issue:1643.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

用户问「咖啡指南现在做到哪了？」时，需要看到有依据的当前状态。现有快回可见部分已提交上下文和汇总计数。#1618 回归还观察到一项已完成的杭州任务被快回称为仍在运行。此议题交付进度查询路径，和 #1618 的快回缺陷修复分别追踪。

### Design Ideas

在快回发布前识别明确的纯进度查询，Host 按当前身份读取 Store 的已提交任务状态、版本和结果引用，Beebou 用该快照回答。目标含糊时澄清，事实暂不可得时明确说明。发布前复核授权，进度查询不向 Bee 投递。

复用 Store 的任务读侧，先在现有 Home 消息入口交付。若需要逐步进度，再由对应执行 owner 单列提案。

[设计规格 v0.1（D1）](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e7bbc16cfe8f27433fe0d0f8058f724f501ddc35/docs/assets/feature-design/hive-post-cutover-spec-v0.1.md#status-snapshot) · [可编辑架构评审](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e7bbc16cfe8f27433fe0d0f8058f724f501ddc35/docs/assets/feature-design/hive-post-cutover-review-v0.1.pptx)

### Involved Public APIs

内部读侧输入是可信范围与精确任务引用，结果是相应状态、提交版本和已授权结果引用。Store 维护任务事实，Host 核验范围。沿用 Home 请求和回复形状。目标缺失、歧义和权限失效有独立结果。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

与 #1310、#1244 衔接，保留 #1618 的专门回归。Bee 执行队列无写入，只有 Home 自身的回复记录按现有规则提交。

评审涉及 Beebou Harness、Host、Session Store。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- **T1.1** 在 Home 依次查询排队、运行、待回答、已完成与失败的已授权任务，核对回复与已提交 Store 版本一致。
- **T1.2** 复跑 #1618 两条时序，覆盖先问后派与完成报告待消费。重放同一消息时，核对当前约定的回执和零新增 Bee 输入、派发或 Run。
- **T1.3** 覆盖两个同名任务、已退役 Bee 的可读历史、权限撤销与外部主体。歧义只澄清，未授权对象的存在不泄露。

### Additional Information

切流后安排。工程估算 **2–4 人日**。评审确定任务读侧接口、发布时版本复核方式及无明确目标时的产品文案。

相关 [#1228](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228) · [#1310](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1310) · [#1618](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1618) · [#1244](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1244) · [切流与发布范围 #1533](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1533)。

issue:1644.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

用户在 Home 说「改成周四」这类无引用续话时，Beebou 应把它接到正确的话题上。main 上 Beebou 已能推断目标（`dispatch` `mode=steer` + `task_ref`），有歧义时用纯文本反问。本 Issue 把歧义追问改为可点选的选项卡，并补齐已完成任务的续话。

范围与规则由 owner 在 #1228 决定：[决定记录 D1–D4](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228#issuecomment-6923295823) · [ADR-0026](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/docs/implementations/adrs/0026-hive-home-unreferenced-followup.md)（#1755 已合入 318ff156；始终推断、不确定时给选项追问、无默认项、无灰度开关）。

### Design Ideas

**相对现状的增量**（其余沿用现有 steer）：

1. **Beebou 选项卡。** 候选话题不唯一时，Beebou 用会话语言追问：「我不确定『<原话>』指的是哪件事，是下面哪一个？」
   - 最多 5 个候选话题，包括最近已完成的话题；外加一个输入框；卡片带过期时间。
   - 能唯一确定时直接投递，不追问。
2. **点选交回 Beebou。** 每个选项带标签；Bee 话题还带它的任务 `task_ref`。（[ADR-0026 Amendment 1](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/docs/implementations/adrs/0026-hive-home-unreferenced-followup.md#amendment-1-a-bee-option-click-is-a-beebou-turn)，#1796）
   - 点选后客户端以 **原话 + 所选选项** 发送 `hive.message.send`。Bee 选项先按现有 `follows` 规则检查，再作为普通 Beebou 输入受理。Host 在这一轮加一条说明，写明所选 Bee、任务和任务状态，由 Beebou 决定怎么处理，并由它写给 Bee 的指令。
   - 不新增 Host 入口，不在 Store 保存追问状态。
3. **输入框作答** 是普通 Home 消息，Beebou 结合刚才的追问重新推断。
4. **超时无默认。** 到期后卡片改写为「我还是不确定『<原话>』指什么，能再多说一点吗？」，选项失效，不投递任何任务。时长写入配置。
5. **已完成任务续话。**
   - Bee 会话仍在时，`plan_route` 走 NewTask，`follows` 指向原任务，沿用该会话上下文。
   - 更新后的回复作为新消息并引用原回复，不原地改写旧答案。
   - 会话已驱逐或替换时，显式引用返回 `SESSION_TARGET_EXPIRED`，客户端改为普通消息交给 Beebou。

**不做：** 默认关闭开关、Host 从文本自行推断目标、新的投递路由。

### Involved Public APIs

- Beebou 新工具（暂名 `ask_choice`）：参数为原话、候选项列表（≤5，每项 `label` + 引用）；产出 Home 选项卡（options、free-text、`expires_at`）。
- 客户端：渲染选项卡，可复用 Bee 问题卡的卡片形态，但不走 `answer_bee`。点选生成带 `choice: {reply_id, option}` 的 `hive.message.send`（契约 [beebou-choice-card.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-choice-card.md) C3）。卡片过期后的改写在各端一致。
- 现有 `hive.message.send` 显式定向、`dispatch` steer 回执（pending / consumed）语义不变。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- Beebou Harness：选项卡工具、推断提示词（替换 `AMBIGUITY_RULE` 的纯文本反问）。
- HarmonyOS 客户端：选项卡渲染、点选重发、过期改写。
- Delivery：选项卡投递与过期改写。
- Host：点选检查、给 Beebou 的说明、`follows` 关联（C5），以及剖析事件 `digitalmate_hive_choice_turn`。

[#1603](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1603) 已合入（`hive_session_target.py`），切流 #1313 / #1533 已完成。本 Issue 属于 #1665。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- **CI 回归**（agent_bridge，可收集）：
  - 两个候选时，产出选项卡且零投递；
  - 点选后由 Beebou 处理一轮：Host 的说明写明所选目标，只对该目标产生一条投递；
  - 超时后零投递，卡片改写；
  - 已完成任务续话走 NewTask 并带 `follows`；
  - 驱逐目标返回 `SESSION_TARGET_EXPIRED` 后零投递。
- **真实模型验收**：多候选会话中，目标明确时直接投递，不明确时追问；统计错误目标率与追问率，作为 #1244 评测常设指标。
- **HarmonyOS Home**：选项卡点选、输入框作答、过期改写、已完成任务的新消息引用原回复。

### Additional Information

工程估算待按缩小后的范围重估，预计低于原 3–5 人日。原 D2 规格草稿（未合入分支 `codex/hive-post-cutover-design-v0.1`）中「默认关闭试点」一节由 #1228 的决定取代。

issue:1645.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

长 Home 对话使提示随轮次增长。需要先知道 Hive 实际产品模型的缓存命中、输入量和延迟，再决定压缩时机。#775 负责通用 HostAPI 上下文能力迁移，本议题聚焦 Hive 配置与实际性能收益。

### Design Ideas

先用真实模型量测前缀稳定性、缓存读量、输入 token 和延迟，把供应商不返回指标视为未知。若基线支持压缩收益，复用现有 Host 上下文和模型操作，在可恢复的边界生成摘要并按修订提交，最近原文、工具调用配对、未处理交互及撤回边界可核验。

以真实 provider 指标决定压缩试点。优先保证长对话语义和可恢复性，再调整压缩阈值。

[设计规格 v0.1（D3）](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e7bbc16cfe8f27433fe0d0f8058f724f501ddc35/docs/assets/feature-design/hive-post-cutover-spec-v0.1.md#context-cache) · [可编辑架构评审](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e7bbc16cfe8f27433fe0d0f8058f724f501ddc35/docs/assets/feature-design/hive-post-cutover-review-v0.1.pptx)

### Involved Public APIs

指标按模型、调用路径和运行标识汇总，不记录对话正文或密钥。摘要提交绑定原上下文版本与来源；版本已变则丢弃或重算。Store 按现有上下文提交策略保存记录。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

复用 #775 所有者能力；与 #1244 共用样本。压缩策略、预算和持久格式需要 Harness 和 Store owner 审定。

评审涉及 Beebou Harness、Model Gateway、Session Store。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- **T3.1** 固定模型、提示和工具集合，报告冷暖缓存、输入量及 p50/p95 延迟。缓存字段缺失单独统计。
- **T3.2** 穿过压缩点与重启复测引用、待回答卡、工具调用配对、撤回和重置，核对权限来源及旧历史。
- **T3.3** 模拟摘要生成后新输入先提交，核对旧摘要提交失败且新轮内容可读。对照评测确认任务和事实没有被改写。

### Additional Information

切流后安排。工程估算 **测量 1–2 人日，压缩试点 4–7 人日**。基线数据、摘要阈值、验收收益和会话修订保证待 owner 评审。

相关 [#1228](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228) · [#1310](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1310) · [#775](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/775) · [#1244](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1244) · [切流与发布范围 #1533](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1533)。

issue:1646.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

当 Hive Bee 能调用的能力增多，把完整工具描述一并放进模型上下文会增加输入量。效果模式当前把 allowlist 直接暴露给 Bee，通用 tool_search/tool_call 被 Host rail 拒绝。

### Design Ideas

在显式试点中复用已有工具目录，仅返回任务和 Run 已获授权的候选。固定一轮的可发现集合，在实际调用点重新核验绑定和撤权。调用仍经过原 Host 效果记录、审批和结果路径。

先选少量已支持的 Hive 工具测可用性和节省，保留原工具暴露方式作为试点关闭时的行为。

[设计规格 v0.1（D4）](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e7bbc16cfe8f27433fe0d0f8058f724f501ddc35/docs/assets/feature-design/hive-post-cutover-spec-v0.1.md#tool-discovery) · [可编辑架构评审](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e7bbc16cfe8f27433fe0d0f8058f724f501ddc35/docs/assets/feature-design/hive-post-cutover-review-v0.1.pptx)

### Involved Public APIs

发现结果标明稳定工具身份与其当前绑定。调用所需权限取自 Host 当前授权，和模型输出的名字、描述分开。发现是只读，重试不会新增效果。使用原操作身份核对未知执行结果。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

#835 负责通用 MCP 底座。本议题负责 Hive Bee caller 和授权联验。已获批准的效果仍走原确认和落账。

评审涉及 Hive Runtime、Host 效果门、Plugin Gateway、WorkSwarm。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- **T4.1** 从真实 Hive Bee 发现并调用一个已授权工具，核对 Host 执行证据和输入 token 对照。
- **T4.2** 验证隐藏未授权工具、可见后撤权、跨 Run 或跨租户借用、描述中的提示注入、关试点及旧调用方兼容。
- **T4.3** Host 调用回执丢失后用原键对账，核对执行次数。覆盖一个仍依赖现有审批的工具。

### Additional Information

切流后安排。工程估算 **4–8 人日**。Host 与 Plugin Gateway owner 审定目录接口、首批工具和逃逸测试。

相关 [#1228](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228) · [#1309](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1309) · [#835](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/835) · [#1533](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1533) · [切流与发布范围 #1533](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1533)。

issue:1647.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

Hive 已有旧历史回填、实时摄取和 Bee 封存交接。需要区分长期事实、近期事件、短期笔记和按需历史检索，为不同任务提供有限、可追溯的信息。

### Design Ideas

围绕 Profile、Log、Notes 和按需检索先约定读取、时效与重置语义。Beebou 提议或挑选片段，Memory owner 写入并保留来源。Host 按范围只读注入。网页、报告及记忆中的文本保持来源标记，不能获得用户指令或效果权限。

先用现有 provider 和来源记录设计读取分层。分类结构及存量回填由 #999 owner 签收。

[设计规格 v0.1（D5）](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e7bbc16cfe8f27433fe0d0f8058f724f501ddc35/docs/assets/feature-design/hive-post-cutover-spec-v0.1.md#memory-tiers) · [可编辑架构评审](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e7bbc16cfe8f27433fe0d0f8058f724f501ddc35/docs/assets/feature-design/hive-post-cutover-review-v0.1.pptx)

### Involved Public APIs

各层约定范围、来源引用、修订、有效性及撤回影响。Memory provider 对同一来源及版本去重，Host 读取当前授权状态。需界定 Notes 的保留期与源记录关联。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

#1312 和 #1610 继续负责当前摄取契约与游标边界，本议题以读取分层、版本、删除和注入为范围。

评审涉及 Memory provider、Beebou Harness、History、Host。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- **T5.1** 用旧库、回填、实时摄取和新 Home 轮验证同源去重、事实更正、分层命中与跨重启读取。
- **T5.2** 覆盖撤回、删除、清空、跨主体检索、摘要和上下文重建，验证已失效片段无法再次进入新模型上下文。
- **T5.3** 在网页、报告和记忆内嵌伪指令，并检查来源类型、模型消息位置和 Host 效果权限均符合既有合约。

### Additional Information

切流后安排。工程估算 **7–12 人日**。Profile、Log、Notes 的分类、保留期、修订和召回预算待 #999 评审。

相关 [#999](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/999) · [#1228](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228) · [#1312](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1312) · [#1610](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1610) · [切流与发布范围 #1533](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1533)。

### Bee / Beebou 记忆加载补充（#1665 后续）

基于 main `629ba37e` 的代码核查：Hive 已有 Session Context 提交、Global Memory 摄取和 provider 检索组件；尚未确认 Bee / Beebou 产品路径已加载 Local Memory 或调用 Hive Global Memory 检索。验收需区分组件、受控替身与实际产品调用。

- [ ] 复用 #1312 Hive Memory provider 与 Host 授权，为 Bee 和 Beebou 接入已发布且当前获权的 Global Memory 读取；保留来源和版本，覆盖撤权、重启与跨用户隔离。检索接口当前仍为 Memory owner 待签收提案。
- [ ] 接入各自 Local Memory 的实际 owner 与加载：Bee 被驱逐后旧身份不复活，新 Bee 使用独立 Local Memory；仅已发布且获权的 Global 碎片可跨 Bee 使用。
- [ ] Beebou 快回使用最近约 10k 的上下文且不做工具 I/O；次快回和 Bee 触发轮按授权加载相关记忆及 inbox。核实较大原文保留窗口、任务完成总结、达到阈值时保留最近两三轮并总结更早内容，不把摘要当成原文。
- [ ] 按已确认的分类/子分类加载和长度预算接入，首版不加 embedding；Global 查询阈值参考现有配置（有效 Local 条目 ≤ 3）；分类注册与 owner 以 #999 / #1228 的现行决定为准。
- [ ] 验证用户请求的 attention 最近 5 个任务与 LRU 语义；先确认分类归属和 owner，不预设以任务为分类。
- [ ] 用真实 Hive Store、Phase 3 Memory provider 与仓库内 WorkSwarm 的 Bee 运行时验证 Bee / Beebou 产品入口；列出替身、未运行项目、记忆撤权后已加载上下文的处理及数据覆盖差异。

依赖与边界：Session Context / Local / Global 正文归属见 #1228 未决项；旧 EngineMemory 与 Hive provider 是不同数据面，不在未验证覆盖前删除旧能力。Bee 其他工具的接入与 #1750 跟踪于 #1749；本文不要求新建逐 Bee 沙箱。

issue:1648.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

长时网页工作遇到浏览器实例休眠、工具失败或运行时重启时，需要从已有检查点继续，并保证同一效果不会重复发生。试点先选定一个有明确验收的浏览器任务。

### Design Ideas

首个试点限定已授权的网页读取工作流。Bee 通过 Host 申请任务绑定的 helper，检查点携带原 Run 与稳定操作 ID。恢复前重验授权和浏览器隔离。最终结果经原 Bee 回到 Home。

选一个真实网站的可重读场景验证暂停与恢复。外发、支付和已登录账户动作继续受各自 owner 的确认约束。

[设计规格 v0.1（D6）](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e7bbc16cfe8f27433fe0d0f8058f724f501ddc35/docs/assets/feature-design/hive-post-cutover-spec-v0.1.md#resumable-helper) · [可编辑架构评审](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e7bbc16cfe8f27433fe0d0f8058f724f501ddc35/docs/assets/feature-design/hive-post-cutover-review-v0.1.pptx)

### Involved Public APIs

助手身份绑定主体、任务、Run 和操作。检查点记录已确认步骤、恢复所需引用及其权限。存在未知副作用时由 owner 按原键对账。Stop 撤销继续执行的许可。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Browser / Sandbox owner 保存运行和检查点，Host 持有执行权限，Session Store 持有 Hive 作业与回执。试点先走公开网页读取。

评审涉及 Host Runtime、Browser / Sandbox owner、Session Store。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- **T6.1** 真实运行时验证沙箱关闭、恢复、Stop 与重启。验证已完成步骤、最终来源和 Home 回执可核对。
- **T6.2** 注入提交后丢回执、权限撤销、越租户、恶意网页注入和并发恢复，核对权限和副作用次数。
- **T6.3** 实测冷启动、休眠和恢复耗时。明确当前只读试点的范围、日志和验收运行环境。

### Additional Information

切流后安排。工程估算 **10–20+ 人日（首个工作流，取决于运行时复用）**。待 owner 选定首个工作流、沙箱生命周期及检查点保留约束。

相关 [#1228](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228) · [#1309](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1309) · [#1533](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1533) · [切流与发布范围 #1533](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1533)。

issue:1650.body:
### 🐞 Problem

**Home never shows Beebou's relays of Bee results.** When a Bee finishes, Beebou relays the result, but the relay never appears in the Home transcript, neither live nor after a reload.

Found on the SC04-C1 device run against `hive/hive3-integration` @ `6cac213b` (direct instance in adx-jiuwen-test-0, emulator, real model). Diagnosis from the client lane:

- A relay is a Beebou turn on a `kind='done'` input. `hive_store.list_beebou_home_submissions`, used by `HiveHomeTrial.project`, selects only `i.kind='user'`. So relay replies never reach Home `messages`, on load or in history.
- The only live signal is the broadcast `hive.beebou.reply {trigger:'bee_done', bee_id, text, final}`. The client uses it only as an Activity refresh trigger (`DigitalMateHiveActivity.ets:34`).
- Rendering only the push would make relays disappear on reload.

### Expected

Done-triggered Beebou replies are projected into the Home transcript, with position and page queries, so they survive a reload. The client renders them in Home.

### Scope

- Server: the projection of `kind='done'` Beebou turns into Home messages and pages.
- Client: render them, and dedupe them against the live `hive.beebou.reply` push.
- Not in the Router-retirement cutover #1605. It's listed there as a known limit. Bee results stay visible in the Bee/Activity view. Tracked under #1533.

issue:1653.body:
## What happens

When a setup turn's dispatch has been accepted, Beebou keeps making tool-call rounds until it runs out of its 12-call normal-turn budget (`max_model_calls`). The harness then raises `RuntimeError: Beebou exceeded its normal-turn model call budget`, and the Store settles the turn as `harness` / `settled`. The user sees the generic failure notice "抱歉，这条消息没能处理完成，其中一个操作可能已经执行。请先查看结果，再决定是否重试。", even though the Bee was created and its task was accepted and queued.

This is the same budget-exhaustion path as #1616, with a different trigger: no slot is busy here, and create and dispatch both succeed.

## Evidence (hive3 `6cac213b`, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, run `pf-6cac213b`, 2 of 42 repeats)

| Trace | Turn | Tool plans committed | Normal-turn model calls |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `artifacts/hive-live/pf-6cac213b/HIVE-LIVE-EVICT-04/r2/trace.json` | F1 (first turn, empty slots) | `create_bee` ACTIVE, `dispatch` accepted (`task_0e4fcfac…`, queued) | 12 calls, every one `finish_reason=tool_calls`; prompt grows by about 300 tokens a round |
| `artifacts/hive-live/pf-6cac213b/HIVE-LIVE-EVICT-06/r3/trace.json` | F1 | `create_bee` ACTIVE, two `dispatch` accepted | 12 with `tool_calls`, then 1 `stop` |

- `dm_hive_beebou_turn_failures`: `kind=harness`, `reason=RuntimeError: Beebou exceeded its normal-turn model call budget`, `outcome=settled`.
- The extra rounds left no row in `dm_hive_beebou_tool_plans`, so they are read-only calls (the proxy records counts, not names).
- In both traces the gateway shows no error during the turn.

## Expected

After a dispatch has been accepted, running out of the budget should not settle the turn as a failure. `normal.py` already has a receipt reply for the empty-content case (`accepted_dispatch` → "已将任务交给 Bee 处理。"). Use it, or a configured receipt, when the loop reaches `max_model_calls` with `accepted_dispatch` true. Also consider stopping repeated read-only calls once a dispatch has been accepted, for example with a per-turn read-only call cap set in TOML.

## Owner

Beebou harness: `dm_hive_beebou/harness/normal.py`, the `run()` loop end, plus the read-only call policy. This is the #1616 lane.

Found by the Hive behaviour QA post-fix pass (#1244 SC04-E2, Phase 3 tracker #1533).

issue:1654.body:
## What happens

In one normal turn, Beebou dispatches a `new` task to a Bee and then steers that same new task, sending almost the same text a second time. The Host accepts both calls, so the Bee gets the request twice.

## Evidence (hive3 `6cac213b`, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, run `pf-6cac213b`)

`artifacts/hive-live/pf-6cac213b/HIVE-LIVE-STEER-04/r2/trace.json`, turn T2. The user said "再补充一点：开业前三天全场八折。" after T1's task had finished.

1. `dispatch {id: bee-9571…, mode: new, text: "用户补充了一条关键信息，请据此更新上一版…"}` returned `accepted`, `task_0125535a…`, queued. This alone is the expected `new:reuse`.
2. `dispatch {id: bee-9571…, mode: steer, task_ref: task_0125535a…, text: "再次确认：上一个任务请直接作废，改用本条要求。用户补充的是：开业前三天全场八折…"}` returned `accepted`, delivery pending.

The grader recorded the decision `new:reuse+steer` against the allowed set `new:reuse | answer`, so FAIL. It happened in 1 of 3 repeats; r1 and r3, and p3's 3 repeats on be000e5e, did not.

## Expected

A turn should not steer a task that it created itself in the same turn. Options:
- The Host refuses a steer whose `task_ref` came from a `new` dispatch earlier in the same turn, returning a clear status the model can read.
- Or the Beebou prompt or skill says so.

## Owner

Beebou prompt or skill, and the Host dispatch guard (Hive Host tools).

Found by the Hive behaviour QA post-fix pass (#1244 SC04-E2, Phase 3 tracker #1533).

issue:1658.body:
### Problem

A question card raised by a Bee's `ask_user` doesn't name the asking Bee. On the SC04-C1 device run against `hive/hive3-integration` @ `6cac213b`, Beta's card read "Beebou 想问你". #1651 changes Hive cards to a generic "Bee 想问你", but the Bee's name still isn't shown.

### Cause (client lane)

- `question_card()` (`server_engine/hive_bee_execution.py:411`) carries no Bee label.
- The snapshot's `hive_tasks` row has only `bee_id`.
- Bee names live only in `hive.activity.get` lanes, which Home reads only while Activity is open.

### Expected

The card shows "{Bee label} 想问你". A display label is added to the `hive.result.get` interaction, or to `hive_tasks` rows, and the client renders it for `hive:` cards.

### Scope

UX follow-up after the Router-retirement cutover (#1605). Not a G5 condition. Tracked under #1533.

issue:1659.body:
### Problem
Self-hosted runner `digitalmate-win-st-04` has twice hung the hypium-ut job in "Run Hypium" until the 45-minute job timeout cancelled it. Normal runs take about 5 minutes.
- #1573 at 27a21ffa: a rerun passed.
- #1297 at 58558f4a.
Both heads change only fixtures and tests, and they pass locally (2326/0).

### Expected
Check or drain the runner. Consider a shorter step timeout with a clear "runner hang" result, so a hang isn't read as a code failure.

### Scope
CI infrastructure (runner owner). No code change in the PRs.

issue:1660.body:
### Problem
After #1641 (#1618 guards), a quick reply can still state an earlier task's progress after that task completed, when the wording falls outside the guard's word lists.

Live, `pr1641-b9ff090a`, Flash, HIVE-LIVE-FOLLOW-04 r3 T2: the quick reply "好，杭州一日游也记下了。等我这边把周报的事收个尾，马上开始安排…" was committed although the weekly-report task was already completed. The normal turn corrected it.

Traces: `artifacts/hive-live/pr1641-b9ff090a/HIVE-LIVE-FOLLOW-04/r3/trace.json` (behaviour QA worktree).

### Expected
A quick reply doesn't imply that an earlier task is still in progress unless the given task view shows it active. Extend the `task_state_mismatch` guard beyond the "still running" phrases, e.g. "wrapping up", "收个尾", "等我这边…完".

### Scope
After the cutover (#1605). Same family as #1618 and #1537. Tracked under #1533.

issue:1661.body:
### Problem
When a Bee raises `ask_user`, Beebou on Home refused to relay the question to the user, apparently confusing Bot capabilities with tools. The tester had to answer on the Bee's own lane. The question card and the answer path work: Beta's run consumed the answer.

Observed on the SC04-C1 device run against `hive/hive3-integration` @ `6cac213b` (direct instance, real model). Evidence: `hk-longjianyu:~/oc-out/hive-device-receipts/6cac213bcc2d-evidence/`.

Behaviour QA did not reproduce it: no live case answers a Bee question through Home, so there is a coverage gap. In EVICT-03 r2, Beebou listed every pending question as a table without refusing.

### Expected
Beebou relays a pending Bee question on Home when the user asks about it, and accepts an answer for it.

### Scope
Beebou prompt or skill, plus a new live case for ask_user relay through Home. After the cutover (#1605). Tracked under #1533.

issue:1662.body:
### Problem
With an ambiguous reference such as "that email" or "the trip", Beebou routes to the most recent Bee instead of asking which one is meant.

Behaviour QA `pf-6cac213b` (Flash): AMBIG-01 r1–r3 UNREASONABLE (r3 hedges and offers to switch), and AMBIG-02 r1 UNREASONABLE. Traces: `artifacts/hive-live/pf-6cac213b/HIVE-LIVE-AMBIG-0{1,2}/`.

### Expected
When several Bees match, Beebou asks a short disambiguating question before dispatching.

### Scope
Model limit, prompt-tunable (Beebou prompt or skill). After the cutover (#1605). Tracked under #1533.

issue:1663.body:
### Problem
For a device row (e.g. SC04-C1), `run_hive.py --device-receipt` passes the row when every journey in the receipt is PASS. It doesn't know the row's required step list (C1-S1/S2/S3), so a receipt that silently omits a step would pass.

For the v3.1 G5 call, QA checked the step list by hand and published a per-step checklist next to the receipt.

### Expected
`tests/scenarios/hive/device_receipt.toml` declares the required steps per row, and `device.py` refuses PASS when any required step is missing.

### Scope
Runner (hive3 QA owner). v3.5. Tracked under #1533.

issue:1664.body:
### Problem
OpenJiuwen Core keeps its cross-process file-lock SQLite DBs in a machine-global `<tmp>/openjiuwen-fs-rwlocks`. On a multi-user host the directory may belong to another user. Every Core `write_file` then fails with "unable to open database file".

Seen on HK, where `/tmp/openjiuwen-fs-rwlocks` was owned by another user (mode 775): SC04-W1's workspace tests failed until the runner gave each run a private TMPDIR (runner c4d884a1).

### Expected
The lock directory is per user or per process root, or configurable, e.g. under the runtime's own state dir.

### Scope
Core/runtime owner (`harness/agent-core`, upstream). Single-user containers (the product deploy) are unaffected. After the cutover (#1605). Tracked under #1533.

issue:1672.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

为会议报告 Demo 的 Intelligent UI 补齐卡片背面交互：用户从卡片正面进入背面，查看本次任务实际处理的关键步骤及关联材料，浏览材料详情后能够平滑返回正面。该任务细化 #918 中的卡片翻面与依据查看，并与报告流程 #1376 协同。

需求表负责人：需辉（仅记录需求表中的姓名，不自动指定 GitHub 账号）。设计依据为需求方提供的 `DM1114规范包.zip`，重点参考 `data/exports/03.卡片背面@2x.png` 和 `data/22-5.png`；用户提供的验收截图列出了翻面、翻回、列表滚动和条目详情的检查步骤。规范文件尚未作为附件上传到本 Issue，下面列出可执行的设计要点。

### Design Ideas

首批实现见 [草稿 PR #1844](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1844)。评审材料见 [设计稿 v0.1](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/3b00877532a3080abf27d14e6775aa7ee2a0bedf/docs/assets/feature-design/report-card-back-design-v0.1.pptx) 和 [DM1114 背面参照](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/3b00877532a3080abf27d14e6775aa7ee2a0bedf/docs/assets/feature-design/report-card-back-dm1114.png)。

本批覆盖方案版本匹配、分类、条目详情和已有权限下的邮件原文片段。模拟器验收待设备空出后执行，记忆分类的常驻规则、其他材料与 PPT 详情继续在本 Issue 跟进。

#### 主分支核查结论（静态检查基于 `498bc351`）

- 已有基础：#1269 已合入原生邀约卡和方向卡的翻面、背面弹层、摘要“更多”、分类切换和可滚动内容；#1463 补充了点击外部遮罩返回。当前 [DigitalMateHome 已调用这些卡片并映射报告快照](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4/digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets#L4667-L4678)，因此不应再将其描述为仅有独立预览页。
- 材料详情未贯通：生产会话中 [`sourcesAvailable` 固定为 `false`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4/digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets#L4842-L4854)，所以现有来源入口不会显示；即使调用回调，[详情请求的返回字符串目前也没有呈现到界面](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4/digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets#L4735-L4742)。应核对并正确使用 `source_ref`、`detail_ref`、`source_url` 的各自语义，不能只把开关改成 `true`。
- 真实数据映射与规范存在差异：[分类的标题和来源标签被映射为空](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4/digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/cloud/digitalmate/report/ReportCardMapping.ets#L36-L49)；[面板仅保留上下文、知识、技能](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4/digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/cloud/digitalmate/report/ReportEvidencePanel.ets#L18-L23)，技能图标使用兜底样式。规范包还展示了“记忆”分类；而 #1269 曾明确只提供三类，**需要产品确认本次四类规范是否覆盖此前决策**，不应伪造不存在的数据。
- 处理步骤和状态需按真实契约核对：当前服务端 [依据视图组装邮件事实、规划 Skill 和传入依据](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4/temp/report-goals/src/dm_report_goals/service.py#L371-L395)；`cited`、`loaded`、`planned` 等状态与[客户端状态文案映射](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4/digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/cloud/digitalmate/report/ReportCardModel.ets#L192-L201)并不一致。还需验证目标 `version` 与依据 `plan_version` 不同、以及历史卡片重开时的匹配逻辑，避免当前依据消失或旧依据被误标为当前版本。

以上是代码核查，不代表设备上的最终效果或真实链路已经验收。

#### 需求范围

1. 基于已有报告卡片，保留正面翻面入口、分段动画、背面翻回按钮及外部遮罩返回；卡片内部点击和滚动不得误触关闭，快速重复点击、切换会话及页面销毁时状态正确。
2. 按规范展示背面摘要、分类与内容区域。摘要较长时最多展示四行并提供“更多”，展开后展示全文且不显示“收起”；翻回后再次进入的展开状态与最终规范对齐。分类采用选中态和相邻项的视觉层级，内容滚动时分类区按设计吸顶。
3. 依据最新规范与产品确认后的分类范围，支持“上下文 / 知识 / 记忆 / 技能”的显示及切换；每类只展示真实可用数据。缺失、加载中、无权限、失败等情况明确提示，不把无效入口显示为可点击。
4. 背面展示有真实记录支持的关键处理步骤或决策说明及其关联材料，不把示例数据当作真实记录。材料有数据时展示标题、来源、时间、关键内容及可用的原文 / 详情入口；不可用的字段如实缺省。摘要内关联标签与列表项应定位或打开对应材料，并支持返回原背面上下文。
5. 文本段落、结构化信息及报告产物按现有来源和文件能力展示；邮件正文、来源和 PPT 的读取均遵循原有权限与归属。关联关系必须属于当前账号、目标、阶段及方案版本，历史卡片应保留对应历史依据。
6. 实现前对齐版本化设计稿与三类/四类决策；在不改变原有选题确认、补充要求和邮件查看行为的前提下复用已合并的组件。依据应是可对用户解释、可验证的处理记录，不暴露模型内部隐式思维链。

### Involved Public APIs

优先复用现有报告快照、`evidence_views`、`report.goal.detail`、邮件和文件入口。由报告服务与客户端共同确认步骤、材料、来源引用、可访问状态及版本字段的契约；如需扩展协议，单独说明兼容和权限边界，避免把来源标识当成可直接读取的详情引用。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

涉及报告目标/处理记录、邮件与其他材料来源、文件/PPT 预览、会话快照和历史卡片，以及卡片 UI。与 #918、#1376 保持范围衔接；已有预览基础见 #1267 / #1269，外部遮罩返回见 #1461 / #1463。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- 对照规范包和用户验收截图：从正面翻到背面，检查关键步骤与材料无缺失、无错位；在背面切换分类、展开摘要、滚动列表、点击材料并返回，最后翻回正面，确认动画与状态正确。
- 覆盖真实快照的分类名称、`cited` / `loaded` / `planned` 等状态、不同来源引用、详情结果及空/无权限/失败状态；覆盖摘要标签定位、列表项点击和真实版本变化，验证不可访问材料不会误开或显示虚假内容。
- 验证同一目标多轮邮件、方案更新、旧卡片、账号/会话切换、刷新及重启，确保数据和链接不串用；回归确认/补充、原邮件打开、遮罩返回和文件查看。
- 自动化覆盖映射、面板交互及客户端与报告服务的契约；随后在真机或可用模拟器使用独立测试数据做端到端验证，记录安装版本、结果、规范对照截图或录屏。检查窄屏、大字体、读屏和长内容滚动。

本次核查已运行现有 `digitalmate-report-cards` 与 `digitalmate-report-card-mapping` 两组 Node 测试，共 20 项通过；它们使用测试替身，不能作为真机及真实材料链路验收。

### Additional Information

本 Issue 负责细化背面 UI 和依据查看，不表示 #918 / #1376 的完整报告流程已经完成。请在实施设计阶段补充团队可访问的规范包或设计稿链接，并保存实际验收截图。

issue:1673.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

PR #1601 added the Hive trustworthiness "startup batch": the `temp/hive-trust/` diagnostics partition
(correlated events with evidence kinds, a conservative no-reply investigator), emitters at the real
Beebou owner boundaries, and the packaging/ownership declarations that make the package buildable and
visible to the architecture gates.

#1601 was merged into `hive/hive3-integration` at 14:38 CST on 2026-11-16 (`e3bcc0c3`) and reverted two
minutes later (`47e5a102`) because the v3.1 lead had frozen scope for the Router-retirement cutover
(#1605), and that day's G5/G6 runs, behaviour QA and device receipt did not cover the Beebou turn-path
changes. The branch `feat/hive-trust-hardening` was left untouched. #1605 is now merged into `main`
(`498bc351`), so this issue tracks re-landing the same change on `main`.

Tracked under #1344 and the post-HIVE collection #1665.

### Design Ideas

- Re-land by reverting the revert (`47e5a102`) on a branch from `main`, rather than re-opening #1601:
  git already records those commits as merged, so the original branch has an empty diff against `main`.
- Behavior stays opt-in: `DIGITALMATE_HIVE_DIAGNOSTICS` absent or `off` installs no recorder; an
  unknown value refuses startup instead of silently disabling evidence.
- The partition stays read-only and temporary until the observability owner publishes the event schema;
  emitters stay at commit/observation boundaries only.
- Not included here (separate follow-ups): a `CLIENT_DISPLAY` producer from the client, and a reader that
  parses `hive_diag` log lines back into events.

### Involved Public APIs

- New package `dm_hive_trust.diagnostics`: `DiagnosticEvent`, `EventLog`, `Stage`, `EvidenceKind`,
  `DiagnosticRecorder`, `DiagnosticReceiver`, `NoReplyInvestigator`, `investigate_message`,
  `investigate_delivery`, `configured_recorder`, `SETTING`.
- `investigate_message` / `investigate_delivery` require a `scope_token` keyword.
- No existing public interface changes; the Bridge imports the package only when the setting is `log`.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- Bridge Beebou turn path: `server_engine/hive_turn_startup.py`, `hive_beebou_model.py`,
  `hive_beebou_tools.py`, `server_engine/server.py` (assembly).
- Ownership/architecture: `temp/hive-beebou/ownership.json` (`hive-trust-diagnostics` in `allowed`,
  `legacy-mobile-gateway` admitted as caller) and `temp/hive-trust/ownership.json`.
- Packaging/CI: Bridge `pyproject.toml` wheel force-include, `.github/ci-gates.json`
  (`sourcePaths` / `sourcePackages`), `scripts/ci/server_context_source.py`,
  `tests/server/test_installed_package_proof.py`.

### Test Design and Test Plan

Local, executed on the re-land branch before the PR:

- `pytest temp/hive-trust/tests -q` -> 52 passed.
- `pytest temp/hive-beebou/tests tests/architecture/test_import_gate.py -q` -> 111 passed, 29 subtests.
- `tools/architecture/transition.py --check docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json --root .`
  -> exit 0.

Covered by this batch: owner-boundary emitters over real owners (real `deliver` with
`SQLiteSessionRepository`, real `HiveTurnStartup.accept`, controlled model gateway, faulting tool
provider, failing and succeeding push callables); lost ACK, deadline-cut commit, receipt mismatch,
malformed tool call, concurrent turns, unsafe identifiers, failing sink.

Not covered and not to be reported as passed: T02, T04-T80, C01-C24, H01-H08; the `telethon`-dependent
Bridge scenario tests; real device display (`CLIENT_DISPLAY` has no producer yet); any cloud deployment.

Planned end-to-end verification for this re-land:

1. `python3.13 tests/scenarios/run_hive.py --gate G1 --report hive-g1.json --markdown hive-g1.md --prepare-deps .hive-deps-venv`.
2. One test-environment deployment with `DIGITALMATE_HIVE_DIAGNOSTICS=log` driving the four fault cases
   (lost ACK, accepted but unclaimed, model/tool start without terminal, committed but undisplayed) and
   reading the emitted `hive_diag` lines.

### Additional Information

- Merge commit `e3bcc0c3`, revert `47e5a102`, cutover `#1605`, original branch
  `feat/hive-trust-hardening` at `d5d338e4`. Re-land branch `feat/hive-trust-reland`.
- Review findings F1-F8 and R1-R8, each with its test, are recorded in `temp/hive-trust/TRACEABILITY.md`.

### Related trust items collected in #1665

These post-cutover items are the symptoms this diagnostics layer is meant to make provable. This
re-land does not fix them; it supplies the correlated evidence and the conservative "where did it
stop" answer they need:

- #1637 (STEER-01): a reply says a steer was added while its receipt is still pending and unconsumed.
  The evidence rules here are exactly what separates "the owner admitted it" from "a reply claims it".
- #1650: the Home transcript never shows Beebou's relays of Bee results. Display is only proven by a
  `CLIENT_DISPLAY` event, which has no producer yet (listed as a follow-up above).
- #1653: after an accepted dispatch, the turn settles as a generic failure although the Bee got the
  task. The investigator reports `UNKNOWN` with the missing fact and next owner instead of a generic
  failure.
- #1655: orphaned `RUNNING` Bee Runs after restart or a missing terminal. Correlation by
  message/delivery/task ref is what a recovery walk needs to find them.
- #1663: the device receipt runner should enforce each row's required step list. The same rule applies
  here: a row without its named evidence is `NOT_RUN`, not a pass.

issue:1678.body:
### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**The client drops a failed Bee terminal in Home and never reads its `reason`.** Split out of #1655 (F4) under #1665. The server side is complete. This issue covers only the client presentation and its device evidence.

The server sends one frame per failed Bee terminal. It is replayed once per `event_id`:

```json
{"event": "digitalmate.task.text", "task_id": "<task_ref>", "execution_id": "<run_id>", "event_id": "<id>",
 "version": 1, "committed_message_id": "<id>", "state": "failed", "text": "", "earlier": "", "final": true,
 "reason": "context_commit_failed | empty_final | interrupted"}
```

`reason` names the cause:
- `context_commit_failed` (#1547): the turn's context never reached the Session Store.
- `empty_final` (#1652): the runtime ended the turn without reply text.
- `interrupted` (#1655): the Host lost the turn after a restart or a missing terminal.

The task view state is `failed`.

What the client does with it today (code reading on `main` at 498bc351):
- `DigitalMateConversation.ets` `DigitalMateHiveNotices.accept` checks only `event.state === 'stopped'`. A `failed` frame becomes an ordinary result notice with empty text, titled `Bee 已完成`.
- `hiveNoticeRows()` turns it into an assistant row with empty text. The Home page drops empty rows (`Index.ets`, `.filter((row) => !!row.text)`). So the Home stream shows no line for the failure.
- `reason` is not read anywhere in `digitalmate/`.
- Where the task itself is shown as `failed`, the client uses the generic `digitalmateStatusText` default, 本轮任务执行失败，暂时无法确认具体原因…, and the notification 任务未完成 · <title>. Nobody has yet shown on a device whether Home displays that failed task state for a Bee task (see #1650: Home does not project Bee relays).

**Expected:** the client renders a failed Bee terminal as a failure, never as a completed or empty result. It uses `reason` to word the line: for example, the Bee gave no reply (`empty_final`), or the Bee's run was interrupted (`interrupted`). It keeps a phrase the device e2e detector matches (`任务执行失败` / `联系服务管理员`). The client owns the wording.

**Done when:** a device receipt on a deployed candidate shows a failed Bee task in Home (or in the Bee/Activity view, if that is where Bee terminals belong), with the reason-specific wording. The server can produce each reason on demand with the owner tests listed below.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

Code reading only, no device run yet. Server: `main` @ 498bc351 plus #1655. Client: `digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/digitalmate/DigitalMateConversation.ets` (`DigitalMateHiveNotices`, `hiveNoticeRows`), `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets` (empty-row filter), `DigitalMateStatus.ets` (`digitalmateStatusText`).

### Additional Information

The server reproduces each reason in these owner tests: `tests/scenarios/hive/test_phase3_bee_empty_final.py` (`empty_final`, including a queued supplement) and `tests/scenarios/hive/test_phase3_bee_orphan_recovery.py` (`interrupted`). The contract is in `docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-hive-phase3-delivery.md` §7c.

### Version Information

v3.1 after the Hive cutover (#1605); target v3.5 with #1655.

issue:1698.body:
## Summary
The deployment assets under `harness/personal-agent/deploy` need a consistent, validated deployment contract. The file named `digitalmate-template.prod.json` can be mistaken for a directly deployable current template, while it differs materially from `render_session_template.py`.

Evidence baseline: main `d47d3d6c`.

## Repository evidence
- `digitalmate-template.prod.json` still names image tag `v0.1.10` and sets `resources.memory_limit_mib=2048`.
- `render_session_template.py` requires an explicit digest-pinned image, preserves a complete platform base template's mounts/volumes, and sets `memory_limit_mib=4096`.
- The static JSON includes a concrete storage namespace prefix rather than requiring a target-environment-specific base. Copying it unchanged into another environment is unsafe.
- `DIGITALMATE_HIVE_CONFIG=/opt/personal-agent/hive-deploy.toml` is already present. The production TOML declares `principal_binding="per_user"` but intentionally does not enable Hive; the static JSON does not explicitly select a Hive profile. This is not a claim that Hive should be enabled by default.
- Updating an image does not automatically update an already-published ADX template's environment settings.

## Requested outcome
Provide one documented, validated path to render a target-environment deployment from its exported complete platform template. Clarify whether the checked-in prod JSON is an example, a baseline, or directly deployable. Keep static examples, renderer and runbook aligned.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Explicit image digest/version selection; no accidental deployment of the stale example tag.
- [ ] Validate and preserve target-environment workspace volume IDs, source prefixes, mounts, lifecycle and isolation. Do not hard-code any particular test environment as the universal default.
- [ ] Explicitly select/document legacy versus Hive settings, approved Beebou identity and the effective settings log. Preserve safe defaults and Bee-effects opt-in.
- [ ] Verify that the configured Hive TOML exists in the built image and is actually referenced by the published template.
- [ ] Treat `per_user` as a verified isolation contract, not a workaround: authenticated user-to-binding routing, independent workspace storage, and appropriate negative isolation tests are prerequisites.
- [ ] Align resource settings and document sizing evidence for cold start, first connection and representative tasks, including sandbox overhead and headroom. A 4 GiB setting is not by itself a universal production capacity guarantee.
- [ ] Keep model endpoints/aliases environment-specific and credentials runtime-injected; do not commit secrets.
- [ ] Automated consistency/validation tests cover examples, renderer and deployment documentation, plus a rollout checklist distinguishes template publication, alias/binding activation, readiness and authenticated WebSocket/application validation.

Related: #1495 (closed enablement mechanism), #1494 (gateway/Hive isolation contract). Collection: #1665.

This issue requests deployment-template/documentation/validation work only; it does not request changing a running environment or weakening isolation.

issue:1701.body:
**Found by:** the live-model acceptance run for #1637/#1654 on main `d47d3d6cfc6489f745b2846cd59950de2ce34175`, built on hp-laptop with `tests/eval/hive-live/build_server_env.py --ref d47d3d6cf…` (the `docs/scenarios/hive-behaviour-qa.md` path).

**Defect 1 — package proof refuses main's own registry.** `package proof` fails with `PackageProofError: incoming registry transition suite has an unreviewed shape: history-recovery-sources`. `.github/ci-gates.json` enrols `history-recovery-sources` (path `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests`, added by #1298), but `INCOMING_REGISTRY` / `REVIEWED_PERMANENT_SUITES` in `scripts/ci/server_contract_package.py` pin only `hive-scenarios` as a permanent suite, and the `temp/<feature>/tests` rule rejects this path. Every main since #1298 fails the wheel build for hive-live / `run_hive.py --source wheel`. Fix shape follows #1422: reviewed row in `scripts/ci` first (trusted run reads it from base), then nothing more is needed because the registry row is already on main.

**Defect 2 — runtime venv cannot install `digitalmate-history-context-recovery==0.2.0`.** `tests/scenarios/run_hive.py:prepare_dependencies` pip-installs `bridge_dependencies()`, which now includes that requirement; it is a repo-local package (`temp/history-context-recovery`), not on PyPI or the mirror, so pip fails with `No matching distribution found`. The helper needs to build/install that wheel (as `install_runtime.py` already knows via `RECOVERY_REQUIREMENT`).

**Workaround used (not committed):** allow-list row added in the throwaway source worktree only; wheel built from `temp/history-context-recovery` and installed into the venv by hand. Candidate source files are unchanged.

**Done when:** `build_server_env.py --ref origin/main` completes on a clean host without manual steps.

Refs #1637, #1654. Parent: #1665.

issue:1708.body:
### 🐞 Problem

**Beebou's relay of a finished Bee does not show in Home live.** The `hive.beebou.reply` push reaches the device, but the relay bubble appears only after the app is reloaded. While Home is open, it shows the Bee's raw result text instead, and that bubble disappears on reload.

This is the live half of #1650; the reload half now passes. Found in the device acceptance run for #1650 on main `14a95298b3d8d017c27e027cb6060f068aa3c0f7` (includes #1689 `1351fbf6`).

### Run

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Server | `digitalmate@sha256:1c73c5d0e8a17c45c253a3bff909407488968b9f57286f7c18db06ec4f83ee45`, direct Pod `dm-hive-direct-qa-14a95298` in adx-jiuwen-test-0, real model; torn down |
| Client | `com.jiuwen.digitalmate.hivedirectqa` 0.1.0 (10006), HAP sha256 `a51e9885…5b36455` |
| Device | DevEco emulator Pura 90, OpenHarmony-6.1.1.125, API 24 |
| Receipt | `hk-longjianyu:~/oc-out/hive-device-receipts/14a95298-issue-1650-1658/issue-receipt-1650-1658.json`, sha256 `69a6f91cc160a31945415af2573b5d4d9c485f99b761c4f3ea5b3436f528570c`; screenshots, text dumps and Store snapshots in `evidence/` next to it |

### Evidence

There were two rounds in Home, each asking for two different Bees (Alpha and Beta). Both rounds had `dm_hive_beebou_turn_failures` = 0.

| Round | Store | Live Home | After reload (force-stop + start) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| R1 | `done` seq 4 (Beta), 5 (Alpha); `beebou_context_runs` 4 and 5 `COMPLETED` | The run-4 relay showed once. **The run-5 relay never showed** (watched for more than 5 min). Two copy-only bubbles held the raw Bee texts | Runs 4 and 5 showed once each, in Store order. The raw Bee bubbles were gone |
| R2 | `done` seq 9 (Beta), 10 (Alpha); runs 9 and 10 `COMPLETED` | **Neither relay showed** (watched for about 3 min). Only the two raw Bee result bubbles | Runs 9 and 10 showed once each, in Store order. The raw Bee bubbles were gone |

In R2, the QA relay recorded the frames it forwarded to the device. Each frame below is `hive.beebou.reply`, `trigger=bee_done`, `outcome=committed`, `final=true`, `bot_id=beebou`, `session_ref=hive-session-beebou-g1-71ac1845dcef`:

| source_seq | bee_id | text_len |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 9 | `bee-1526db17…` | 163 |
| 10 | `bee-7a958fdf…` | 413 |

The device therefore got a push that passes every field check in `acceptHiveRelay`. Even so, no row with ID `hive-home:<session>:9:reply` or `hive-home:<session>:10:reply` appeared until the reload.

Evidence files: `03-home-live-end.jpeg` (R1 live), `04-reload.jpeg`, `06-home-live2.jpeg` and `06-home-live2-texts.txt` (R2 live), `06-relay-beebou-reply-witness.jsonl`, `07-reload2*.{jpeg,txt}`, `07-store.json`.

### Not yet known

The cause has not been diagnosed. Things to check:
- `acceptHiveRelay` returns false on the device. A likely spot is the `home.id !== this.roomId` guard: the unit test uses room id `home`, but the device's Home room id may differ.
- The relay is accepted but then dropped or hidden when `apply()` rebuilds rows.
- The follow-up `scheduleRefresh()` snapshot does not replace the live revision, so the projected row from the server is not applied until the next load.

Two more points:
- The raw Bee result bubbles in live Home (`digitalmate.task.text` final frames of Bee tasks, event IDs `hive-result-…`) are live-only and disappear on reload. Whether Home should show them at all belongs to the same fix.
- Server-side projection is correct: after a reload, every relay appears once, in position.

### Done when

On a device run, each relay of a finished Bee:
- appears in Home while it is open, within a few seconds of its `hive.beebou.reply` push, as exactly one bubble;
- stays in the same position after a reload;
- leaves no extra live-only bubble.

Device acceptance needs a receipt, so reference this issue with `Refs`, not an auto-close keyword.

Refs #1650 · parent #1665

issue:1709.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] I understand the report needs environment information and a minimal reproduction.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

On HarmonyOS, enable location in 本地能力连接 and grant system access. A current-location card asks for one-time consent repeatedly, while the location receipt and standalone card expose collection time and system-reported accuracy.

Expected: choose approximate or precise access when enabling location and show the effective precision in settings without an additional upgrade row. Reuse an adequate current grant. When a foreground task such as nearby food requires precise location but the effective grant is approximate, ask for permission; if the user accepts and the OS grants it, update the global choice to precise. A refusal keeps approximate access. Respect app opt-out and OS revocation. Show the resolved place without collection time or reported accuracy in either location presentation.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

HarmonyOS DigitalMate client; reported on a phone with location globally authorized. Exact phone and OS versions were not supplied.

### Additional Information

Keep existing calendar behavior, location freshness/accuracy validation, stale-request protection, and task payload format. Verify both precision choices, task-driven escalation and refusal, reuse, revocation, and non-sensitive presentation in an isolated emulator. No cloud change or new manifest permission is intended.

### Version Information

Source checked on `main` at `e5ac5d1588d6f4950be11458d60bbb3a9688a3fa`.

### Screenshots / Recordings

The reporter provided a phone screenshot privately. It includes a real location, so it is not attached to this public issue.

issue:1710.body:
### Problem

The repository's GitHub Actions **artifact storage quota is full**. `architecture-conformance` fails in its "Upload trusted architecture evidence" step (`actions/upload-artifact@v4`, `if-no-files-found: error`):

> Failed to CreateArtifact: Artifact storage quota has been hit. Unable to upload any new artifacts. Usage is recalculated every 6-12 hours.

`gate-report` then fails too, because it reads `GATE_ARCHITECTURE_RESULT=failure`. The conformance scan itself passed; only the upload failed. So every PR is currently red for a reason unrelated to its code.

### Evidence

- PR #1703, run 43843436902: `architecture-conformance` job 133217554857 fails at the upload step, and `gate-report` job 133220344327 fails on the aggregate. #1703 was merged while these two checks were red, which breaks the merge rule (see the note on #1703).
- PR #1705 (#1701) is blocked by the same two checks.
- The #1659 bot review had already flagged that artifact storage usage and quota should be checked.

### Expected

- Short term: free or raise the quota. That needs the repository owner, because deleting old artifacts is an owner action.
- In repo: a quota or upload failure of evidence that no later job consumes should not turn a gate red. Use `continue-on-error` plus a visible warning on the upload, and keep the job's verdict tied to the scan result, as #1656 did for other uploads. If `gate-report` or another job downloads that evidence, record the evidence somewhere it can still be read, for example the job summary, instead.
- Give heavy uploads a short `retention-days`, so the quota doesn't fill up again.

Found while coordinating the post-HIVE lanes. Related: #1659, #1656.

issue:1725.body:
## Problem
#1714 (fix for #1710) added "Warn if upload ... failed" steps to `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (lines ~521, 542, 684, 703 on main) with `shell: pwsh`. The self-hosted runners `dm-hk-ci-03`, `digitalmate-win-st-02` and `digitalmate-win-st-03` have no `pwsh`, so while the Actions artifact quota is hit these steps fail with `pwsh: command not found`. That fails node-ut, hypium-ut and st, then gate-report. The uploads themselves no longer fail the job, but the warning steps do.

Seen on PR #1723 head 6c9792a6; it blocks every open PR until the quota renews.

## Fix
Write the warning steps so they run on every runner (for example bash `echo "::warning ..."` plus `>> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"` on Linux and the shell matching each runner OS), and/or give them `continue-on-error: true` so a warning can never fail a job. If the steps are generated, change the generator, not just ci.yml.

## Done when
On a PR while the quota is still hit, node-ut, hypium-ut, st and gate-report pass, and the warning shows in the job summary.

issue:1726.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

本项跟踪 **Bee `status` 报告已受理，但 Beebou 缺少对应消费轮次，以及未消费报告可能阻塞后续 `done` 的实现缺口**。不以本项直接改变父 RFC 的消息语义。

设计与跟踪关系：

- [#1316](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1316) 是 Project Hive 开发进度、阶段验收与主线集成总单，已关闭；其指向的共享设计来源为 [#1228](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228)，切流后跟踪归 #1665。
- #1228「推理额度（Gap 11）」明确 `status` 每条单独排队；仓库 [Delivery 设计 §report](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/c58b8609afba7c53044341c99dcceac34a889b16/docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-delivery-design.md#report) 及第 586 行进一步规定：每条 status 有自己的轮次、不批量消费，status 轮可以没有用户输出，报告本身不构成新的派单/外部动作授权。
- #1228「用户答复双份知会」的 **`observation`** 是另一种语义：原答复直达 Bee，仅知会不启动 Run，在下个正常轮次进入持久 context 后确认消费。不能将这条要求直接套到全部 `report(status)` 上。
- #1316 的[后续交接](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1316#issuecomment-6888577031)列过“多 Bee 报告合批”待认领细项；这是后续设计方向，不等于已有逐条 status 契约已被替代。

#### 当前 main 的代码事实

核对版本：main [`c58b8609afba7c53044341c99dcceac34a889b16`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/commit/c58b8609afba7c53044341c99dcceac34a889b16)（2026-11-17 本次核对固定到该 SHA；不以本地候选实现代替 main）。

1. **D1 — status 已受理，但没有生产消费路径。** `HiveStore._finish_report` 会保存 `status`，按每任务待处理 4 条、累计 8 条限额受理；但 `claim_beebou_context` 的 source 查询仅允许 `user/done`，`HiveTurnStartup.drain_inbox` 也跳过 `status`。因此只修 `drain_inbox` 的条件还不足以完成修复，需要贯通 Store 认领、执行、持久上下文提交和消费见证。
2. **D2 — status 可以占满调度页，遮住有效 done。** `peek_beebou_inbox` 在无待处理 user 时将 `status/done` 一起按 seq 排序并应用 LIMIT；消费端跳过 status 后，下一次又读取同一页。积压 status 达到页面上限时，后面的已具备合法终态见证的 done 可能持续不可见。该问题与“done 没有唤醒机制”不同：done 已有恢复扫描和终态校验。
3. **已有边界，不应描述成不存在。** 当前有每任务 status 配额及原 ID 去重；`done` 认领要求匹配已提交的 Bee 终态，并让待处理用户消息优先。不能再笼统称“inbox 没有任何 cap”“所有报告走同一唤醒路径”或“done 无法被唤醒”。

源码证据（均固定上述 main SHA）：

- [hive_store.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/c58b8609afba7c53044341c99dcceac34a889b16/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/hive_store.py)：`claim_beebou_context`（1333 行起，1377 行过滤 user/done）、`_finish_report`（status 配额 3681–3687 行）、`peek_beebou_inbox`（3790–3803 行）。
- [hive_turn_startup.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/c58b8609afba7c53044341c99dcceac34a889b16/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/hive_turn_startup.py)：`drain_inbox`（839–866 行，849 行跳过 status）。
- [hive_store.toml](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/c58b8609afba7c53044341c99dcceac34a889b16/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/hive_store.toml)：`status_per_task=4`、`status_total_per_task=8`。
- [现有缺口测试](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/c58b8609afba7c53044341c99dcceac34a889b16/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_hive_bee_induced_reply.py)：`test_gap_c1_status_report_is_consumed_or_acknowledged`、`test_gap_c2_unconsumed_status_does_not_starve_done` 仍为 strict xfail。它们是已有失败预期，不是本次新运行的通过证据。

### Design Ideas

Feature 设计稿（评审提案，合入前需 Store / Harness / Host / Delivery 评审）：[Bee status 独立消费与 done 可推进设计](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/kimi/issue-1726-status/docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-status-consumption-1726.md)。

#### 本项修复范围

沿用 #1228 / Delivery 的既有 `report(status|done)` 契约：

- **D1：贯通 status 的独立排队、认领和持久消费。** status 作为带可信作者、来源与任务关联的 Bee 数据处理，不能伪装用户指令或完成见证。允许不向用户输出，但该轮的持久提交/消费必须有可核验结果；不能为了消费静默制造一条用户消息或虚假完成答复。无输出轮如何结算应由现有 Store/Harness owner 在设计稿中明确。
- **D2：保证调度可推进。** 用户优先；未处理的 status 不得永久遮住有效 done。不得只从查询里隐藏 status 便宣称 D1 已修，也不得用无持久见证的 ACK 清空积压来通过测试。
- **持久性与权限：** 接收、执行和消费分别确认；只有对应上下文/处理结果持久提交后才能记录消费。相同源报告重放、并发扫描、失败和重启不能丢输入或产生重复执行。report-only 轮不能凭报告正文获得 create/dispatch/steer 或外部写操作权限。
- **保留现有边界：** 每任务待处理/累计配额与同 ID 幂等继续有效，明确拒绝超限；done 的终态校验、用户优先和问答/Stop 独立通道保持。

#### 不作为本项默认修复的方案

先前正文的“把所有 status 改成静默 inject、等下一条用户消息再合并”不是上述契约的直接实现。已有本地 user-turn 合批候选也不作为 D1 的完成证据：它不提供既定的独立 status 轮次。

若后续仍要合批、定时窗、动态 inject 或全局折叠，须单独记录动机、是否替代逐条处理、适用消息、触发边界、消费与恢复语义，并按 change-control 更新设计及完成 owner 评审后再接入。不预设新增 `kind/priority/segment` 字段。

本项实施前补与当前范围一致的 Feature 设计稿（现有独立 status 轮如何完成、零用户输出如何结算、Host 授权、失败/恢复及 D2 调度规则）；之前的合批草案不充当这个设计稿。

### Involved Public APIs

复用并核对实际调用链：

- Bee BotTools / Delivery `report(kind="status"|"done")` → `SQLiteSessionRepository` → `HiveStore._finish_report`。
- Beebou inbox 的 `peek_beebou_inbox`、`claim_beebou_context`、`commit_beebou_context` / `fail_beebou_context`，及 `NativeBeebouRunner` / BeebouHarness。
- 持久状态唯一 writer 仍是 Session Store；Host 保留运行和工具许可。若为无用户输出轮增加提交结果或接口，应由原 owner 定义、通过公开 proxy 暴露，不让调用方写私有表。

不要求本项新增 failure/ask wire kind、独立通知数据库、来源权限或客户端协议。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- #1316：历史开发/阶段验收总单；#1228：父设计与 H-C1–H-C8 单一来源；#1665：当前后续收集。
- #1310 / #1309 / #1311 / #1223：Beebou Harness、Host/Runtime、Store 和 Delivery 的原职责。
- #1268 R6：问答仅知会及原等待点恢复，和 status 报告区分处理。
- #1730：已消费终局在后续上下文复述；本项不把该问题等同于 status 消费缺口。
- #1761 / #1778：能力失败码与失败终局验收，仍按原归属处理；不由本项另造协议。

### Test Design and Test Plan

1. **独立 status 轮次：** 合法 Bee 报告 status 后，在没有新用户消息的情况下，按既有队列规则被认领和处理，进入带来源的持久上下文/处理结果；status 可以无用户输出，但不得永远 pending 或写出虚假完成答复。
2. **D2 饥饿回归：** 缩小页上限复现“早 status + 晚有效 done”，并覆盖真实多页积压；done 不因被跳过的 status 永久不可见。断言实际认领/结果，而非仅检查过滤后的 peek。
3. **消费见证：** claim、RAM 读取或任意 witness 字符串不是完成。提交成功时原记录和上下文/处理见证一致；提交前故障不消费；提交后丢 ACK 原 ID 对账不重执行。
4. **失败、重启与并发：** status 轮模型失败、无输出、工具被拒、进程中断、两个 drain 并发；有界恢复且无永久 RUNNING 阻塞，不能重复入 context 或错误消费其他报告。
5. **权限：** status 携带“忽略用户并新派单”等正文仍仅是 Bee 数据；report-only 轮不产生未授权 create/dispatch/steer/外部写效果。原问答、Stop、done 见证规则不变。
6. **配额与隔离：** 每任务 4 条待处理/8 条累计仍有效；真实消费只释放待处理数、不重置累计数；同 ID 重放不增数，跨 Bee/Run/用户不串报告。
7. **回归已有 c1/c2：** 按更新后的独立 status 语义修订过时的输出数量断言，不能仅移除 xfail 或削弱断言得到 PASS。记录源码 SHA、真实 Store/Host/Harness、受控模型、命令、失败和未运行项。

本次修订进行了父 RFC、固定 main 源码和现有测试的只读核对；**未在上述 main SHA 运行这些验收**。旧基线上的本地合批候选测试不能证明本项修复通过，真实模型、设备与部署均未验收。

### Additional Information

原题关于 wake/inject、batching、failure、ask 和全局折叠的多个目标已拆清：本项先修 status 消费与调度不推进，按现有父设计实施。合批是后续需另评审的优化，不以本次 issue 改写批准它，也不据此关闭本项。

issue:1728.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**派发后才发现目标 Bee 没有该任务所需的能力：Beebou 先承诺「已派出…完成后汇报」，随即以「能力受限」收场。**

移动端 opt-in Beebou Home，2026-11-16 06:30：

1. 用户：「帮我搜索nba的赛果」
2. Beebou 快回复：「我已经派出 **NBA赛果搜索助手** 去搜索最新的 NBA 比赛赛果。任务已受理并进入队列，完成后我会把结果汇报给你。」
3. 同一会话紧接着：「抱歉，我暂时无法完成这次 NBA 赛果的实时检索。原因：当前会话的搜索/网页访问能力处于受限状态（仅能进行对话确认），我无法联网获取 2026-11-16 前后的真实比赛数据。为避免提供不准确的信息，我不会凭记忆编造比赛对阵与比分。」

**这不是「搜索结果不对」，而是根本没有执行搜索**，也没有任何来源可对账：

- `engine_execution_policy.py` 的 `before_model_call` 检查本次 model call 的工具集，缺失 `web_search` 时注入 priority 19 的 `digitalmate_current_web_tools` 段：「web search is not configured in this model call … say that web search is not set up … instead of fetching guessed URLs or giving unverified facts」。上面第 3 段正是这条策略要求的诚实降级，不是模型幻觉。
- Bee 侧没有任何搜索能力：在 `temp/hive-runtime`、`temp/hive-worker`、`temp/hive-beebou` 全量检索 `web_search` / `fetch_webpage` **零命中**；Host 也没有给这只 Bee 授权搜索工具（#1646 按需发现工具尚未落地）。
- 派发侧没有能力预检：`dm_hive_beebou/selection.py` 的 dispatch 只校验 identity / roster / task_ref；`dm_beebou/tools/providers.py` 的 `dispatch_schema()` 字段只有 `id` / `mode` / `text` / `task_ref` / `source_ids`，**没有任何能力声明或核对**。

四个缺陷：

1. **派发即承诺**：Bee 还没有任何执行结果，快回复就断言「完成后我会把结果汇报给你」，失败后这句仍在会话里，无法撤回。
2. **能力与任务不匹配仍派发**：应在 dispatch 前比对「任务所需能力」与「该 Bee 的 tool grant」，缺能力则不派发。
3. **失败无结构化归因**：终局只有自由文本「能力受限」，没有 `capability_unavailable:web_search` 这类 failure code，客户端无法一键引导，也无法统计。
4. **结果无来源可对账**：没有 citations / `message_id` 可回溯，「结果对不对」无法被复现判定——这是用户感知为「搜索结果不对」的直接原因。

期望：dispatch 前做能力预检并拒绝派发；快回复只陈述可验证状态并绑定 `task_ref`，不预示结果；失败终局携带 failure code 与建议动作；结果必须带来源。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 服务端：`openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate` main 分支，本地 clone `6fc4202b02a2e76e397e98f700e7eaccb8608108`（2026-11-16），Hive 切流后版本。
- 客户端：移动端 App（Home / opt-in Beebou Home），截图分辨率 1080×2337；具体 build 号未采集，需从客户端「关于」页补齐。
- 后端：Bridge 进程（`engine_cli serve`）+ owned Bee runtime 子进程（`workswarm_launcher --bee-runtime`，端口 19100/19101/19102）。
- Bee 侧工具授权：未授权 `web_search` / `fetch_webpage`。

### Additional Information

- 父收集：#1665
- 能力预检的统一契约：#1761
- 工具授权：#1646
- 快回复措辞的历史修复：#1537（已关闭）、#1660（已关闭）——若本图发生在合并之后，则属于回归证据
- 附件侧的同类问题：#1760、#1762
- 非目标：不改 WorkSwarm 内部执行；不改 Bee 的记忆与 profile。

### Version Information

- 仓库 HEAD：`6fc4202b02a2e76e397e98f700e7eaccb8608108`（main）
- 客户端版本：未采集（待补）
- 复现时间：2026-11-16 06:30（Asia/Shanghai）

### Screenshots / Recordings

![同一会话：先承诺已派出，随后以“能力受限”收场](https://aka.doubaocdn.com/s/ICMmlfo4q6)


## 范围拆分与关闭交接
按维护者确认，产品搜索执行恢复由已合并 #1753 承接；其余引用溯源、能力预检、快回复和结构化终局验收移交 #1778（已关联 #1665）。关闭本 issue 不表示这些余项已完成。

issue:1730.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**上一轮已经答过的 Bee 失败终局，在下一轮（话题完全无关）被再次投影出来。**

同一设备、同一个 Home 会话，相隔一小时：

- 06:30：用户「帮我搜索nba的赛果」→ Beebou 先承诺「已派出 NBA赛果搜索助手…完成后我会把结果汇报给你」→ 随后「抱歉，我暂时无法完成这次 NBA 赛果的实时检索…搜索/网页访问能力受限…需要我在权限恢复后立即为你查询最新赛果吗？」
- 07:30：用户「你好」→ Beebou 正常问候「你好呀～我在的。有什么需要帮忙的尽管说…」→ **紧接着又出现 06:30 那段一模一样的 NBA 失败说明**，结尾仍在追问「需要我在权限恢复后立即为你查询最新赛果吗？」

即：失败本身上一轮已发生并已告知用户，第二次出现说明**终局事件没有被"一次性消费"语义约束**，在新 turn 里被当成仍待处理的事务重新作答。

代码依据：

1. **Bee 终局以普通 context message 永久落库**：`server_engine/session_proximity/hive_store.py` 的 `bee_event_message()` 把每个已提交的 Bee 终局写成 `role: "user"` 的 data message，附 `metadata: {hive_origin: "bee", hive_event: "bee_done", hive_source_seq: N}`。它不会因为这终局已被回复过而被移除或标记。
2. **只有"最后一条"才被认作 Bee 触发**：`dm_hive_beebou/harness/normal.py::_committed_bee_done_text()` 仅在 `messages[-1]` 是该终局时判定为 bee-induced turn。用户先说「你好」之后，终局不再是最后一条——既不触发 Bee lane，也不再被识别为已消费，只是作为历史留在上下文里。
3. **没有 per-event 的 answered / closed 状态**：写入侧只有 `hive_source_seq` 用于去重（防同一 seq 重复追加），但没有任何字段表示"这条终局已经向用户回复过"。
4. **模型会顺着它作答**：终局本身就是一段以「…需要我在权限恢复后立即为你查询最新赛果吗？」结尾、且以 `role: user` 出现的文本；下一轮即使锚点是「你好」，上下文里仍有一段未闭合的"用户请求 + 失败说明"，模型容易重新叙述一遍并复读追问。

待判定的两条路径（需要证据二选一，修法不同）：

- **A. 重复投递**：同一 `source_seq` 的终局被 Store 追加了第二次（或上次 claim 未消化又被 claim）。判据：该会话是否出现两条指向同一 run/终局的 `hive_source_seq`。
- **B. 上下文重投影**：只有一条终局，但后续 turn 把它当未完成事务重答。判据：`bee_done` 的 `source_seq` 唯一，且第二条气泡没有对应审计事件。

期望：终局投递一次性生效，重复 claim 拒绝并留审计；终局被回复后标记 `answered`（或在 context 中降级为已关闭历史），后续 turn 不得复述或再次追问；用户发无关新消息时锚点必须是新消息本身；终局关闭状态持久化，跨重启/切设备成立。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 服务端：`openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate` main 分支，本地 clone `6fc4202b02a2e76e397e98f700e7eaccb8608108`（2026-11-16）。
- 客户端：移动端 App（Home / opt-in Beebou Home），截图 1080×2337；具体 build 号未采集。
- 模型侧：Beebou normal turn 与 quick reply 均在 Bridge 进程内（`hive_turn_startup.py`），Bee 在 owned launcher 子进程的 Session 内。

### Additional Information

- 父收集：#1665
- 上一轮的失败案例：#1728
- 终局分级与一次性消费：#1726
- 相邻症状：#1650（done-triggered turn 未投影，assignee Jianyu010）、#1708（实时不渲染）、#1678（failed 终局被客户端丢弃）；这三条方向是"该显示没显示"，本条是"多显示了一次"
- 客户端残留状态的相似体感：#1408（重开页面残留"进行中"提示，assignee huben0423-hw）
- 若最终判定为客户端残留（#1408 路径），本条应转为 #1408 的证据补充，不另修
- 非目标：不涉及搜索能力本身（#1728）

### Version Information

- 仓库 HEAD：`6fc4202b02a2e76e397e98f700e7eaccb8608108`（main）
- 客户端版本：未采集（待补）
- 复现时间：2026-11-16 06:30 与 07:30（Asia/Shanghai）

### Screenshots / Recordings

06:30 首次失败：

![06:30 首次失败](https://aka.doubaocdn.com/s/ICMmlfo4q6)

07:30「你好」之后同一段失败说明再次出现：

![07:30 同一段失败说明再次出现](https://aka.doubaocdn.com/s/fT6vyUGVbm)

issue:1735.body:
## 概述

本 issue 汇总 DigitalMate 手机端当前发现的两个独立缺陷，合并为一张给开发的工单清单，按修复优先级排列。两项均为用户实测反馈，附截图为证。

| 编号 | 问题 | 类型 | 修复优先级 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| BUG-1 | 设备定位已获取但未注入模型上下文，导致「我在哪」误判城市 | 数据链路 / 正确性 | P1（高） |
| BUG-2 | 手机日历读取提示「云端尚未升级，手机日历读取暂不可用」，功能整体不可用 | 能力可用性 / 版本依赖 | P2（中） |

---

## BUG-1　定位已获取但未注入模型上下文（P1）

### 现象
用户在 App 内提问「我在哪」，底部「设备位置」卡片已成功返回真实定位（广东省 深圳市 附近），但对话模型回复称「无法直接读取你设备的实时定位」，并仅依据时区和一个提到虹桥机场的旧待办，推断用户在上海。真实位置为深圳，答复为上海，结论相反。

### 复现步骤
1. 在已授予定位权限的设备上打开 DigitalMate 对话；
2. 触发一次定位采集，确认底部「设备位置」卡片正常显示定位；
3. 在同一会话中向模型提问「我在哪」；
4. 观察回复：模型表示读不到实时定位，并给出与卡片不一致的城市。

### 原因（排查方向）
1. 数据未注入上下文（最可能）：定位结果停留在 UI/展示层，未随对话请求一起传入模型上下文。
2. 取数工具/链路未打通：模型侧缺少「读取当前定位」的可调用能力，或「权限已授予」与「实际取数并传值给模型」是两条未连通的链路。
3. 提示词缺字段：系统提示未提供 location 字段，或未要求模型优先使用该字段。
4. 时区被误当位置：模型把 Asia/Shanghai 时区当作城市证据，缺少「时区不能判定城市」的约束。

### 修复建议
1. 每次对话请求显式注入设备位置字段（如 location: {name, lat, lng, source, accuracy, collected_at, tz}），并在系统提示中要求：有该字段时优先使用，读不到时再询问用户。
2. 提供/打通「获取当前定位」的工具调用，确认「权限授予 → 定位采集 → 值传入模型」为同一条链路（权限开 ≠ 值已送达）。
3. 增加反例约束：明确告知模型「时区不能用于判定城市；历史待办中的地点不代表当前所在地」。
4. 坐标统一：WGS84 在国内地图展示前需转 GCJ-02，否则存在数百米至公里级偏移。
5. 精度提示：约 5000 米属基站/WiFi 粗定位，文案只应表述到「深圳市附近」级别，不得承诺门牌级地址。

### 优先级理由
P1：数据本已成功获取却丢失，导致直接输出与事实相反的城市，属功能正确性与可信度问题，且修复路径明确（注入字段即可），应优先处理。

### 截图
![定位问题截图](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-screenshots/issue-assets/dm-location-not-injected.jpg?raw=true)

- 卡片：大致位置「广东省 深圳市 附近」/ 来源「本机定位(WGS84)」/ 采集时间 2026-11-16 19:40:33 UTC+08:00 / 精度约 5000 米。
- 模型回复：「我无法直接读取你设备的实时定位……你现在应该在 上海。」

---

## BUG-2　手机日历读取提示「云端尚未升级，手机日历读取暂不可用」（P2）

### 现象
用户在 DigitalMate 对话页发起涉及读取手机日历的操作时，底部输入框上方弹出提示条「云端尚未升级，手机日历读取暂不可用」，日历读取功能无法使用。该提示为能力受限提示，不是崩溃或报错。

### 复现步骤
1. 在已登录的 DigitalMate 手机端打开对话页；
2. 触发任意需要读取手机日历的操作（如让助手查看/引用手机日历中的日程）；
3. 观察底部输入框上方弹出提示条：「云端尚未升级，手机日历读取暂不可用」；
4. 日历内容无法被读取，相关功能不可用。

### 原因（排查方向）
1. 云端服务版本未就绪（最可能，文案已直接点明）：手机端日历读取依赖云端能力，当前云端未升级到含该能力的版本。
2. 功能开关/灰度未开启：日历读取的开关、白名单或灰度配置未对该用户/环境打开。
3. 接口未上线或契约不匹配：手机端已调用日历读取接口，但云端接口尚未提供或版本不兼容。
4. 版本联动检查缺失：缺少升级引导或降级兜底，用户只看到「暂不可用」而无从操作。

### 修复建议
1. 核对并推动云端升级到支持日历读取的版本，确认对应接口已上线且与手机端契约一致。
2. 检查日历读取的功能开关/灰度名单，确认目标用户与环境已开启。
3. 增加版本联动与兜底：云端版本不足时给出明确引导（如「请升级到 X 版本后使用」），或在入口处提前置灰说明，避免操作后被动拦截。
4. 优化提示文案与埋点：区分「云端未升级 / 未授权 / 接口异常」等原因并上报埋点，便于统计影响范围。
5. 如可，评估本地直读日历（不依赖云端）的降级方案作为兜底。

### 优先级理由
P2：功能整体不可用，但提示已明确、原因已知（依赖云端升级），属于发布/运维依赖项，需按云端升级排期推进；相较 BUG-1 的正确性误导，可稍后处理。

### 截图
![日历读取不可用截图](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-screenshots/issue-assets/dm-calendar-cloud-unavailable.png?raw=true)

- 红圈/红箭头指向输入框上方提示条：「云端尚未升级，手机日历读取暂不可用」。

---

## 环境信息
- 端：DigitalMate 手机端（Android，包名 com.jiuwen.digitalmate），界面时间为设备本地时间（Asia/Shanghai）。
- 截图采集：2026-11-16 19:40–19:46（UTC+08:00）。
- 定位来源：本机定位 WGS84，精度约 5000 米。

## 说明
两项为彼此独立的问题：BUG-1 属「数据未注入模型上下文」的数据链路缺陷；BUG-2 属「云端版本未跟上导致日历读取被关闭」的能力可用性问题。

issue:1738.body:
### Context

邮件邀约流程中的第二张卡片「请选择选题方向」。



### Test Environment

- 源码基线：03e94a347
- 验证提交：ba6a0bb98
- 构建环境：Windows、DevEco Studio
- 设备：Pura 80 Pro 模拟器
- 系统：HarmonyOS 6.1.0（API 23）


### Problem Description & Suggestions

当前卡片与 UCD 存在以下差异：

1. 三个选题方向之后还展示多选和“补充你的想法”输入区域。
2. 选项圆角和选中样式不符合设计要求。
3. 选中对勾占据文字布局空间，导致文字宽度和换行变化。
4. 标题与正文之间留白过大，正文行高和段间距与设计不一致。

期望行为：

- 正面只保留最初三个选题方向和“确定方向”按钮，移除后续多选及补充入口。
- 选项使用 8 vp 圆角；选中后显示橙色描边、浅黄色背景和右上角对勾。
- 对勾独立叠加，切换选中状态时不改变文字位置和换行。
- 标题与正文间距为 6 vp，正文行高为 20 vp，正文到选项间距为 12 vp。
- 正文高度随行数自然增长，三行正文不应发生裁切、重叠或间距压缩。


### Additional Information (optional)

设计依据：《邮件正反面卡片+交互规则》中的选题确认画板

issue:1741.body:
### Checklist
- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] 已附上复现步骤与界面证据（截图由反馈者在群内提供，见下方「截图」小节）；客户端代码路径可直接定位。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

用户在对话里**明确要求写入日历**时，手机端仍要求再点一次「添加到本机日历？」确认卡片，写入不是直接发生。

复现的原话（截图中的用户气泡）：

> 帮忙在日历中写入明天下午三点泡茶

随后出现的不是直接的写入回执，而是 `LocalCalendarProposalCard` 的确认卡片（标题「Beebou 想问你」/正文「添加到本机日历？」/按钮「不添加」「添加到本机日历」）。用户点击「添加到本机日历」之后才产生回执卡片：

```
日历回执                  已回执
本机日历操作结果
已添加到本机日历
```

即：用户指令本身已经表达了写入意图，端侧却又要求一次授权点击，属于重复确认。

**期望行为**：用户当前这一轮消息里明确说了「在日历中写入/加到日历/记到日程」等写入指令时，手机端应直接执行该次写入并给出「日历回执」，不再弹出确认卡片；系统日历权限在未授权时仍按系统要求申请，权限被拒、写入失败、结果不确定或与已有日程时间冲突时，仍交回确认卡片让用户处理。

**当前行为**：无论用户说得多明确，云端下发 `device_calendar_event` 提案后，手机端一律渲染确认卡片并等待一次点击。

**代码路径**（基线 `main@03e94a34`）：

1. 云端 `interaction_gateway.py` 产出 `ask_user` + `inputs:[{type:"device_calendar_event"}]` 的提案。
2. 手机端 `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets`：`PendingInteractionBody` 只要看到 `deviceCalendarEvent` 就渲染 `LocalCalendarProposalCard`，只有用户点击「添加到本机日历」才会调用 `saveLocalCalendarEvent`。
3. `LocalCalendarProposalCard.saveEvent()` 内部已有完整的冲突检查、权限检查、回执日志与去重逻辑，确认卡片是唯一的人为入口。

**修复方向**：由手机端用自己的那份用户消息判断「这一轮是否明确要求写入日历」（不依赖云端对提案的声明）：明确指令时卡片自启动一次 `saveEvent()`（复用既有冲突/权限/去重路径），不明确时维持现状。实现与验证见关联 PR。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 设备：HarmonyOS 手机端（反馈者真机；同一流程在 20010 测试环境镜像上也可复现）
- 应用：DigitalMate 手机端，20010 测试环境镜像 v0.1.12（`release_v0.1.12@997c88ce` + 20010 overlay）
- 云端：`onlineswarm.openjiuwen.com:20010`（agent_bridge，`main@03e94a34` 同源逻辑）
- 登录态：已登录、已授予本机日历全部日程权限；「本地能力连接 → 日历」为已授权（全部日程）

### Additional Information

- 相关代码：`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets`、`LocalCalendarProposalCard.ets`、`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/model/LocalCalendarWriter.ets`
- 设计约束：端侧仍保留全部安全边界——写入前冲突二次确认、`calendar-receipt-v1` 回执、结果不确定时不重复写入、账号/请求/草稿三重作用域的去重日志都保持不变；只有「用户本轮消息已明确要求写入」这一种情况跳过那次多余点击。
- 关联：#978（读取手机日历并在对话中展示来源）、#1190（读取设备日历并确认聊天日程）、#1308。

### Version Information

- 客户端：DigitalMate 手机端 20010 镜像 v0.1.12；代码基线 `openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate main@03e94a34`
- 云端：agent_bridge（20010 镜像），与 `main@03e94a34` 的 `server_engine/interaction_gateway.py` 行为一致

### Screenshots / Recordings

反馈截图（群内提供，未随 issue 上传）：上方为用户气泡「帮忙在日历中写入明天下午三点泡茶」，下方为「日历回执 / 已回执 / 本机日历操作结果 / 已添加到本机日历」卡片。二者之间手机端额外要求点击「添加到本机日历」确认卡片。修复 PR 会补充端侧自动化用例覆盖「明确指令直接写入」与「冲突仍需确认」两条路径。

issue:1744.body:
### Background and Goal Description

Hive (#1316) is on `main`, so DigitalMate now has a main bot (Beebou) that dispatches worker bots (Bees). The next question is how a third-party event starts work without the user typing anything.

Reference scenario: the user receives an email asking for a slide deck, with materials attached. The mailbox is connected to DigitalMate. DigitalMate sees the email, builds the deck and tells the user it is ready.

The current system cannot do this:

- **Plugin Gateway is one-directional.** Its only entry is Host → `dispatch(call)`. A plugin cannot start a conversation with Agent Service, and an unsolicited event has no Run to correlate to.
- **Registry only knows Run-consumed kinds.** `Kind = Literal["core", "model", "tool", "skill"]`. Nothing registers an implementation that runs outside a Run.
- **The mail pipeline stops before the model.** Receiver staging and the Signal pipeline exist, but accepted mail is explicitly not model or report authority.
- **Proactivity does not exist in DigitalMate.** #998 is a design only.

This RFC supersedes #998. It keeps that RFC's candidate, evidence and idempotency ideas, and replaces its entry path (host adapter → Router → new Session) and its naming (Commander) with the wiring below. #999 (Memory) is not affected.

### Proposed Solution

Design draft: `docs/architecture/server-plugin-trigger-proactivity-v1.md` and scenario `docs/scenarios/server-plugin-trigger-v3.1.md` (draft PR to follow on this issue).

1. **Proactivity is a third-party app that we build.** It lives outside Agent Service, owns its rules, candidates and cursors, and reaches DigitalMate only through Plugin Gateway.
2. **Plugin Gateway gains an inbound surface, `plugin_trigger`.** It authenticates the calling app, checks its registration and forwards one trigger for admission. It never holds a Run capability.
3. **Registry gains a trigger mode.** This submodule records which exact app versions may trigger, which bot they may target and under which user grant. Registry still owns no session or bot state.
4. **A trigger is admitted directly as a Beebou turn.** Session Manager and Store admit it with its own idempotency key. It does not wait in Beebou's lazily read notice inbox, and it runs with quick reply and second quick reply off.
5. **The only acknowledgement is the admission receipt.** Plugin Gateway returns "received" to the app. Nothing is sent to the email sender.
6. **Execution is unchanged Hive.** Beebou dispatches or steers a Bee. The Bee reads the mail and attachments through `tools.call` under current permission and registers the deck as an artifact. The result reaches the user through Host output and Mobile Gateway.

Decisions left for the developer and ADRs are listed in the design draft, section 8.

### Involved Public APIs

- **Plugin Gateway:** new inbound operation `plugin_trigger`; new granted event subscription for apps (proposed).
- **Registry:** new trigger-mode registration and lookup beside the existing four kinds.
- **Session Manager / Store:** trigger admission, trigger-ID replay, and work-key occupancy.
- **Beebou Harness:** a trigger turn kind with quick replies disabled.
- **Mobile Gateway / client:** projection of work that started from a trigger.

No existing operation changes meaning. All of the above are additions.

### Test Verification

Scenario DM-SC-009 in the scenario draft defines the cases. In short:

- The same trigger ID sent twice returns the original receipt and one Run.
- An unregistered app version, a revoked grant or a wrong target is refused before admission.
- A trigger turn publishes no quick reply.
- A trigger that arrives while Beebou is mid-turn runs next and is not lost.
- A follow-up email in the same thread steers the original task.
- Revoking the mail connection stops the Bee's reads; email content cannot widen the Bee's permissions.
- End to end with a real mailbox: email in, deck artifact out, user notified, nothing sent to the sender.

All cases are NOT_RUN. Nothing is implemented.

### Additional Supplementary Information

Supersedes #998. Related: #1316 (Hive), #737 (v3.1 migration), #1207 and #1192 (mail Signal pipeline and receiver), #1176 (connection foundation).

### Before submitting a new issue

- [x] Please confirm that you have searched the previous RFC documents

issue:1747.body:
## 问题描述
手动断开云端连接后重新连接，“云端连接”页显示“云端账号已连接”，但对话页仍在连接中，用户反馈实际未连接成功，页面状态与实际可用状态不一致。

## 复现步骤
1. 进入 APP 的“云端连接”页面。
2. 点击“断开云端连接”。
3. 点击“重新连接”。
4. 查看云端连接页面，再返回对话页面检查状态。

## 实际结果
- 截图一：云端连接页显示“云端账号已连接”，有效期至 11/23/2026。
- 截图二：对话页显示“Beebou 正在连接…”、“连接较慢，仍在努力连接中…”、“正在连接”；输入框显示“连接中，消息将稍后发送…”。
- 实际未连接成功，用户无法正常使用云端对话。

## 预期结果
- 两个页面应准确反映云端实际连接状态；重连成功后恢复正常对话。
- 如“云端账号已连接”仅代表授权有效，应明确区分账号授权状态与云端服务连接状态，避免误导。
- 尚未连接成功或连接失败时，显示准确状态及重试提示。

## 环境与证据
- 鸿蒙手机真机，发现日期：2026-11-16。
- 本次构建上下文：v0.1.12；云侧配置 `wss://onlineswarm.openjiuwen.com:20005/digitalmate/ws`（截图未展示版本号，待核实）。
- 依据：用户提供的两张真机截图及操作说明。尚未采集端云日志，根因待定位，不预设为云侧故障。

issue:1749.body:
## 背景与拆分

父收集：#1665。按本次工具范围评审，将工作拆为两个独立 Issue / PR：
- **#1728 优先恢复普通 Bee 的产品搜索链路**，复用 digitalmate 搜索，验证实际搜索及来源返回。本议题不扩大或替代其原有缺陷记录。
- **本 Issue 接入其余已确认保留的 Bee 工具能力**，单独 PR，不把全部能力恢复作为搜索修复前置。

这是目标范围，不表示以下工具已在 Bee 注册、通过 Host 或验证可用。v0.1.12 只作为兼容能力参考；配置名、MCP 别名和实际运行时工具不能混为一谈。

## 计划保留 / 接入

| 类别 | 工具或能力 | 边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 文件读取 | read、read_file、ls、glob、grep、read_pdf | 共享沙箱内当前任务获授权的工作区和输入，按实际注册归一别名 |
| 文件修改 | write、write_file、edit_file、search_replace | 共享沙箱内当前任务获授权的工作区；不改产品权限、凭据或未授权资源 |
| 开发执行 | bash、powershell、mcp_exec_command、create_terminal | 复用 Beebou 与 Bee 共用的云端沙箱及现有执行器；按任务授权限制路径、凭据和网络，不以字符串路径检查冒充隔离 |
| 询问 | ask_user | 保留 Host 问题/答复与原等待点通道 |
| 任务内规划 | todo_create、todo_list、todo_get、todo_modify | Bee 私有任务计划；旧配置 todo_insert/complete/remove 不另造工具，按实际实现归一 |
| 技能 | skill_tool、search_skill、install_skill、uninstall_skill | Bee 私有技能作用域；内置技能不可卸载；安装技能不扩展凭据或工具授权 |
| 产品记忆 / 历史读取 | native_search_memory、native_read_memory、native_search_conversations | 产品 API 接入，room/task/owner scope 与来源权限；保留独立 Local Memory 与获授权 Global Memory 生命周期 |
| 天气 | native_weather 及对应 mcp_digitalmate-search_native_weather 注册名 | 产品只读能力；独立于 #1728 的优先搜索恢复，避免遗漏 |
| 历史与文件交付 | 受授权历史读取、Host 产物交付 | 保留用户可读取历史、获取生成文件的能力；不直接开放旧跨会话或任意目标发送路径 |

## 明确排除

- 旧 WorkSwarm memory：write_memory、edit_memory、read_memory、memory_search、memory_get、coding_memory_write/edit/read、ltm_search/ltm_search_summary、mem0_profile/search/conclude、viking_search/read/browse/remember/add_resource，以及旧自动记忆/跨会话提取。禁止旧路径不删除已有数据，不关闭产品 EngineMemory / Local / Global Memory 链路；旧库独有数据应先盘点，迁移另由 owner 管理。
- 全部 Bee 调度工具：所有 cron_* 和 native_schedule，包括查询、创建、更新、删除、启停、预览；不影响 Host 内部超时、等待、恢复。
- 非批准搜索入口保持禁止：web_search、free_search、web_free_search、web_fetch_webpage、mcp_free_search、mcp_fetch_webpage、fetch_webpage，以及付费搜索别名。产品搜索内部复用 FreeSearch 不等于开放旧工具入口；搜索具体接入由 #1728 承担。
- 六个旧 session_*（session_list/read/send_message/message_list/continue_queued/message_resolve）及 acp_chat 不直接开放；send_file_to_user 的用户交付能力通过 Host 承接，不泛开放任意路径/目标。
- 多模态生成/理解工具和全部小艺手机工具不开放；read_pdf 文本读取仍在保留范围。

## 架构约束

遵循 #1228 / #1316：Beebou 与所有 Bee 在同一云端沙箱运行，不要求为每只 Bee 或每个 Session 新建沙箱或文件系统。复用仓库 WorkSwarm 的原生工具和现有执行器；Session 负责绑定 Bee、任务和执行状态，文件系统共享不等于授权跨任务或跨主体访问。

#1749 计划保留的工具默认纳入 Bee 的能力配置，实际能力仍为模板、绑定能力、当前授权的交集；执行前封存工具选择，Host 每次复核 scope、撤权、Stop 与运行状态。不得关掉整个 Host rail、全局开启 trial 或把旧版 allow 表直接作为授权源。带副作用的调用保留 journal / owner / 未知结果对账，不重复执行。

工具曝光与实际准入应一致。shell、文件写、技能安装不得绕过旧 memory、调度、跨主体资源和禁用外部能力。无法证明安全接入的项要明确标阻塞，不将拒绝测试描述为已经安全开放。

## 与已有工作关系

- #1728：优先产品搜索恢复，独立 PR；共有 Host/MCP 改动需协调，不重复实现。
- #1646 / #1731：工具发现试点，不替代本 Issue 的实际工具执行接入。
- #1647 / #999：Memory 分层、来源、迁移的 owner；本 Issue 仅接已有授权读取接口，不另造记忆库或摄取写入方。
- #1242 / #1640：产物归属、交付和报告工作流；复用现有 owner，不另建输出链或扩展 report Bee 权限。

## 验收与交付

- [ ] PR 附每工具一行的清单：实际注册名、计划/当前状态、Host 执行映射、授权与平台条件、测试证据、未完成项。静态名称记录不等于运行时工具总数。
- [ ] 保留工具经真实支持的 Bee → Host 路径执行成功，而非只验证配置 allow 或名字存在。
- [ ] 共享沙箱内授权工作区及输入可访问；未授权的跨 Bee/room/task 资源、越权路径、撤权/Stop、隐藏工具直接调用和别名绕过均有负例；不要求每 Bee 独立沙箱或独立文件系统。
- [ ] shell/技能安装不能绕过禁 memory、调度及外部能力；自有 memory 正常读取且无双写、无主从私有记忆自动合并。
- [ ] 历史读取和生成文件到用户可下载的端到端验证通过。
- [ ] 适用测试与架构检查执行，逐项记录真实/替代参与方、跳过和环境限制。

本 Issue 的创建仅完成范围拆分，不声称代码已实现或环境已部署。后续独立 Draft PR，不自动合入或部署。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

测试账号的免费积分已耗尽，BeeBou Home 仍显示通用失败提示，并建议重新发送或说「重试」。提示里没有失败原因，也没有额度恢复时间。

**复现步骤**

1. 使用日额度为 30 积分的测试账号，将余额用到 0。确认管理台显示「额度已耗尽」，且返回该账号的重置时间。
