issue:1863.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

1. 使用合成日程复现。给明天新增「开会」或「练字」，发送「删除明天开会的日程」，再到系统日历核对。真机反馈称日程已删除，对话却显示「你取消了这次操作，日程仍保留在原处」。已有真机截图缺少同一条日程的删除前后记录。对话应区分已删除、未执行和待核对。
2. 在同一会话先问天气，再发送「查询明天的日程」，打开「实时活动 → 最近话题」。反馈截图中的标题仍包含「天气查询」和缺少城市的描述。该处应展示实际日程请求的标题。
3. 为目标日期和隔天各准备合成日程，发送「删除明天所有的日程」或「删除the day after tomorrow所有的日程」。出现过日历读取卡或让用户选择日程的步骤。云端应下发明确的单日批量操作，端侧在授权有效时直接执行。
4. 点名删除「明天锻炼的日程」时，等待确认期间会短暂闪现回执。读取、新增、修改和删除的日历回执卡均应隐藏，最终结果使用对话文字展示。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

2026-11-17 15:29–15:38（UTC+08:00），HarmonyOS 真机 JUY-AL50，Beebou 对话与实时活动，本机系统日历，连接 20010。

### Version Information

DigitalMate 0.1.0（10006），初始反馈的安装包对应已合入的 #1780。

### Screenshots / Recordings

20010 模拟器的合成日程交易。截图仅截取点名删除请求和最终对话。

![点名删除合成日程的对话结果](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/cefbb661a8634dbf0238ee1f8db87859cb569dac/.github/issue-assets/calendar-command-results/20010-named-delete.png)

### Additional Information

相关 #1852、#1853、#1854。天气相关文字来自托管会话标题，截图无法确认该轮执行了天气查询。

补充需求是支持「每周一到周五早上新增晨会」。云端在未提供具体时刻时先澄清，再下发星期和首次日期，端侧写入一个本机重复日程。协议和验收范围见 [设计说明](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/cefbb661a8634dbf0238ee1f8db87859cb569dac/temp/phone-calendar-commands/README.md)。

issue:1867.body:
### Checklist

- [x] 已检索相关 Issue；#1212 涉及忙运行时释放和队列超时，但未覆盖本次 OOM 重启后 Task/turn/runtime 状态分裂。
- [ ] 最新版本是否已修复：尚未完成同版本镜像与受控沙箱复验。
- [x] 已提供环境、受控复现步骤与脱敏视觉证据；原始用户图片和聊天内容不上传仓库。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现网故障**：用户请求移除照片中的路灯。11 月 13 日执行时，沙箱达到 2 GiB 内存上限并被 OOM 杀掉；后续启动仅把旧 Task 改成 `waiting`，对应会话 turn 仍是 `RUNNING`，runtime 仍为 `occupied=1`。11 月 16 日同一会话的新请求因此保持 `QUEUED`，没有派发到 WorkSwarm 执行器，也没有修图工具调用。

**两段原因需要分别处理**：

1. **中断触发**：ADX 负责人确认该沙箱于 11 月 13 日 18:12:02（北京时间）退出，`OOMKilled=true`；内核记录内存使用量和限制值均为 `2097152 kB`。18:12:01 最后一步启动 PIL/NumPy 整图处理并分配多个图像数组。尚无法确认具体哪一次分配触发峰值。(OOM后不能自动重启问题已解决)
2. **持续排队的应用缺陷**：重启后的持久状态分裂。现场只读记录为旧 Task `status=waiting, cut_by=restart`，旧 turn `RUNNING`，同一 runtime `occupied=1`；新 Task `pending`、新 turn `QUEUED`、无 `session_id`、无执行事件。按现有队列领取条件，只要旧 turn 保留 `RUNNING`，新 turn 就不具备领取资格；只读反事实查询排除该旧记录后，资格条件恢复。残留的 `RUNNING` 是持久状态，**不代表原 P 图进程仍在运行**。

| 北京时间 | 现场事件 |
| --- | --- |
| 11/13 18:10:10 | 原 P 图请求开始执行；WorkSwarm trace 记录模型与工具步骤。 |
| 11/13 18:12:01 | 最后一步启动 PIL/NumPy 整图处理。 |
| 11/13 18:12:02 | ADX 负责人确认沙箱 OOM 退出，`OOMKilled=true`。从请求开始约 112 秒。 |
| 11/13 21:58 | 同一沙箱日志出现 Gateway/AgentServer 新的启动记录；旧 Task 后续被标记 `cut_by=restart`。 |
| 11/16 20:06:40 | 同一会话再次提交“移除路灯”请求，受理为 `QUEUED`。 |
| 11/17 15:14 | 只读复核仍为 `QUEUED`；旧 turn 仍 `RUNNING`，runtime 仍占用；新 turn 执行事件为 0。 |

**受控最小复现**（测试环境，勿在现网重放副作用）：启动一个同会话图像任务，在执行中让 2 GiB 沙箱触发 OOM；重启 Personal Agent 后读取 Task、`dm_session_turns`、`dm_session_runtimes`；再向同一会话提交普通消息。实际现场状态组合使新消息一直不能领取。测试须核对旧执行的未知结果，不得盲目重放图像写入。

**预期**：沙箱 OOM 后，旧任务及会话轮次、runtime 占用按同一恢复判定收口；未知外部效果先对账。下一条已受理消息能够执行，或在明确期限内得到可操作的失败/恢复结果，不无限停留在 `QUEUED`。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 环境：DigitalMate / Personal Agent 现网，WorkSwarm 执行器；北京时间（Asia/Shanghai）。
- 沙箱内存上限：2 GiB；ADX 负责人提供的内核使用量/限制值均为 `2097152 kB`。
- 现场索引：SFS 工作区 `digitalmate-w-5b43d654…`；原 Task `turn_a4724aab…`，新 Task `turn_cdf276c3…`，同一 conversation `conv_67ed023a…`。完整 ID 留在受控现场记录中，不在 Issue 搬运用户图片或原始日志。
- 核对方式：只读 SFS 日志、WorkSwarm span、SQLite（包含 WAL）与持久状态；没有重放任务或修改生产数据。
- 手机设备、系统和 App 构建号：本次没有可核实记录，待补。

### Version Information

- 事故 Personal Agent 镜像 digest、对应源码 SHA、ADX 沙箱版本及手机 App 构建号：待运维补充，当前不能把本地源码直接认定为事故镜像。
- 调查时本地仓库 revision：`118426eb6f497032ef41135e707e662409764c9f`，仅用于解释当前实现的恢复/队列机制，不作为现网部署版本证明。

### Screenshots / Recordings

下面是依据现场时间戳与状态重建的**脱敏诊断图，非原始客户端截图**；原始用户图片和聊天截图留在受控反馈渠道，不进入 Git。

![OOM 中断后 Task waiting、turn RUNNING、runtime occupied，导致新任务 QUEUED 的脱敏时间线](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-evidence/oom-session-recovery-20261113/.github/issue-assets/oom-session-recovery-20261113/timeline.svg?raw=true)

### Additional Information

**可能的修复归属与边界**：主责 A「会话与任务」（@huben0423-hw）；ADX 提供 OOM 及沙箱生命周期证据，图像处理 owner 协同评估内存峰值。应用恢复应在 Session/Store owner 内对齐 Task、turn 和 runtime 状态，并覆盖新提交、Retry、重启和未知执行结果；不要仅凭断开的 socket 清理占位，也不要把未确认的修图效果再次执行。

**验收建议**：

- 受控 OOM/进程终止后，旧任务、turn 和 runtime 的持久状态一致；无法证明外部结果时保留可见的待核对状态。
- 同一会话后续消息可继续执行，或在有界时间内得到明确失败及恢复入口；旧孤儿 `RUNNING` 不使它无限排队。
- 对原请求 ID、attempt、沙箱退出原因、恢复判定、队列阻塞原因和最终状态有可关联日志；不得把累计等待误报为模型或修图耗时。
- 核对是否需要限制 PIL/NumPy 同时存在的整图数组数量、峰值预算或分块处理；具体触发分配点须另行采样验证。

关联：#1212（已关闭，忙 runtime 与队列超时；活动前序轮次不计入超时）、#1062（已关闭，类似“仍在处理”症状但不同现场状态）。本 Issue 记录新的 OOM 现场与重启状态分裂，不声明它们是同一根因。

来源：用户实际使用反馈；OOM 证据由 ADX 负责人确认并经本轮转述。原始反馈渠道未核实，GitHub 是转录落单处，不作为 `channel:github` 依据。

issue:1874.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

Step HS0 of the [Host and Store cutover plan](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1870) (`docs/implementations/migration/host-and-store-cutover.md`), under #737. v3.1 code keeps accumulating in Bridge `server_engine`: on main `c58b8609` there are 55 registered adapter files (11.4k LOC) and unregistered Hive code (`session_proximity/hive_store.py` 4.0k LOC, `hive_busy.py`, Hive wiring in `server.py`). Several registered adapters hold feature policy rather than translation (`hive_turn_startup.py` 1.3k, `hive_bee_execution.py` 1.0k, `hive_beebou_tools.py` 0.75k LOC). HS0 slows this growth **without blocking feature delivery**: until HS1 lands, every new `temp/` feature still needs a registered Bridge adapter.

### Design Ideas

Extend the architecture gate ([architecture-gate.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/docs/implementations/migration/architecture-gate.md#transition-features-under-temp)):

| Rule | Result |
| --- | --- |
| New Bridge file that imports a `temp/` package or `server.*`, or is named for a v3.1 feature, and is not registered in any `temp/*/ownership.json` | Fail; fix is one registration row |
| Registered adapter above a configured line cap | Fail unless an owner-approved exemption is recorded; cap and exemptions live in gate configuration, not code |
| Growth of existing unregistered v3.1 files (`hive_store.py`, `hive_busy.py`, `server.py` Hive wiring) | Warn and list in the gate report only |

Seed the exemption list with today's oversized adapters, each with an owner and the issue that moves its policy into `temp/`.

### Involved Public APIs

None. Gate configuration and report only.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Affects every PR touching `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine`. The warn-only list becomes the work list for HS2. HS4 later tightens this to refuse new Bridge adapters.

### Test Design and Test Plan

- Gate tests for each rule: unregistered new file fails; registered file passes; oversized adapter fails without exemption and passes with one; growth of a listed unregistered file warns without failing.
- Run the gate against main `HEAD`: expect zero failures, with the exemption list and warning list matching the measured files.
- Confirm a representative feature PR (new `temp/` package + registered adapter) passes unchanged.

### Additional Information

Done when the gate reports on every PR, main passes, and each oversized adapter has an owner and follow-up issue.

issue:1875.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

Step HS1 of the [Host and Store cutover plan](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1870) (`docs/implementations/migration/host-and-store-cutover.md`), under #737. `server/` has contracts and proxies but no host: the production entry is Bridge (`engine_cli.serve` → `server_engine/server.py`, which fills its own `_methods` table). `temp/` packages are libraries bundled into the Bridge wheel via `force-include`, so Bridge must construct each one and register its RPC methods. That is why every v3.1 feature leaves an adapter in Bridge.

### Design Ideas

Host inversion, in place, same process. **Start from the proven foundation host**, not a new design: [`codex/architecture-foundation` `server/__main__.py`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/77a92a218bb9f6775d826a53cd702cc19a0ffdfb/server/__main__.py) (`compose_runtime`, `start_runtime`) and [`server/runtime.py`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/77a92a218bb9f6775d826a53cd702cc19a0ffdfb/server/runtime.py), adapted to main's existing `server/agent_service` packages. Its Store and Router port later (HS2 data decision; Hive routing behaviour must be preserved).

- `server/agent_service` owns the process entry, lifecycle (startup, shutdown, recovery ordering) and the RPC method registry.
- `engine_cli.serve` becomes a thin call into it; `server.py` registers its existing methods through the registry instead of `_methods`.
- `temp/` assembly (for example `dm_hive_runtime.assembly`) is constructed by `server/` and receives Bridge services through declared ports.
- No behaviour change; method names, payloads and error codes are unchanged.

New exports of `server/agent_service` need their `module-ownership.json` change merged first, as the gate requires.

### Involved Public APIs

New: Agent Service host and method-registry interface in `server/agent_service`. Unchanged: every existing RPC method and event.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Bridge `server.py` / `engine_cli.py`, all `temp/` assembly entry points, the Bridge wheel packaging. Prerequisite for HS4 and for any #737 package that needs a new runtime wiring point.

### Test Design and Test Plan

- Installed-wheel proof: the full existing RPC surface is registered and answers identically (method inventory diff is empty).
- Startup, shutdown, recovery bootstrap and hosted-session paths pass existing server UT/ST suites.
- A new sample `temp/` feature registers a method and receives its dependencies with no new file under `server_engine/`.

### Additional Information

Done when a new `temp/` feature needs no Bridge adapter to be hosted, and the existing surface behaves identically on the installed wheel.

issue:1876.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

Investigation that sizes step HS2 of the [Host and Store cutover plan](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1870) (`docs/implementations/migration/host-and-store-cutover.md`), under #737. `session_proximity/hive_store.py` (4.0k LOC) writes almost only its own `dm_hive_*` tables but also references the legacy `submissions`, `history` and `messages` tables, through `EngineStore.transaction()` (`engine_workspace.py`). `EngineStore` is used by 26 non-test modules. Before moving Session/Hive store ownership into `server/agent_service/session_store`, we need to know which of those references must commit atomically with Hive rows.

### Design Ideas

Produce a short report (added to the cutover plan) covering:

1. Every reference in `hive_store.py`, `hive_busy.py`, `hive_migrations.py` and the session parts of `repository.py` to a non-`dm_hive_*` table: read or write, and whether it shares a transaction with Hive writes.
2. Which modules outside the Session/Hive domain write the same tables.
3. Whether the existing participant pattern in `server/agent_service/session_store` (`legacy_admission.py`, `legacy_receipts.py`) can own the transaction for this domain over the existing workspace database file.
4. A recommended HS2 cut line and size estimate.

Constraint: keep the same database file. Do not split into an `ATTACH`ed file; in WAL mode SQLite commits each attached file atomically on its own.

### Involved Public APIs

None. Read-only investigation.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Blocks HS2 and the #737 packages that write Session/Hive state.

### Test Design and Test Plan

Report cites file:line for each classified reference, verified against a named main SHA. No code changes.

### Additional Information

Done when the report is merged into the plan and HS2's scope is updated from it.

issue:1877.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

Step HS2 of the [Host and Store cutover plan](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1870) (`docs/implementations/migration/host-and-store-cutover.md`), under #737. The sole writer of Session and Hive state is Bridge's `EngineStore`, so Hive store logic had to live in Bridge (`session_proximity/hive_store.py` 4.0k LOC, `hive_busy.py`, `hive_migrations.py`). `server/agent_service/session_store` already owns a separate DMS1 database and treats the hosted legacy format as a distinct transaction participant. Scope is set by the HS2 investigation issue.

### Design Ideas

[HS2 cut design](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/de56f973f8110f80815006eb68568aab6721f563/docs/implementations/migration/host-and-store-cutover.md#hs2-workspace-bootstrap-and-hive-writer-cut) covers the existing connection, Home PDF failure cases, rollback and the ownership transition.

- The Session Store owner in `server/` opens the existing workspace database as a registered participant and owns the transaction primitive for the Session/Hive domain. **Same file; code moves, rows stay.**
- Move `hive_store.py`, `hive_busy.py`, `hive_migrations.py` and the session parts of `repository.py` into the Session Store owner. Tables, identities and migration order keep their bytes.
- Bridge callers switch to the Session Store public operations; any temporary Bridge shim is registered and removed in the same lane.
- Other `EngineStore` domains (people, consent, connectors, activity) stay put.

#### HS2a proposed cut

The [HS2a source trace](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1880)
found that the Hive names `submissions`, `history`, and `messages` are CTEs.
The production Home PDF hold writes shared Attachment records in the same
transaction as Hive admission. Session/History/Hive schema initialization also
shares one transaction. Preserve those boundaries and the original connection,
authority, savepoints, commit acknowledgements and outcome reconciliation.
Move the Session-owned claims, bootstrap and admission participants with the
Store or connect them through its narrow same-file operations.

### Involved Public APIs

New Session Store operations for the Session/Hive domain in `server/agent_service/session_store` (ownership change merged first). No RPC or client contract change.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Bridge `session_proximity`, `temp/hive-*` adapters, Hive recovery and retention. Prerequisite for #737 packages that write Session/Hive state, and for HS4.

### Test Design and Test Plan

- Existing workspaces open without data migration; schema and migration fingerprints unchanged.
- Duplicate requests, lost post-commit receipts, Stop, unknown-outcome reconciliation and replay pass through the new owner on the installed wheel.
- Existing Hive server UT/ST suites pass; one local device/emulator run of Hive flows before merge.
- Static check: no write to a `dm_hive_*` table outside `server/agent_service/session_store`.

### Additional Information

HS1 and HS2a are merged. #2012 implements the first cut for Hive writers and shared schema bootstrap. #2009 prepares trusted ownership. The Session repository, admission, claims and coupled publication writers remain in scope. Done when every Session/Hive write goes through the Session Store owner in `server/`.

issue:1887.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

HS4 in the [Host and Store cutover](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737) moves each transition partition to its established owner. On main `38595772`, Bee Artifact settings are a small first slice. The loader only validates an optional supplied TOML path or its bundled configuration. The artifact readers, notice and erasure workers, MCP catalogue and Hive document assembly consume it.

### Design Ideas

Draft for the first Hive Artifact partition of the [cutover plan](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/docs/implementations/migration/host-and-store-cutover.md#hs4--drain-temp). Move the settings module and bundled TOML into `server/agent_service/artifacts`, switch its existing callers, and remove the obsolete transition component and caller grants. Follow the [architecture change review](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/docs/protocols/feature-development.md) and pre-register the exact new owner paths and only the current checked caller edges.

- HS4-ART-D1. Artifact settings own their existing resource bytes and checked loader interface. The caller sequence is unchanged: startup/dispatch → notice, erasure or read consumer → validated artifact settings → existing reader, publisher or byte-owner port.
- HS4-ART-D2. The Artifact and workspace writers retain their existing wire values, defaults, state tables, byte locations and retry semantics. The settings loader never writes and the runtime change waits on HS1 and device acceptance.
- HS4-ART-D3. Remaining artifact partitions continue behind the existing Store, byte, notification and Tool operations. Track removal of their Bridge adapters, packaging map and registration in dependent slices after their destination callers are verified.

### Involved Public APIs

Existing settings loader signatures and value types under the Artifact owner module. Existing RPCs, provider boundaries and settings TOML data are preserved.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

The installed server contracts wheel owns the settings module and resource. The Bridge wheel retains the transition package for the remaining artifact core until those partitions move.

### Test Design and Test Plan

HS4-ART-T1. On installed wheels compare bundled defaults and original bytes and exercise rejection of malformed files with the existing assertions.

HS4-ART-T2. Run the existing artifact core, Bridge Host read, handoff and erasure selections. Use the actual Store/bytes where selected and report named fixtures.

HS4-ART-T3. Verify trusted architecture and package inventory, device send/history/continuation, and post-merge startup with the same artifacts.

issue:1893.body:
### Context

HarmonyOS Home → 点击 Beebou 头像 → Beebou 弹窗的实时活动区域。用户从这里回到 Beebou 主对话，也从这里找具体的 Bee。

### Test Environment

用户反馈来自 HarmonyOS 客户端。源码对照为 `main@9486bdd0`。反馈所用 HAP 版本、设备型号和系统版本未提供，本次未在设备上重现。底部截图引用的是已有的 Home 入口取证。 [当前 HiveActivityPanel](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/9486bdd00c065e1c01f248e76c473f475180f5a7/digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/DigitalMateHome/HiveActivityPanel.ets)

### Problem Description & Suggestions

当前活动区以名称和「记录」按钮展示会话。用户需要从文字列表里找 Beebou 和具体的 Bee，单看列表难以区分谁在工作、谁空闲。

- 弹窗顶部用 Beebou 头像作为主对话入口，点头像直接进入当前 Beebou 主对话，并移除独立的「Beebou 对话」行。Beebou 自己执行时，头像右上角出现「…」小气泡，并播放思考动作。可复用已有的用电脑动作。Beebou 执行结束后收起小气泡。
- 下方每只 Bee 使用可辨认且稳定的小蜜蜂头像，带名称。执行中播放工作动作，空闲时睡觉，退休时置灰。排队、待用户答复和状态暂不可用需要能与执行中、空闲区分。动画和状态由服务端活动事实驱动，Bee 执行时只更新对应 Bee。减少动态效果模式以静态画面和状态描述表达同样的信息。
- 一次验收中放入执行中、空闲、退休三只 Bee，验证头像差异、各自状态、状态切换和读屏描述。点击顶部头像一次即可返回原 Beebou 主对话，且弹窗没有重复入口。

### Screenshots / Recordings

下图为现有 Home 的 Beebou 头像入口。弹窗内现有会话行见上面的源码链接。

![现有 Home 的 Beebou 头像入口](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-26-phone-comparison-digitalmate.jpg?raw=true)

issue:1894.body:
### Background and Goal Description

用户希望从 Home 点击 Beebou，再点某只 Bee 的头像，进入该 Bee 的独立子对话。页面显示这只 Bee 的上下文和回复，底部提供常规对话框。用户可以回到 Beebou 继续讨论，Beebou 应能接上刚才在子对话里确认的需求、变更和结果。

`main@9486bdd0` 已有 #1243、#1603、#1605 的显式目标、会话历史及面板内定向发送。当前面板用「记录」展开历史和内嵌输入；现有定向路径已把路由动作及用户输入记入 Beebou 上下文。仍需交付独立对话界面，以及覆盖用户与 Bee 双向交流的 Inbox 摘要。现有 `status`、`done` 报告及问题答复知会提供了参考。 [HIVE 父设计 #1228](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228) · [Worker 设计 #1268](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1268)

### Proposed Solution

**设计提案 v0.1**

1. **D1 · 子对话。** Home → Beebou 弹窗 → 点某只 Bee 的头像 → 该 Bee 的专属页。标题显示 Bee 头像和名称，时间线和分页限定当前 Bee，底部有常规对话输入框。弹窗列表去掉内嵌的发消息选项。返回时回到 Beebou 弹窗。退役 Bee 在仍有授权和历史可读时可查看历史，输入框禁用。入口视觉见 #1893。
2. **D2 · 定向与历史。** 客户端用 `hive.activity` 读取会话，并通过 `hive.message.send` 携带显式 `target_session_ref`。服务端复核用户权限、Bee 绑定和会话代次。目标失效时给出明确反馈，保留输入草稿。设计评审明确忙时普通发送的默认语义，并保留现有显式补充、排队、抢占与问题答复各自的目标和回执。
3. **D3 · 摘要投递。** 每轮已受理的用户直聊及其 Bee 应答、已提交的可见结果或终止事实都纳入摘要覆盖。由 Bee 生成简明增量摘要，记录来源 Bee、会话和源消息范围，保留用户确认的约束变更、Bee 的结论、失败或停止以及未决事项。Bee/Host 经现有报告或知会边界交给 Session Manager / Store。Store 权威记录摘要及可恢复的投递义务，以稳定的源范围或轮次身份去重。Bee 回复可先展示。摘要暂时生成失败、丢 ACK 或重启时恢复同一义务，原始对话可继续读取。
4. **D4 · Beebou 消费。** 复用现有 Inbox 与上下文提交见证，把它作为知会数据投递。Beebou 后续读取已持久化的摘要，把它纳入正常轮上下文，提交后才确认消费。已到达的摘要须供下一次相关 Beebou 回复使用。对尚未交付的变更保留可区分的待同步事实。摘要到达本身不触发自动派单或补充任务，也不在 Home 自动重复展示原对话。
5. **接入与回退。** 优先沿用现有显式目标、分页和消费边界。需新增服务端核心时，按 v3.1 迁移规则放在对应 owner 的支持路径，支持路径未就绪时用已登记的 `temp/<feature>/` 过渡路径。以能力声明控制入口和升级顺序。回退界面时保留已有对话及已承诺的 Inbox 投递义务。

建议时序为「用户在 Bee 页发送 → Gateway 校验定向 → Bee 回复并提交源记录 → Bee/Host 提交摘要或可恢复义务 → Store 投递 Inbox → Beebou 正常轮读入并确认」。可评审复用现有知会类型或扩展受控报告类型。采用哪种类型、何时生成摘要、并发时如何保证覆盖，以及权限变化如何处理，由 Bee/Host、Session Manager/Store 和 Beebou owner 一起确认。

### Involved Public APIs

优先复用客户端已支持的 `hive.activity` 和 `hive.message.send` 显式目标。评审需确认摘要知会的类型、来源引用、去重键、确认点、兼容行为及能力声明。Session Store 持有持久会话、回执和 Inbox 的权威写入。App 使用已有公开代理读写会话。 [现有会话与知会规格 §7](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/9486bdd00c065e1c01f248e76c473f475180f5a7/docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-delivery-design.md)

### Test Verification

- **T1（D1、D2）** 实际 HarmonyOS HAP 从同一弹窗进入 Bee A 和 B，各自发送多轮并切换、返回、重开。验证历史、分页、回复和后续上下文只归对应 Bee。覆盖旧 HAP、已退休、目标过期及双设备各停留不同 Bee。
- **T2（D2）** 实际 Gateway / Store 验证越权及冲突目标被拒绝，且草稿可恢复。忙时发送、问题答复与重连重试按已评审的语义落到原目标。
- **T3（D3、D4）** 实际 Bee、Inbox 与 Beebou 串联。用户在 Bee A 改约束并收到 Bee 回复，随后回 Beebou 追问，检查持久 Inbox 记录、Beebou 实际轮次输入及回复是否采用最新约束。另验 Bee B 原始上下文和其他账号不可见。
- **T4（D3、D4）** 覆盖摘要生成失败、写入后丢 ACK、Bee 或 Beebou 重启、Inbox 消费提交前崩溃、快速连续多轮及退役交界。对账每个源轮及其终止事实都有摘要覆盖，重试后逻辑上只应用一次，且只读知会不会触发派单。
- 上述均为待验收用例。验收记录实际 HAP、Gateway / 服务端版本、参与方及回执，沿用 HIVE-SC-04 的显式目标与设备用例。 [HIVE G5 验收](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/9486bdd00c065e1c01f248e76c473f475180f5a7/docs/scenarios/hive-g5-plan.md)

### Before submitting a new issue

- [x] Please confirm that you have searched the previous RFC documents

issue:1895.body:
### Context

移动端 Beebou Home 会话。用户发送「你好」后，Beebou 回复正常问候，但在括号中顺带输出系统运维信息：「（顺带一提：系统刚回收了「产品额度查询助手」来释放名额，不影响你手头的上海亲子游方案。要调整行程或导出 Word/Excel，随时说～）」

导航路径：Home 会话 → 输入「你好」→ Beebou 回复。

### Test Environment

- 服务端：`openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate` main 分支，2026-11-16/17 版本。
- 客户端：移动端 App，Beebou Home。
- 复现时间：2026-11-17 05:49（Asia/Shanghai）。

### Problem Description

Bee 的回收/驱逐通知是内部系统状态，应该静默记录或放在开发者/运维面板，而不是由对话助手以括号补充说明的形式主动告知终端用户。普通用户不需要知道哪个内部 Worker Bot 被回收；这类系统消息会：

1. 打断对话的自然流程，让助手看起来在“自言自语”；
2. 暴露内部实现细节（Bee 的名字、回收原因）；
3. 与用户当前对话目标无关，造成噪音。

截图中，用户只是发送「你好」，Beebou 的回复却包含系统回收「产品额度查询助手」的通知。用户认为这类系统信息不应出现在对话中。

### Improvement & Fix Suggestions

- 将 Bee 回收/驱逐、名额释放、容量管理等系统事件从对话输出中移除，改为仅记录在服务端日志、运维面板或开发者调试页面。
- 如果确实需要通知用户（例如用户正在等待的任务被取消），应以用户可理解的业务语言单独说明，而不是括号补充系统运维细节。
- 系统事件进入模型上下文时，应标记为 `role: system` 或内部数据，不应被模型自然语言化后复述给用户。

### Screenshots / Recordings

![Beebou 在回复「你好」时顺带告知系统回收了「产品额度查询助手」](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-evidence-unified-capabilities-20261117/issues/assets/2026-11-17-unified-assistant-capabilities.png?raw=true)

### Version Information

- App 版本：未知，截图来自 2026-11-17 05:49（Asia/Shanghai）。
- 服务端：main 分支，2026-11-16/17。

issue:1899.body:
### Background and Goal Description

[#1884](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1884) moves the Bee tool hook to the Host and retires the Hive overlay from WorkSwarm. An installed-wheel restart probe showed that an altered DeepAdapter source makes an old Registry core unavailable and deleting the overlay makes the old legacy WorkSwarm participant unavailable. Old bindings still resolve when the same installed inputs are present. Design compatibility for already retained work while preserving checkpoint, replay and authority guarantees.

### Proposed Solution

The [versioned specification](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/hs3-retained-binding-design/docs/implementations/migration/hs3-retained-binding-compatibility.md) and the [architecture review slides](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/hs3-retained-binding-design/docs/assets/feature-design/hs3-retained-binding-review-v0.1.pptx) are open for review in #1900.

Review a release-scoped compatibility design. Evaluate a trusted, bounded proof that connects exact original dependencies to a reviewed successor and retains the original recorded binding as the durable evidence. Consider retaining exact old inputs with a sunset and keeping the present unavailable behavior as separate options. Approve coverage and rollback semantics before any resolver change or persisted-data operation.

### Involved Public APIs

Hosted binding resolution and the WorkSwarm Registry factory boundary. Inspect the existing Bee Harness reference, current owner claim, context operations, tool admission, effect journal and client-visible recovery behavior.

### Test Verification

Reopen retained Registry Hosted, legacy Hosted and Hive Bee work across restarts using the installed wheels. Exercise same-session continuation, retained receipt replay, answer claims, lost receipts, effect reconciliation, Stop, unknown and forged transitions, mixed old and new participants, and rollback after new admissions. Measure differences through actual callers with controlled providers and a separate emulator acceptance.

### Before submitting a new issue

- [x] Please confirm that you have searched the previous RFC documents

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

The sealed-step case in `test_phase2_cli_bee_effects.py` sends `write_file` as a deliberately forbidden call. #1800 grants that tool in the Bee catalog. The Host records and executes the call under the current policy, and the case stops at its assertion that there is no plan for `forbidden-1`.

Run with the Server Engine and pinned patched WorkSwarm and Core installed:

```text
WORKSWARM_RUNTIME_TESTS=1 python -I -m pytest -q <repo>/tests/scenarios/hive/test_phase2_cli_bee_effects.py

test_supplement_after_the_step_is_sealed_lets_executing_calls_settle_once_and_refusals_hold
    self.assertNotIn("forbidden-1", by_id)
AssertionError: 'forbidden-1' unexpectedly found
Observed operation: write_file / EXECUTED
```

Use an operation that the current Bee scope rejects. Preserve the assertions for refusal before planning and for settling the admitted effect exactly once.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

Local macOS arm64, Python 3.13.13. Installed Server Engine, pinned WorkSwarm and Core. The actual authenticated WebSocket, owned Bee child, effect gate and Store ran with a controlled model, personal backend and effect ledger.

### Version Information

The same case failed on main `f7bec48a9ea9bdece5c981c0e30c3ac05a3df7a3` and #1897 head `a30b09384740b8a1329a42e3fcec4f757ecb705b`. The two other installed effect scenarios passed on both revisions.

### Symptom

`harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_hive_beebou_choice_card.py::test_a_result_relayed_during_the_next_turn_is_reported_in_its_view` (line 289) now fails 3 out of 3 runs on main `0e6777f81`. It raises a `StopIteration` inside a coroutine.

### When it started

- It passed on `38595772d`. On that base the Bridge Hive subset showed only the 9 usual failures, all from the build host's environment.
- It fails on `0e6777f81`, so the regression landed in `38595772d..0e6777f81`.
- Candidates in that range:
  - #1837 (omits consumed terminal triggers from model history). It touches the same "result relayed in the next turn" path the test covers, so it is the likeliest.
  - #1881, #1890 and #1891 (host ownership / installed host gate).
  - #1888 and #1896 (artifact settings).
- This has not been bisected yet.

### Expected

A Bee result that Beebou relays during the next turn is reported in that turn's view, as #1847 / #1855 established, and the test passes on main.

### Done when

- The breaking commit is identified.
- The test passes on main again, or the test is updated with a stated reason if the behaviour change was intended.

Found while #1871 was being validated on main `0e6777f81`. It is not caused by the #1749 tool lanes, since it fails on plain main.

### Symptom (QA #1790 §12.7, B17)

A Bee's second `ask_user`, made inside the resume turn after the user answered its first question, sometimes reaches the runtime as a `chat.ask_user_question` with `source: permission_interrupt`, header 权限审批 and an empty question text.

When that happens:
- the Host records no question row;
- no question card appears;
- the task stays `running` until the user presses Stop.

Seen in 1 of 2 runs on build `2af7ac6d`, which contains #1833's B14 fix. The retry with a fresh Bee passed: both questions showed and the task completed. R3b run K1 also passed.

### Evidence

`hk-longjianyu:~/hk-runs/qa-1790/2af7ac6d-20261117T105830Z/` holds the Bee history from the failing J2 run. The write-up is in `docs/qa/hive-tool-access-1790.md` §12.7 (PR #1791).

### Done when

- The cause of the intermittent `permission_interrupt` shape is found.
- A nested `ask_user` during a resume is always recorded as a question: a card appears and the task moves to waiting_user.
- If it can't be prevented at the source, the Host settles the Run instead of leaving it running.
- A test reproduces it.

issue:1907.body:
### Symptom (QA #1790 §12.7)

The Host read tools resolve `./r4.pdf` differently from `r4.pdf` in the same task. Before the file existed:
- `./r4.pdf` was refused as `outside_workspace`;
- `r4.pdf` was refused as `not_found`.

A leading `./` refers to the task root and should give the same result as the bare name. Once the file exists, `./name` must read it.

### Where

`temp/hive-tools/src/dm_hive_tools/workspace.py` path resolution, shared by the read and write tools.

### Done when

- `./x`, `x` and `sub/../x` resolve the same way inside the task root.
- `..` and symlink escapes are still refused.
- Tests cover these cases.

Refs #1784 #1749

issue:1916.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

当前 Hive Home 的 PDF、PPTX、DOCX 专用生成依赖部署配置。已有 Home 逐条授权识别英文创建命令。中文用户在默认部署下无法稳定从明确请求得到相应文件。相关验收见 #1790 和 #1529。

### Design Ideas

D1 提议在现有可交付格式中默认启用 PDF、PPTX、DOCX 的创建。明确请求单一格式的中文 Home 消息可以授予同一 task 对该格式和安全文件名的一次创建权限。选择现有 Host 门控与结构化生成器，复用产物读取和客户端预览。

[可编辑评审稿](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/chinese-home-documents/docs/assets/feature-design/hive-home-documents-review-v1.pptx) · [版本化规格](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/chinese-home-documents/docs/implementations/contracts/hive-home-documents-v1.md)

### Involved Public APIs

沿用 `room.message`、`room.home` 和 `artifact.read` 的请求及响应字段。Home 的单条创建授权增加中文意图，Host 仍核对原始提交和已受理回执。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Bridge 提供默认装配，Hive Runtime 识别授权请求，Host 与 Store 核对绑定并提交回执，产物所有者管理文件字节。HarmonyOS 复用现有产物中心。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- T1 默认设置下经中文 Home 消息生成三种真实格式，在产物中心预览并下载。核对中文内容和 SHA-256。
- T2 拒绝越界文件名、多个格式、错误格式、缺少 Home 来源及无关意图。保留原有单次执行和重试对账。
- T3 校验显式部署配置优先、禁用格式和仅交付配置的启动。保留英文路径回归覆盖。

### Additional Information

验收范围为独立测试 HAP、HarmonyOS 模拟器和受控模型。附件来源的授权重查继续按现有行为处理。

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

请修复当前 main 天气工具城市解析链路：**一个不完整的非目标候选使整批候选失败；常用中文城市名直接查询也没有候选。** 不应把这两类情况笼统视为预报服务/网络不可用。

2026-11-17 本机两轮真实调用 `server_engine.search_mcp.native_weather` 均复现：

| 入参 | 实际结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `上海` | `locations: []` |
| `苏州` | `locations: []` |
| `Shanghai` | `ValueError: The weather response is incomplete; try again later`；日志 `weather_lookup_failed stage=geocoding_search category=response_validation` |
| `1796236`（中国上海 ID） | 成功返回上海预报；第一轮耗时 4.53 秒，第二轮 checked_at=`2026-11-17T20:32:10.932321+08:00`，temperature_c=14.5、weather=Overcast、high_c=17.3、low_c=13.2。是小时预报，非实时观测。 |

**已确认根因（英文候选失败）：** 实际 Open-Meteo `v1/search?name=Shanghai&count=5&language=en&format=json` 的第一个候选是有效的中国上海；第 5 个候选 id=4568317、country_code=PR，缺少 `country`。`engine_weather.py:15-25` 把 `Location.country` 设为必填，`:115` 对整批 `Locations.model_validate_json()`，因此 `results.4.country` 的缺失导致整个 search 失败。该失败随后被包装为服务响应不完整。中文空结果是另一个已观察事实：当前工具没有替代解析路径，本次没有证明上游为什么不返回中文匹配。

**可离线复现的最小候选夹具**（从本次实际响应裁剪，只保留第一和第五个候选；因此错误下标变为 1）：

```python
from server_engine.engine_weather import Locations

Locations.model_validate({"results": [
    {"id": 1796236, "name": "Shanghai", "country": "China",
     "latitude": 31.22222, "longitude": 121.45806, "timezone": "Asia/Shanghai"},
    {"id": 4568317, "name": "Shanghai",
     "latitude": 18.20774, "longitude": -65.74461, "timezone": "America/Puerto_Rico"},
]})
```

实际校验错误：

```text
1 validation error for Locations
results.1.country
  Field required [type=missing, input_value={'id': 4568317, 'name': '...: 'America/Puerto_Rico'}, input_type=dict]
```

真实工具复现（使用仓库已安装的 Bridge 依赖，在该源码版本运行）：

```python
import asyncio
from server_engine.search_mcp import native_weather

async def main():
    for name in ('上海', '苏州', 'Shanghai', '1796236'):
        try:
            print(name, await native_weather(name))
        except Exception as error:
            print(name, type(error).__name__, str(error))

asyncio.run(main())
```

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- macOS 26.6.2 arm64，Python 3.12.13，Pydantic 2.14。
- 独立 main 源码快照，通过产品 `native_weather` → `forecast` → `PageFetcher` 调用真实公共免 Key Open-Meteo；未替换 HTTP 数据。离线最小夹具另行标注如上。
- 使用本机网络；测试进程环境有本地代理配置，本次未将此结果外推为云端出口结论。
- 没有真实 LLM、Hive Host、HAP 或设备参与本次直接工具复现；未部署共享环境，不声称端到端验收通过。

### Additional Information

**修复与验收边界：**

1. 候选按条验证/隔离：不完整的无关候选不能使其他有效候选不可用；不要用编造国家/坐标来通过校验。全无有效候选应有明确错误语义。
2. 中文城市名的解析应有受控的归一化/替代路径，至少覆盖上海、苏州；明确指定地点优先，同名城市仍须消歧，不静默选错地点。若改变工具公开返回契约，应同步设计与调用方。
3. 保留 `forecast` 的唯一实现，修复应覆盖当前 Hive/Bee 经 Host 调用的产品路径，不只改已退役 legacy 执行器；遵循仓库 temp/过渡归属规则。
4. 补真实响应形状回归：有效+缺字段候选混合、全无有效候选、中文空结果、同名地点、按 ID 成功、网络超时/错误；失败不得编造天气。
5. 目标部署上的 DNS/TLS 和真实模型+HAP 验收单列。#1790 中天气预报握手超时尚未完成；本机按 ID 成功不能关闭该环境义务。

关联：#1338（此前网络/超时修复）、#1775（耗时度量）、#1335（使用授权定位）、#1790（工具联合验收）。此条聚焦**城市解析正确性**，不重复搜索质量工作；web search 由另一 agent 验证，明确不在本条范围。

### Version Information

复现源码：main `e02e99dffb1ff08943a35d4f0c3c5226503a721b`（2026-11-17 拉取的 origin/main）。

责任入口：[engine_weather.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e02e99dffb1ff08943a35d4f0c3c5226503a721b/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_weather.py#L15)；[search_mcp.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e02e99dffb1ff08943a35d4f0c3c5226503a721b/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/search_mcp.py#L155)。

### Screenshots / Recordings

下图是浏览器展示**实际采集诊断 stdout**的截图，包含离线夹具校验与第二轮真实工具请求结果；不是手机界面，也不代表设备验收。

![Weather diagnostic output captured on main e02e99df](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-screenshots/issue-assets/weather-diagnostic-e02e99df-20261117.png?raw=true)

### Background and Goal Description
Hive presentation generation currently reduces slides to title/bullet JSON and a fixed renderer. Instructions, references, tools and dependencies need a versioned plugin model reusable by other skills.

### Proposed Solution
Use plugins/<capability>/ for first-party packages. Runtime selects installed manifests and constructs providers; Registry prepares exact versions, Host owns authority, and Plugin Gateway dispatches bound tools. First candidate: immutable skill resources, a presentation plugin, and opt-in Home/report integration. Existing client and upstream skills retain their callers until separately migrated.
Design draft: [Skill plugins v1](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/skill-plugins/docs/implementations/contracts/skill-plugins-v1.md). Editable review: [architecture review PPTX](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/skill-plugins/docs/assets/feature-design/skill-plugins-review-v1.pptx). Both will be linked from the implementation PR. New contracts remain proposed until review; no deployment or merge is included.

### Involved Public APIs
Reuse RegistryProxy, ImplementationRef, Profile.skills, ToolProvider and PluginGateway. Add plugin-owned resource interfaces without moving Host, Store or Artifact authority.

### Test Verification
Check manifest validation, immutable resource identity, exact Registry resolution, real Gateway dispatch, traversal/unknown/disabled refusals, editable PPT generation and real Home/report consumers. Verify wheel resources and architecture boundaries; record external model, visual and deployment gates separately.

### Before submitting a new issue
- [x] Please confirm that you have searched the previous RFC documents


### Additional Supplementary Information
Producer: #1929 (owner and checker prerequisite; merge first). Implementation: #1931 (default-off bounded candidate). [Development guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/skill-plugins/docs/guides/development/skill-plugins.md) and [verification](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/skill-plugins/docs/verification/skill-plugins-2026-11-17.md) record reusable rules and the bounded evidence. Refs #737; A05/A32/M29/HS3 are not closed. Owner review, applicable CI, real-model visual quality and deployment remain separate gates.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

用户上传一张 JPG 图片并提问后，Beebou 顶部显示「连接暂不可用」，并在回复中给出两段能力声明：

1. 「Bee 也没有看图的能力。它和我一样是对话型代理，能处理文字，但没有图像识别/查看的接口，看不了 JPG 图片。派它去『看这张图』一样做不到。」
2. 「而且现在所有 Bee 都处于冲突状态、接不了新任务（`accepts_new_dispatch: false`），就算派也派不出去。」

随后 Beebou 建议用户把图中文字打/复制出来贴给它。

**用户感知**：助手「读图不行了」。无论这是能力真缺失、能力存在但未暴露，还是状态异常（全部 Bee 冲突），当前对外的口径都是「不能读图」，与用户「发图即问」的预期不符。

**需要区分两种情况并分别核实**：
- 若 Hive 体系确实没有图像理解链路，则对外口径应与能力边界单（#1762）一致，且不应接收图片上传后再拒绝——应前置拦截或给出「当前会话不支持图片」的明确入口说明。
- 若能力存在（历史版本或配置下可用），则「看不了 JPG」属于回归，应定位图像输入在哪一环被剥掉。

另：`accepts_new_dispatch: false` 使「派 Bee 去做」这条降级路径同时失效。两种失败叠加时，Beebou 只能让用户手打图中文字。

复现步骤：
1. 在 Beebou Home 会话中通过「+」上传一张 JPG 图片。
2. 就图片内容提问。
3. 观察 Beebou 的回复与顶部状态条。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 应用：DigitalMate / BeeBou（包名 com.jiuwen.digitalmate）。
- 平台：HarmonyOS 手机。
- 复现时间：2026-11-17 10:22（Asia/Shanghai，取自状态栏）。
- App 版本、模型、服务端部署 SHA：未采集。

### Additional Information

- 父收集：#1665。
- 能力边界与呈现：#1762（附件能力边界 A/B 决策）、#1760（附件拒收提示，已修复合入）、#1761（能力预检 umbrella）。
- 能力口径：#1842（整体助手能力口径）。
- 截图中另见「连接暂不可用」，可能与连接/配额状态有关，需一并核对当时会话的 Store 记录。

issue:1932.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [ ] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.（当前 main 的完整运行路径尚未复现验证。）
- [x] 已提供固定版本、隔离复现和受控替身说明。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

在 `v0.1.12`（`709f4d39d613cf191d0dbb8bf1e4bec8e8695edf`），会话容量已满时，如果最久未活动的 runtime 因残留提问返回 `STILL_IN_USE`，即使另有可以释放的空闲 runtime，排队维护也可能反复选择同一个最旧候选，最终将新请求以“排队等待超过 5 分钟”失败。

**隔离复现结果**：使用真实 `EngineService`、`SessionManager`、`SQLiteSessionRepository`、`SessionMaintenance` 和 `WorkSwarmAdapter.release_session`，构造两个占用槽位：最旧候选有残留 saved question，第二个候选模拟后端确认 `RELEASED`。模拟时钟：

| 维护间隔 | 实际结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 30 秒 | 11 次释放尝试均选中最旧候选；第二个未被尝试；模拟 330 秒后请求 `failed` |
| 1 秒 | 第二次选中另一候选并完成请求 |

330 秒包含首次记录阻塞之前的一个维护间隔；队列阻塞超时配置为默认 300 秒。测试手动驱动维护方法、使用内存/临时测试工作区和模拟时钟；未连接实际服务或重放现网请求。第二个候选的卸载确认是受控替身；最旧候选的 `STILL_IN_USE` 由该提交真实的 WorkSwarm adapter 判断产生。

**可能的代码路径**：

1. [SQLiteSessionRepository._reserve_runtime](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/709f4d39d613cf191d0dbb8bf1e4bec8e8695edf/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/repository.py#L919) 按 LRU 选择候选。
2. [WorkSwarmAdapter.release_session](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/709f4d39d613cf191d0dbb8bf1e4bec8e8695edf/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/workswarm_adapter.py#L1157) 因 `saved_questions` 非空返回 `STILL_IN_USE`。
3. [abort_release](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/709f4d39d613cf191d0dbb8bf1e4bec8e8695edf/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/repository.py#L1008) 将该 incarnation 暂避 30 秒；[队列维护](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/709f4d39d613cf191d0dbb8bf1e4bec8e8695edf/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/maintenance.py#L199) 无其他唤醒时也按 30 秒轮询。候选暂避在下一次维护时到期，可导致再次选中同一候选。
4. [默认组装](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/709f4d39d613cf191d0dbb8bf1e4bec8e8695edf/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/composition.py#L134) 已传入 execution 和默认 300 秒队列期限。

**现网只读观察，因果尚未闭环**：某工作区 20 个 `occupied` 中，最旧 4 个均存在产品侧交互已 `CANCELLED`、同一物理会话的 WorkSwarm 保存记录仍有对应提问的状态不一致。两条新请求最终排队超时、没有 Run。尚缺事故时间的 Bridge 每次候选、释放结果和生产镜像 digest，不能断言复现就是两条现网请求的实际根因。一个会话还有另一条独立 `OPEN` 交互，不可批量清除提问。

**期望**：真实已取消交互经确认和对账后，不应无限阻止安全释放；busy 候选被跳过期间应有界尝试其他候选，不能让轮询节奏使等待者饥饿。`UNKNOWN`、真实活跃或等待交互仍须保持围栏，不能臆测释放成功。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- Python 3.13；仓库隔离检出，临时 SQLite 工作区，`SESSION_CAPACITY=2`，默认 `SESSION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_S=300`。
- 本地受控实验，没有真实 WorkSwarm/Gateway 和生产数据库；产品执行返回及第二个候选的后端释放结果为替身。
- 运行方式：在该提交仓库根目录、已安装项目依赖的 Python 环境中，将下面完整脚本保存为 `probe_709f_queue.py`，然后执行：

```bash
PYTHONPATH=.:harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src:temp/connection-foundation/src python probe_709f_queue.py
```

<details><summary>隔离复现脚本</summary>

```python
"""Isolated 709f4d3 integration probe: synthetic workspace, no production data.

Run from the 709f4d3 checkout with its agent_bridge source and tests on PYTHONPATH.
The product service, repository, admission and maintenance are real; runtime
release and the repository clock are controlled substitutes. No server is started.
"""
import asyncio
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import types
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from dm_sessions.types import ReleaseStatus, Scope
from server_engine.contracts import EngineRequest, ExecutionResult, Room
from server_engine.engine_connectors import ConnectorConfig, Connectors
from server_engine.engine_service import EngineService
from server_engine.memory.factory import create_digitalmate_memory
from server_engine.session_proximity import repository as repo_module
from server_engine.session_proximity.composition import create_session_manager
from server_engine.workswarm_adapter import WorkSwarmAdapter

SHA = '709f4d39d613cf191d0dbb8bf1e4bec8e8695edf'
assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip() == SHA


class QueueCadenceProbe(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def asyncSetUp(self):
        self.temp_dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        workspace = Path(self.temp_dir.name)
        async def execute(task, evidence):
            return ExecutionResult(status='completed', output='Synthetic answer')
        self.service = EngineService(path=workspace, principal_id='test_principal',
            memory=create_digitalmate_memory(workspace, {}),
            connectors=Connectors(ConnectorConfig.from_environment({})), execute=execute)
        self.service.publication_root = workspace
        self.service.store.create('room', Room(id='home', project_id='home_project', title='Home',
            member_ids=['test_principal', 'digitalmate'], kind='home'))
        self.service.session_manager = create_session_manager(self.service, {'SESSION_CAPACITY': '2'})

    async def asyncTearDown(self):
        await self.service.close()
        self.temp_dir.cleanup()

    async def exercise(self, spacing, expect_fail):
        service = self.service
        turns = []
        for index, text in enumerate(('Lisbon itinerary', 'Photosynthesis')):
            turns.append(await service.request(EngineRequest(action='room.message', room_id='home',
                text=text, submission_id=f'cadence-seed-{index}')))
            await asyncio.gather(*list(service.active.values()))
            await asyncio.sleep(0)
        db = service.store.connection
        handles = dict(db.execute('SELECT conversation_id,context_id FROM dm_session_runtimes WHERE occupied=1'))
        for index, turn in enumerate(turns):
            db.execute('UPDATE dm_session_conversations SET last_activity_at_ms=? WHERE conversation_id=?',
                       (index + 1, turn['conversation_id']))
        seen = []
        adapter = WorkSwarmAdapter.__new__(WorkSwarmAdapter)
        adapter.runtime_tokens = {'old-session': 'a' * 32}
        adapter.released_runtime_tokens = {}
        adapter.locks = {}
        adapter.questions = {}
        adapter.saved_questions = {'old-session': {'cancelled-interaction': {}}}
        adapter.mapping = {'scopes': {}}
        async def release(handle, generation):
            seen.append(handle.context_id)
            if handle.context_id == handles[turns[0]['conversation_id']]:
                return await adapter.release_session('old-session')
            return ReleaseStatus.RELEASED  # Substitute for a successful backend unload.
        service.release_runtime = release
        clock = types.SimpleNamespace(elapsed=0.0)
        wall_start = time.time()
        fake_time = types.SimpleNamespace(monotonic=lambda: clock.elapsed, time=lambda: wall_start + clock.elapsed)
        worker = service.session_maintenance
        self.assertEqual(300000, worker.queue_timeout_ms)
        self.assertIsNotNone(worker.execution)
        scope = Scope(service.path.name, service.principal_id, 'home')
        with patch.object(repo_module, 'time', fake_time):
            queued = await service.request(EngineRequest(action='room.message', room_id='home',
                text='Ukulele', submission_id='cadence-queued'))
            self.assertEqual('pending', service.task(queued['task_id']).status)
            for n in range(1, 13):
                clock.elapsed = n * spacing
                await worker._maintain_sessions(scope, 10)
                await asyncio.gather(*list(service.active.values()))
                if service.task(queued['task_id']).status != 'pending':
                    break
        status = service.task(queued['task_id']).status
        if expect_fail:
            self.assertEqual('failed', status)
            self.assertTrue(seen)
            self.assertEqual({handles[turns[0]['conversation_id']]}, set(seen))
            self.assertIn('minute', service.task(queued['task_id']).result)
        else:
            self.assertEqual('completed', status)
            self.assertEqual([handles[turns[0]['conversation_id']], handles[turns[1]['conversation_id']]], seen)
        print(f'spacing={spacing}s status={status} release_attempts={len(seen)} '
              f'distinct_candidates={len(set(seen))} simulated_elapsed={clock.elapsed}s')

    async def test_30_seconds_misses_other_idle_candidate(self):
        await self.exercise(30, True)

    async def test_prompt_retry_reaches_other_idle_candidate(self):
        await self.exercise(1, False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    suite = unittest.TestSuite(QueueCadenceProbe(name) for name in (
        'test_30_seconds_misses_other_idle_candidate', 'test_prompt_retry_reaches_other_idle_candidate'))
    result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
    raise SystemExit(not result.wasSuccessful())

```

</details>

### Version Information

- 已复现：`v0.1.12`，`709f4d39d613cf191d0dbb8bf1e4bec8e8695edf`。
- 事故运行镜像 digest / 对应源码 SHA：未确认。

issue:1935.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.（已在下述 main 快照做隔离复现；不代表现网镜像已确认。）
- [x] 已提供固定版本、可运行复现和受控替身说明。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**Beebou / Hive 架构可能存在与 #1932 相似的容量交接风险，具体机制不同。** 在 main 的隔离复现中，当 Hive Store 将一个 Bee 判定为没有未完成工作并选作释放候选，但 WorkSwarm 仍保存该物理会话的提问记录时，`release_session` 返回 `STILL_IN_USE`。Host 恢复任务持续处理同一条已声明的 eviction，新的 Bee 激活保持 `PENDING`；即使另一个 Bee 的物理会话可证明从未打开，也没有用于这次交接。

**范围与边界**：本次是构造 Store 状态与 Adapter 保存问题不一致的局部隔离测试，尚未证明正式用户取消路径会在 main 产生这条不一致，也未证明现网命中、用户消息一定一直等待，或 main 会返回旧版“五分钟超时”提示。真实仍需等待用户的问题应保持保护。

**复现结果（固定 main 提交）**：

| 测试条件 | Host / Adapter 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 最旧 Bee 没有 saved question | `CONFIRMED` / `RELEASED`，槽位交接成功 |
| 最旧 Bee 存在保存的提问 | 连续 3 次 `NOT_RELEASED` / `STILL_IN_USE`，没有 Gateway unload；原 eviction 保持 `CLAIMED`，新 Bee 激活保持 `PENDING` |

另一个 Bee 仍为 `ACTIVE`，隔离实验中它的 `release_scoped_session` 可以提供 `NEVER_OPENED` 证明，但当前这条 eviction 绑定的仍是最旧 Bee。用的是首次释放和两次手动恢复扫描，不声称实测了真实运行时的 5 秒周期。

**路径**：

1. [HiveStore._idle / _place_claim](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/70fcc5f759480e466530438a4565ad03945e0d90/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/hive_store.py#L2868) 按 Store 的任务、运行和队列状态判断候选，并为新激活创建 eviction。
2. [HiveSlotRelease.release / run_once](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/70fcc5f759480e466530438a4565ad03945e0d90/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/hive_slot_release.py#L99) 为该 victim 请求释放证明；无证明则保留声明供恢复扫描重试。默认扫描间隔为 5 秒。
3. [WorkSwarmAdapter.release_scoped_session / release_session](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/70fcc5f759480e466530438a4565ad03945e0d90/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/workswarm_adapter.py#L1536) 发现 `saved_questions` 非空时返回 `STILL_IN_USE`，因此不给出释放证明。
4. main 的普通启动使用 `legacy_execution=False` 和 `legacy_dispatch=False`；不能将 #1932 的 30 秒旧队列与五分钟超时机制直接套用到 Hive。

**期望**：能安全区分真实活跃问题与跨 Store / Adapter 已结束但残留的状态；无法安全释放某候选时，以保留证据和隔离约束的方式有界推进其他可释放候选，或者向调用方提供明确可恢复的状态。不得仅凭任务终态、socket 断开或超时认定物理卸载成功。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 隔离环境：macOS、Python 3.13，临时 SQLite 数据库，Hive `slot_capacity=2`；无现网数据或真实模型调用。
- 真实参与者：`SQLiteSessionRepository` / Hive Store、`HiveSlotRelease`、`WorkSwarmAdapter`、文件持久化及重启后重新加载。
- 受控替身：Host 身份验证和 WorkSwarm Gateway。测试通过实际 Adapter 打开会话并将合成提问保存到临时文件；“残留”是直接构造的，不是重放用户取消。
- 执行方式：在固定提交的仓库根目录和已安装项目依赖的 Python 环境，将下面脚本保存为 `probe_main_hive_slot.py`；确保仓库的 `temp/*/src`、Bridge 源码和测试目录在 `PYTHONPATH`，例如：

```bash
python - <<'PY'
import glob, os, subprocess, sys
paths = ['.', 'harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src',
         'harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests', *sorted(glob.glob('temp/*/src'))]
env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=os.pathsep.join(paths))
subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'probe_main_hive_slot.py'], env=env, check=True)
PY
```

<details><summary>完整隔离复现脚本</summary>

```python
"""Controlled Hive slot-release test for DigitalMate main 70fcc5f.

Real Hive SQLite Store, HiveSlotRelease and WorkSwarmAdapter. Controlled Host
and fake Gateway; synthetic data only. Run from the exact main checkout with
agent_bridge source/tests and all temp/*/src packages on PYTHONPATH.
"""
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from hive_store_support import BEE, BEE2, BEEBOU, BotRef, ControlledHost, SCOPE, activate, open_repository
from server_engine.hive_slot_release import HiveSlotRelease, SlotReleaseStatus, bee_runtime_scope
from server_engine.workswarm_adapter import WorkSwarmAdapter
from test_hive_slot_release import Wire

SHA = '70fcc5f759480e466530438a4565ad03945e0d90'
assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip() == SHA


class HiveReleaseProbe(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def scenario(self, stale_question):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            store, repo = open_repository(root / 'workspace.db', slot_capacity=2)
            self.addCleanup(store.close)
            await activate(repo, BEEBOU, 'main', now_ms=1)
            await activate(repo, BEE, 'bee-1', now_ms=2)
            await activate(repo, BEE2, 'bee-2', now_ms=3)
            old = await repo.read_bot_binding(SCOPE, BEE.id)
            scope_id = bee_runtime_scope(SCOPE, BEE.id, old.session_ref, old.generation)
            wire = Wire()
            adapter = WorkSwarmAdapter({}, root / 'swarm', connect=wire.connect)
            session = await adapter.open_scoped_session(scope_id, persist_session=False)
            if stale_question:
                adapter.questions[session]['stale-question'] = {'source': 'ask_user_interrupt'}
                adapter._save_questions(session)
            await adapter.close_session(session)
            adapter = WorkSwarmAdapter({}, root / 'swarm', connect=wire.connect)
            incoming = await activate(repo, BotRef('bee-3', 'bee'), 'activate-new', now_ms=4)
            self.assertEqual(incoming.status.value, 'PENDING')
            eviction = await repo.read_eviction(SCOPE, incoming.eviction_id)
            self.assertEqual(eviction.victim_bot_id, BEE.id)
            worker = HiveSlotRelease(repo, adapter, scope=SCOPE, host=ControlledHost.TOKEN)
            outcomes = [await worker.release(SCOPE, incoming.eviction_id)]
            if outcomes[0].status is not SlotReleaseStatus.CONFIRMED:
                for _ in range(2):
                    page = await worker.run_once()
                    self.assertEqual(len(page), 1)
                    outcomes.extend(page)
            if stale_question:
                self.assertEqual([o.status for o in outcomes], [SlotReleaseStatus.NOT_RELEASED] * 3)
                self.assertEqual([o.runtime for o in outcomes], ['STILL_IN_USE'] * 3)
                self.assertEqual(wire.unloads, [])
                self.assertEqual((await repo.read_eviction(SCOPE, incoming.eviction_id)).state, 'CLAIMED')
                self.assertEqual((await repo.read_activation_operation(SCOPE, 'activate-new')).status.value, 'PENDING')
                other = await repo.read_bot_binding(SCOPE, BEE2.id)
                self.assertEqual(other.state.value, 'ACTIVE')
                other_scope = bee_runtime_scope(SCOPE, BEE2.id, other.session_ref, other.generation)
                other_status, proof = await adapter.release_scoped_session(other_scope)
                self.assertEqual(other_status, 'NEVER_OPENED')
                self.assertTrue(proof)
            else:
                self.assertEqual(outcomes[0].status, SlotReleaseStatus.CONFIRMED)
                self.assertEqual(wire.unloads, [session])
                self.assertEqual((await repo.read_activation_operation(SCOPE, 'activate-new')).status.value, 'ACTIVE')
            print(f'saved_question={stale_question} statuses={[o.status.value for o in outcomes]} '
                  f'runtime={[o.runtime for o in outcomes]} gateway_unloads={len(wire.unloads)}')

    async def test_stale_saved_question_blocks_same_claim_after_restart(self):
        await self.scenario(True)

    async def test_no_saved_question_releases_and_hands_over(self):
        await self.scenario(False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)

```

</details>

### Version Information

- 复现的 main：`70fcc5f759480e466530438a4565ad03945e0d90`（2026-11-17 22:12:19 +0800）。
- 生产镜像 digest、源码 SHA、该状态在现网是否存在：未验证。
- 关联旧版问题：#1932（`v0.1.12`），机制是 30 秒暂避与旧队列维护撞期；本 issue 是新的 Hive Store / Host 释放路径，不能等同旧版事故。

### Screenshots / Recordings

以下为关联历史问题 #1062 的真实客户端截图，仅用于展示相近的容量阻断用户体验；**不是本次 Beebou / Hive 隔离复现截图，也不能证明本问题已在现网发生**。本次证据为上述脚本及测试结果。

![关联历史问题的客户端发送阻断截图，非本次 Hive 测试截图](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-evidence/send-blocked-20261110-1915/.screenshots/20261110-send-blocked/phone.jpg?raw=true)

### Additional Information

- 关联 #1932；相关既有 #1212 讨论旧版 busy/runtime 的有界恢复。#1632 是 Hive eviction 竞态测试的稳定性问题，非本次状态不一致。
- main 的特定抢占路径在得到实际卸载证明并完成 Store 侧约束后可清理保存的问题；需核对普通取消、重启、历史残留和不同 incarnation 的收敛路径，不宜直接批量清除。
- 建议验收：真实 `OPEN` 问题、已取消问题、Store 与 Adapter 不一致、重启、`UNKNOWN`、generation 变化、一个不可释放候选与另一个可释放候选；验证新激活最终状态及可观测性，并保留释放证明与跨代隔离。

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [ ] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.（仅结合 `v0.1.12` 代码和下述现场日志分析；尚未在后续版本完成等价端到端复验。）
- [x] I understand that environment information and reproducible steps are needed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：用户询问“今天天气怎么样”，系统询问城市后进入续跑。该续跑执行轮耗时 **214.782 秒**，最终回答深圳实时天气暂时查不到。产品 Task 标记为 `completed`，但实时天气业务未成功。

现场请求 `digitalmate-4e599cc3b6ad48678e765a0f92a39e79`，Task `turn_5002b8d306d4433ba32a65cebcfd01f1`。仅保留诊断所需请求标识，不包含工作区标识、精确位置、用户原始日志或隐私内容。

**执行轨迹（北京时间）**：

1. 11 月 17 日 07:27:56 提交天气问题；第一轮约 8.437 秒后进入等待交互，助手询问城市。
2. 续跑执行轮的 `brief` 为 5.339 秒，其中 `brief.memory` 为 0.046 秒；`execute` 为 208.939 秒，最终 `posted` 为 214.782 秒。`brief.memory` 是 `brief` 的子项，不应相加。
3. 去除外层 `tool_call` 包装记录后，`native_weather` 内层工具共调用 10 次，累计约 137.6 秒。其中：
   - 两次 `digitalmate-search` 天气入口快速失败，累计约 0.5 秒，日志记录 `182301`；
   - 三次城市解析累计约 28.3 秒，中文城市查询返回空候选，英文城市名返回候选；
   - 五次按位置 ID 或坐标查天气累计约 108.8 秒，每次约 20–24 秒，均返回 `The weather service is unavailable; try again later`。其中同一位置 ID 被查询 4 次。
4. 还曾直接请求同一个天气提供方的网页接口，约 11.1 秒后连接超时；网页搜索也失败。搜索与一次天气调用存在并行，不能把所有工具时长直接相加。
5. 07:31:55 最终回答天气暂时查不到。从原始提交到最终结果写入约 239.4 秒，包含澄清交互，不等同续跑 Run 的 214.782 秒。

**预期**：上游不可用时，应给同一用户请求设置有界的累计等待和重试；对同一地点、同一上游的重复失败及时止损，快速说明天气暂不可用。返回的产品状态或可观测指标应能区分“已生成失败说明”和“成功获取天气”。

**现场证据边界**：日志可确认天气服务不可用、重复调用和一次直接网页连接超时；尚无事故时间的底层 Bridge 网络分类日志，不能确定具体是 DNS、连接、上游 HTTP 还是其他链路问题，也不能断言提供商整体故障。天气错误被包装为 `BAD_PARAMS`，但日志不足以将故障归因于用户参数错误。未在现网重放请求。

**候选源码**：`v0.1.12` 的 [任务天气工具](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/709f4d39d613cf191d0dbb8bf1e4bec8e8695edf/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_tools_mcp.py#L347) 将请求交给 `weather.forecast`；[天气查询](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/709f4d39d613cf191d0dbb8bf1e4bec8e8695edf/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_weather.py#L101) 会访问城市解析和预报服务，默认 [PageFetcher 超时](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/709f4d39d613cf191d0dbb8bf1e4bec8e8695edf/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_watch.py#L38) 为 20 秒。现场约 20 秒的多次调用与其相符，但**事故镜像 digest 和源码 SHA 未确认，不能据此断定每次调用命中了该版本或该超时配置**。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 现场：2026-11-17，Asia/Shanghai；DigitalMate 移动端用户任务、WorkSwarm 执行记录，城市已确定为深圳。
- 证据来自授权只读的 Task、Run 和该请求的工具事件；后续澄清与原始提交属于同一 Task 的不同执行轮。
- 本次没有在目标部署中故障注入或执行真实服务端对照，也未验证事故时客户端构建号、容器网络环境及镜像 digest。
- 复现建议：使用 `v0.1.12` 的隔离环境和受控天气提供方，令同一地点返回服务不可用/超时；记录每次工具调用、总等待和最终结果，比较调用一次即失败与模型再次发起同一查询的耗时。控制其他搜索回退，不以外部服务实际状态作为测试前提。

### Version Information

- 本单分析范围：`v0.1.12`，标签指向 `709f4d39d613cf191d0dbb8bf1e4bec8e8695edf`。
- 现场真实运行镜像与该源码提交的对应关系未证实。
- **后续版本是否会复现相同的端到端问题尚不确定**。main 已变化；修复状态及实际路由需在目标版本、Beebou/Bee 实际调用链上单独复验，不能用本单证明后续版本已经修复或仍必然复现。

### Screenshots / Recordings

下图来自关联历史问题 #1338 的 test-7 真机模拟器天气查询截图，仅用于展示相似的“已识别城市但天气服务不可用”用户体验；**不是本次 214.782 秒现场截图，也不能证明两次问题根因相同**。本次证据是上述脱敏时间线和请求 ID。

![历史 test-7 天气服务不可用截图，非本次长耗时现场](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/90ab316d72efe482cb16ff402839aaa1d4653d3e/.github/issue-assets/main-acceptance-b67218b3/weather-zh.png?raw=true)

### Additional Information

- 关联 #1338：此前已识别城市但天气服务不可用；本单新增**同一请求重复尝试及 200 多秒耗时**的现场。
- 关联 #1775：城市解析的正常路径多轮往返；本单重点是**服务异常时的重试与累计等待**。
- 关联 #1921：中文城市解析为空或候选校验问题；本单不将中文空候选认定为天气预报不可用的根因。
- 建议验收：同一位置重复失败时的请求级总预算、失败类型与可见提示；独立与非独立回退源；城市解析缓存/消歧；正常天气成功、上游恢复、真实用户追问和不可用场景；保留底层分阶段、脱敏错误与耗时日志。超时数值和重试次数应由 owner 根据目标环境评估，不把建议值当作已部署配置。

issue:1940.body:
### 🐞 问题描述

用户请求“帮我看看 openJiuwen-ai/jiuwenswarm 最近几个月的 star 增长趋势”，任务最终完成，但从提交到结果发布耗时 **166.606 秒**。Agent 尝试 GitHub stargazers 接口遇到 404 后，连续开展环境和接口探查；转向第三方 Star History 图表后，又通过多轮工具调用解析 SVG 估算月度趋势。轻量查询中，外部数据不可用后的探索过程缺少及时收敛，导致用户等待较长时间。

这是一次现网日志回溯，尚未在受控环境复现，也未确认现场服务端镜像和源码提交；不据此断定当前 main 或任何特定版本必然存在同样的问题。

### 现场及执行轨迹

- 时间：2026-11-16 08:16–08:19（Asia/Shanghai）。
- 请求：`digitalmate-27a907c1167248ae98066c57e0203e19`；Task 结果 `completed`。
- `posted`：166.606 秒；其中 `brief`：5.114 秒（含 `brief.memory` 3.190 秒），`execute`：160.035 秒。`brief.memory` 已包含在 `brief` 中，不重复累加。
- 08:16:57 起尝试分页获取 stargazers 时间戳，记录出现 HTTP 404；随后继续测试接口、速率限制、其他仓库以及运行环境和认证配置，至约 08:17:47。
- 08:17:49 左右转向第三方 Star History，一次网页获取取得 SVG 内容，另一次返回 404。之后 Agent 多次调用工具提取坐标轴及折线路径、换算月度数据、校准时间轴并生成图表，最后一次图表生成调用约在 08:19:02，回答约在 08:19:23 输出。
- 最终报告中的月度走势由 SVG 曲线估算，并非从逐条 Star 事件直接汇总；估算值需要明确标注来源和精度。

这次执行记录包含 18 次工具调用（16 次 bash、2 次 fetch_webpage）。工具调用时长相加约 20.8 秒；考虑并行重叠后，其时间区间并集约 19.9 秒。`execute` 其余约 140.2 秒尚未精确归因，可能包括模型往返、调度、结果传递及等待，**不能直接认定全部是模型耗时**。18 次工具调用也不等于 18 次模型调用。

模型用量汇总中累计输入约 113 万 token、输出约 2.3 万 token；这是多轮累计值，缓存 token 属于输入的一部分。这些数字本身不能证明单次上下文超限或用户数据量过大是主要原因。准备阶段的记忆读取约 3.2 秒，也不足以解释本次长耗时。

### 已确认与待调查

已确认：初始 GitHub 取数尝试多次出现 404，之后发生多轮诊断及图表解析；最终任务完成，月度趋势来自图形近似换算。

待调查：404 是接口地址、认证、代理、网络出口或其他因素造成，现有日志不足以确定；不能将其直接归因于 GitHub 故障或 Token 无效。工具之外约 140 秒的构成、各模型轮次耗时、诊断重复的决策机制，以及现场服务端代码版本仍需补充证据。

### 预期与建议

1. 对同一请求内相似的失败探查设置可配置的累计时间或尝试预算，保留一次有针对性的错误诊断，并在无法确定原因时及时给出清楚的降级结果；不要把建议阈值当作现有配置。
2. 评估为此类查询提供可靠、结构化的历史数据获取及月度汇总能力；若使用第三方图表估算，应标注数据来源、时间范围与近似性质，避免把曲线估算值表述为精确原始数据。
3. 记录可关联的模型轮次耗时、工具调用和错误分类、数据源及降级原因，区分并行与串行耗时，避免记录凭据或用户私有数据。

### 复现与验收建议

在隔离环境固定 DigitalMate、WorkSwarm、模型和配置版本，用受控数据源模拟 stargazers 接口持续 404，同时提供可用的结构化历史数据或 SVG 图表。记录从提交到最终答案的时间、模型及工具次数、不同阶段的累计耗时，核验失败探查能在预算内收敛，结果对用户明确标注来源和精度；同时覆盖接口正常、可恢复失败、替代数据源也不可用的场景。真实外部服务与目标版本的端到端验收需另行执行。

### 关联问题

- #1031：另一条 Star 查询中全历史搜索耗时 300 秒；本单关注接口 404 后的环境探查与图表解析，现场路径不同。
- #1938：天气服务异常后重复查询导致长耗时；可共同评估请求级失败探查预算，但不能据此推断两者根因相同。
- #974：云侧首吐字与工具调用指标核验；本单补充模型轮次、数据源及降级决策的归因需求。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

在已部署 #1924（`describe_capabilities` + Host 派生能力事实）的 20026 环境上，用户连续两次问「那你当前有什么能力」，出现两个问题：

**1. 同一条提问首轮直接失败，且给的是通用兜底文案**

第一次提问的回复是：

```
抱歉，这条消息没能处理完成。我还记得你的请求，你可以再发一次，或直接说"重试"。
(Sorry, I could not finish replying to this message. I still have your request: send it again, or just say "try again".)
```

没有说明失败原因，用户只能盲目重发。同一句话第二次发送才正常作答，说明首次失败是确定性的（而非偶发网络问题），但当前没有任何可诊断信息暴露。

**2. 重试后的能力清单仍只覆盖 Beebou 自身工具，没有覆盖可委派能力**

第二次回答只列出三组：

```
1. 调度 / 管理 Bee（工作代理）
   - 查看有哪些 Bee、状态、在手任务
   - 新建 / 激活 Bee，派任务、加补充指令
   - 转达 Bee 在等你的问题，把你的回答传回去
2. 检索你的记忆（在你授权范围内，查你以前留下的记忆）
3. 检索你的历史对话（按关键词找以前的对话）
```

而按 #1924 的设计，`beebou_capability_facts()` 从 `dm_hive_tools` catalog 派生，read 组工具在该版本中全部 `enabled=true` 且 `beebou=true`、`bee=true`：

```
read_file, list_files, glob, grep, read_pdf
```

因此「读取工作区文件与附件」本应作为可用能力出现（write / exec / skill / weather / deliver 同理，取决于 catalog 状态），但回答里完全没有这些组，也没有 #1924 要求的四态表述（现在可以 / 需授权 / 不支持 / 尚未核实）。

结果上，这仍是 #1842 描述的老问题：用户问“整体助手能做什么”时，得到的是主控自身工具清单，而不是“整体助手（含可委派 Bee）”的事实口径。

**影响**：能力类问题是用户判断“能不能把活交给它”的第一入口；当前回答会让用户低估可用能力，也会把“图片/文件不支持”与“整体没有工具”混为一谈。

**期望**

1. 能力类提问首轮失败时，返回可定位的原因（例如工具调用失败/超时），或直接重试一次再答复，而不是抛通用兜底句。
2. 能力回答必须来自 `describe_capabilities`，覆盖 catalog 中所有可用组（含 read/write/exec/skill/deliver），并按四态区分；catalog 之外统一 `unverified`。
3. 图片能力应明确说明“当前不支持图片，可改用 PDF/文本”，而不是笼统否认整体能力。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 端：DigitalMate HarmonyOS 客户端，20026 验收包，基线 main `19fbc99bc` + #1924，集成提交 `c73553edc9ea595b24f801b81252f2a9f457637c`，HAP sha256 `f41323fcf41db890819a52c6bbadd0d7f3ed7772d5d624da401fd421189eab9c`
- 云：`swr.ap-southeast-1.myhuaweicloud.com/openjiuwen-online-test/digitalmate:pr1924-20261117-2133-c73553e-test-6`，digest `sha256:82bf382068d731fcce092a5f155c999dd90cc2aa74ed70936d0b0adf7cc9db4c`
- 环境：ADX `adx-jiuwen-test-6`（tenant `jiuwen-test-6`），入口 `wss://onlineswarm.openjiuwen.com:20026/digitalmate/ws`
- 部署态核对：alias `production` → version 24（weight 1）；binding `current.version=24`、`phase=active`、`secondary=null`；`environments.current.status=running`，image 即上条 digest 对应 tag
- 复现时间：2026-11-17 23:4x（Asia/Shanghai）

### Additional Information

- 关联：#1842（能力口径）、#1924（本次实现，PR）、#1761（能力预检 umbrella）、#1762（Home 附件边界：目前仅 PDF，图片在派发阶段被拒）、#1665（汇总页）
- 代码定位（`c73553edc`）：`harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/hive_beebou_agentcore.py`（`beebou_capability_facts`）、`hive_beebou_tools.py`（`describe_capabilities`）、`temp/hive-beebou/src/dm_hive_beebou/selection.py`（提示词口径）、`temp/hive-tools/src/dm_hive_tools/config/tools.toml`（catalog；注意 `image_ocr` 在不可调用清单内）

issue:1949.body:
Part of #1665. Found by the Bridge suite triage in #1948 ([report](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/claude/bridge-ut-triage-3bde13/docs/plans/bridge-ut-triage-2026-11-18.md), group "Hive modules call mkstemp/TemporaryDirectory(dir=...)").

**Problem.** `tests/test_engine_files.py::test_the_bridge_makes_no_temporary_file_or_folder_through_tempfile_in_its_own_folders` forbids `mkstemp(` and `TemporaryDirectory(dir=...)` in Bridge sources: every temporary file must go through `open_temporary`, and every temporary folder placed in one of DigitalMate's own folders through `make_temporary_directory`. Four Hive modules (first: `hive_attachment_inputs.py`) break that rule on `main`.

**Reproduce.** From `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge`, with the vendored runtime installed (`harness/personal-agent/deploy/install_runtime.py`):

```
python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --timeout 120 tests/test_engine_files.py -k no_temporary -vv
```

Fails every time (also alone). The `-vv` output lists the four files.

**Done when.** The four modules use the helpers and the test passes.

issue:1950.body:
Part of #1665. Found by the Bridge suite triage in #1948 ([report](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/claude/bridge-ut-triage-3bde13/docs/plans/bridge-ut-triage-2026-11-18.md), group "Home text attachment returns FORBIDDEN").

**Problem.** `tests/test_hive_home_input_pdf.py::test_authenticated_home_pdf_is_retained` uploads a `text/plain` attachment to the Home room and sends `room.message` with its `source_id`. The server answers `{'code': 'FORBIDDEN', 'message': 'The original Home PDF is unavailable'}`; the test expects `BAD_PARAMS` with `details.reason == 'home_attachment_format_unsupported'` and `accepted: False`. The earlier steps of the test (quote with PDF, foreign source id, duplicate source ids) behave as expected, so the format check seems to run after, or be masked by, the PDF-availability check. Last changes around this code: 954748bc8 (#1760), 79754ee8d.

**Reproduce.** From `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge`, with the vendored runtime installed:

```
python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --timeout 120 -o asyncio_mode=auto tests/test_hive_home_input_pdf.py -k authenticated
```

(`-o asyncio_mode=auto` is needed until the Bridge pytest config sets it.) Fails every time at `tests/test_hive_home_input_pdf.py:58`.

**Done when.** An unsupported-format attachment returns `BAD_PARAMS` / `home_attachment_format_unsupported` without leaking PDF state, or the test is corrected with the reason recorded.

issue:1955.body:
### Checklist
- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

Location from the gateway IP (#1191) no longer reaches a Home turn. b261db165 (`refactor(hive): require Hive Home and remove the Bridge router`, 2026-11-16) made Hive Home the only `room.message` path, and that path never reads the socket's location.

- `server.py` (around line 5078) still resolves the gateway client IP for each socket through `GeoIPLocator` and sets the current location for that connection.
- `current_location()` is read only when the engine creates a task (`engine_service.py`, around line 2803). The engine copies it into `Task.client_location`, which weather and free web search use (`engine_weather.py`, `engine_web_search.provider_for(country_code=...)`).
- A Home `room.message` is now answered by Beebou Home (`hive_home_trial.py`) and creates no engine task. The per-socket country therefore never reaches the turn's tools, and region-aware search and weather fall back to no country.

Found while repairing the Bridge suite baseline for `server-ut-st` (#1014, triage #1948). The test that covered this, `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_user_location.py::test_gateway_location_reaches_task_without_leaking_between_sockets`, now runs with the Hive Home profile. It fails on its real assertion and is left failing until this is decided:

- Expected: each socket's Home message carries the country of that socket's gateway IP (CN for one socket, HK for the other, concurrently, with the raw IP never stored).
- Actual: `room.message` returns no `task_id` (`KeyError: 'task_id'`), and no Home-turn record carries a location.

Decision needed: should Hive Home turns carry the socket's coarse location to Beebou and its tools, as the legacy task path did? issue:1958.body:
### Checklist
- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

`Bridge.stop()` called while `Bridge.start()` is still blocked does not cancel the startup cleanly. After the producer deadline (`SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SECONDS / 10`, about 1 s) it raises `Bridge shutdown failed` with `startup shutdown exceeded its deadline`.

Cause, in `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/server.py` (main 8c4148b9f):
- `_stop()` (around line 1392) cancels `self._startup_task`, adds it to the `producers` it waits for under `"startup"`, and waits for it to settle.
- The cancelled startup task enters `start()`'s `except BaseException` handler (around line 1317). The handler sets `self._startup_task = None` and then `await self.stop()`.
- `stop()` finds the shutdown task already running and waits for it. That shutdown task is `_stop()`, which is waiting for the startup task.
- Each waits on the other until the deadline. Clearing `_startup_task` in the handler does not help, because `_stop()` captured the task before that.

The handler's comment says the existing stop "must never cancel/await this task", but `_stop()` does both.

Found while repairing the Bridge suite baseline for `server-ut-st` (#1014, triage #1948). `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_bridge_shutdown.py::BridgeShutdownTest::test_stop_cancels_startup_before_producers_start` used to hang to the timeout because it patched a backend instance that the Hive Home startup replaces. The Bridge test-cleanup PR fixes the patch point (it now patches `ScriptedBackend.start`), and the test now fails on this deadlock:

- Expected: `stop()` cancels the blocked `start()`, no producer starts, and `stop()` returns without an error.
- Actual: `stop()` raises the shutdown `ExceptionGroup` with the startup deadline timeout after about 1 s.

The test is left failing until this is fixed.

When `python -m server_engine` (`engine_cli serve`) cannot open its workspace, it exits before listening with code 1 but prints a Python traceback instead of a one-line, named error.

- Exit code 1 and no `listening` line.
- No traceback.
- The last stderr line is the named one-line message.
- A traceback is still printed for unexpected errors, as `test_garbage_rules_json_still_names_invalid_json` checks.
