issue:1970.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

同一查询的两次现网执行中，`brief.memory` 分别耗时 6,609 ms 和 6,333 ms。用同一工作区的实际记忆库独立只读执行该查询，三次耗时为 50–64 ms（中位数约 51 ms），命中一致。独立查询绕过了 Agent Bridge 进程内的调度和共享锁。现有 Run 只能看到 `brief.memory` 的总耗时，缺少拿到读许可、工作线程启动和拿到后端锁的时间点，暂时无法归因这段差值。

关联 #1030。本 issue 落实其中 Agent Bridge 产品记忆检索的读路径分段计时。

### Design Ideas

以下路径相对于 `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/`，行号以 `26790238f9fc` 为参考。

| 代码位置 | 具体打点 |
| --- | --- |
| `engine_brief.py:1363` · `turn_reading()` | 在 `timed("brief.memory")` 内把记忆检索与当前 Turn、Run、attempt 或 trace 关联，保留外层总耗时。 |
| `memory/catalog.py:1500` · `EngineMemory.search_async()`，以及 `:1578` · `_search_page()` | 在目录页读取及其目录锁前后计时，在结果校验、去重和排序前后计时。为每次实际后端读取分配 `operation_id`，记录页数、候选数和命中数。 |
| `memory/catalog.py:1160` · `EngineMemory._read_backend()` | 在 `await self._read_gate.acquire()` 前和成功返回后分别记 `gate_wait_start`、`gate_acquired`。创建异步任务前记调度时间，在被调度的协程实际调用 `asyncio.to_thread()` 提交默认执行器时记 `executor_submit`，以便区分事件循环调度和线程池排队。在 `await asyncio.shield(job)` 返回或取消时记录调用方结果，在 `finished` 回调释放许可时记 `gate_released`。由设置超时的调用点记录超时结果。 |
| `memory/catalog.py:1156` · `EngineMemory._locked_read()` | 工作线程进入函数的第一行记 `worker_start`，进入 `with self._backend_read_lock` 前记 `lock_wait_start`，进入锁内立即记 `lock_acquired`。在 `operation()` 退出时记录后端调用完成和结果，在锁释放后记录完成。正常和异常路径均应保留这些边界。 |
| `engine_service.py:1239` · `EngineService.snapshot_async()`，以及 `memory/catalog.py:1412` · `EngineMemory._read_contents_async()` | 在创建列表任务时标记来源为 `snapshot`。补齐 `_batch_gate`、执行器提交和工作线程启动的时间点，为同一把后端锁补齐申请、获取和释放时间，覆盖 `get_many`、批量失败后的逐条回退和单条 `get`。同时区分搜索与读取操作类型，便于关联等待方和占锁方。批量列表按操作汇总并限制明细量。 |

通过单调时钟计算读许可等待 `gate_acquired - gate_wait_start`、线程池排队 `worker_start - executor_submit`、后端锁等待 `lock_acquired - lock_wait_start`，并记录后端执行和回到调用方的时间。沿用现有服务端诊断输出，用同一个 `operation_id` 关联异步任务、工作线程和完成回调。调用方超时或取消后，仍记录实际运行的后端操作及最终许可释放。未到达的阶段留空。在锁外写出诊断数据，字段限于阶段、操作类型、关联标识和计数，排除查询文本、记忆内容及工作区数据路径。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- 分别人为延迟读许可、默认执行器、后端锁和后端调用，验证耗时落在对应阶段。单独延迟异步任务调度，验证它与线程池排队可区分。
- 让 snapshot 列表与记忆搜索并发，验证诊断能关联同一把锁的等待方和占用方，检索结果及原有读取顺序保持一致。
- 覆盖正常完成、超时和取消。调用方已经返回且后台读取继续时，同一 `operation_id` 仍能查到后台结束和许可释放。未启动阶段没有耗时值。
- 在多页检索中，能沿 `brief.memory` 时间线归集目录读取、后端读取、结果校验及其间的等待，同一时间段只计一次。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

打点位于 Agent Bridge 的请求准备、记忆目录和 snapshot 列表读路径，沿用现有 Run/trace 诊断契约。

issue:1981.body:
### Background and Goal Description

天气故障 #1938 的续跑记录了云侧首文本和最终回复写入。云侧续跑为 214.782 秒。复盘还需要知道用户提交城市后多久第一次看到回复，以及时间花在端侧排队、网络传输、云侧执行还是客户端展示。

当前 `DigitalMateTrajectory` 能记录端侧收到文本和展示完成。`profiling-report.mjs` 按 `task_id` 查找云 trace，而同一个 Task 可以有追问、续跑和重试多个执行轮。需要增加正文首次可见事件，并让同一诊断样本准确关联到本轮端云记录。[端侧轨迹](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/87442f2f3b1a2c094ea23a6f27911a643296c525/digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/digitalmate/DigitalMateTrajectory.ets#L269-L295) · [现有报告关联](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/87442f2f3b1a2c094ea23a6f27911a643296c525/tests/e2e/workflow/profiling-report.mjs#L218-L244)

本 RFC 定义联合观测与验收契约。端侧首文本基础采集复用 #972，跨机单程与时钟校准沿用 #973，云侧执行与工具指标引用 #974。迁移路径使用 #772 已声明的关联身份。#555 是未合入的采集草稿，可供设计参考。

### Proposed Solution

#### 时延要求

| 指标 | 取点 |
| --- | --- |
| 端侧提交与排队 | 点击发送或确认澄清 → 本次传输尝试开始发送 |
| 上行与受理 | 此次发送 → 实际云侧入口收到同一请求 → 受理完成。可在设备上另算发送到 ACK 的往返耗时 |
| 云侧处理与推送排队 | 受理完成 → 首段可展示正文就绪 → 实际下行发送。另记最终结果提交成功时间 |
| 下行 | 云侧实际下发正文帧或结果响应 → 端侧收到同一帧或响应 |
| 端侧展示 | 收到携带正文的数据 → 本轮非空回复正文第一次进入前台可见区 |
| 用户等待 | 端侧提交 → 同轮正文首次可见。整条回复展示完毕用现有 `display_done` 口径单独统计 |

流式回复可在最终提交前上屏。一次性回复和快照回退另量最终结果提交到首次可见。保留澄清、正常回复和失败提示的类型，正文观测与进度占位、空帧区分。聚合输出样本数、可配对覆盖率、缺失原因和有效样本的 P50/P95，业务时延目标由实测基线另定。

同一端的时间差使用单调时钟。上下行单程值要求同一次请求或同一响应帧配对，并有可核验的跨机时钟误差界。证据不足时该段留空并标明原因，端侧往返仍可从同一台设备计算。区间按实际接入节点命名，例如 Bridge 与前置网关各记各自的接收和发送事件。单程值以选定的应用层边界为准。[性能观测指南](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/87442f2f3b1a2c094ea23a6f27911a643296c525/docs/guides/testing/profiling.md#L96-L106)

#### 实施思路

1. **提交与关联。** 在 `DigitalMateHome` 的消息提交和 `submitPendingAnswer()` 路径建立本轮轨迹，覆盖 Hive 澄清提交。以贯通的本轮关联 ID 串起端侧提交、云侧受理和回复，记录它到 `task_id`、本轮 `run_id` 及实际运行时请求 ID 的映射。普通传输重试沿用本轮关联 ID，各次传输保留尝试标识。澄清续跑单独关联。同名的客户端 WebSocket `request_id` 和 WorkSwarm 请求 ID 分别记录。[澄清提交](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/87442f2f3b1a2c094ea23a6f27911a643296c525/digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets#L3850-L3867)
2. **云侧入口、提交与发送。** 在实际接入层记录收包与对应的受理结果。在 Bridge WebSocket 路由，收包点靠近读循环，发送点位于取得写锁后、`ws.send_str()` 前。正文入推送队列与实际出站分别记时，云端和设备配对的是合并后的实际下行帧。最终结果取 Store 对应提交成功的事件，Bridge 兼容路径可核对发布事务返回和 `stream.finish()` 的先后。[Bridge 收发](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/87442f2f3b1a2c094ea23a6f27911a643296c525/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/server.py#L5273-L5318) · [结果提交](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/87442f2f3b1a2c094ea23a6f27911a643296c525/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_service.py#L4575-L4586)
3. **端侧收包与首次可见。** `DigitalMateSocket` 的 `message` 回调提供收包时间，解析后绑定同一条数据。`DigitalMateHome.ChatRowContent()` 的正文容器增加可见区取点，页面在前台且本轮有实际正文时，向 `DigitalMateTrajectory` 记录一次 `first_visible`。流式、一次性推送和快照回退都进入同一可见判定。记录在已有轨迹保留窗口内可以补入稍晚的首显事件。[端侧收包](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/87442f2f3b1a2c094ea23a6f27911a643296c525/digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/digitalmate/DigitalMateSocket.ets#L53-L59) · [正文渲染](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/87442f2f3b1a2c094ea23a6f27911a643296c525/digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets#L5402-L5416)
4. **联合取证。** 复用设备的 `digitalmate-trajectory.json`、云侧结构化日志与现有 profiling 导出。报告按本轮关联 ID 配对，保留实际交付方式和取点覆盖情况。先跑通设备导出加云侧采集的联合报告。现有 `diagnostics.bundle` 支持打包调用方传入的 `client_log`，可作为受控导出的接入点，再评估如何按一个 ID 查询。端侧团队负责收包、正文可见和本地导出，实际网关与运行时 owner 提供云侧时间点及身份映射，诊断工具消费两侧记录。

### Involved Public APIs

优先复用现有提交、交互、回复和快照携带的身份。确需跨端传递时，评审可选的诊断关联字段与帧身份，由实际发送方生成，设备与报告消费。字段缺失时按旧协议处理，报告标记缺段。轨迹字段限定为关联身份、阶段、时间、交付方式与结果，沿用现有诊断导出范围和有界保留，导出在聊天关键路径之外。

### Test Verification

- 用验收环境的实际 HarmonyOS 页面和云侧路由复现「询问天气 → 追问城市 → 提交答案」。一份报告可按 ID 找到续跑、云侧请求和本轮首次上屏。追问和续跑的可见事件分别归到各自轮次，同一 Task 多轮及相邻并发任务都能正确配对。
- 覆盖流式首段、一次性结果、断线重连后快照恢复、同一执行轮重试和下行帧合并。验证只有当前前台会话的回复正文实际进入可见区才记首显，重复帧只产生一次，离屏结果在首次进入可见区时记录。
- 用受控延迟、时钟偏移、丢帧与错配样本核对各阶段。可配对样本能从原事件复算。取点缺失、时钟误差超界和未观察到上屏分别可识别，并显示对应覆盖率。验收报告注明 HAP、服务端版本、实际路由及诊断采集开关。

### Before submitting a new issue

- [x] Please confirm that you have searched the previous RFC documents

issue:1982.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

一条现网 `FRESH` 请求从 Bridge 进入 `execute` 到网关首条本轮消息日志耗时 **5.674 秒**。现有产品记录与 WorkSwarm 日志可对齐以下三个区间。

| 现场边界 | 耗时 |
| --- | ---: |
| `execute` 开始 → 网关开始向 AgentServer 转发 `session.create` | 3.548 秒 |
| 网关转发 `session.create` → AgentServer 记录创建完成 | 0.207 秒，其中 AgentServer 处理为 0.176 秒 |
| AgentServer 记录创建完成 → 网关首条本轮 `chat.send` 相关日志 | 1.919 秒 |

同一问法随后走 `REUSE` 并继续使用同一物理会话，对应总区间为 **0.884 秒**。需要把首次请求的创建前准备、创建回包和发送前准备分段，才能判断慢在锁、建连、状态落盘、RPC 还是任务工具配置。关联 #1030 的诊断日志总需求，连接及发送结果可供 #1240 对照。

### Design Ideas

打点归 Agent Bridge，路径相对于 `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/`。下列行号以 `26790238f9fc` 为参考，主干同名执行边界已核对。

| 代码位置 | 具体打点边界 |
| --- | --- |
| `engine_service.py:4169` 的 `timed("execute")`，`server.py:2228` 的 `_digitalmate_execute()` 和 `:2341` 的 `_execute_jiuwen()` | 沿用 `execute` 起点，记录执行入口到进入会话打开的耗时。调用发生时，单独记录 `require_factories()` 和 `verify_at_invoke()` 的起止。记录产品 `FRESH`/`REUSE` 和实际物理会话打开分支。 |
| `workswarm_adapter.py:1326` 的 `open_scoped_session()` | 在等 `open_lock` 前和拿到后打点。在实际 `await self.connect(self.url)` 前后打点，区分打开锁等待和 WebSocket 建连。注明本轮是新建、直接复用现有连接、重连校验还是恢复创建。 |
| `workswarm_adapter.py:1259` 的 `_create()` | 在 `_remember(..., state='creating')` 和 `_factory_parameters()` 前后分别打点。`session.create` 回包后，拆出 `_remember_runtime()` 和 `_remember(..., state='ready')` 的持久化耗时。 |
| `workswarm_transport.py:258` 的 `GatewaySession._request_frame()`、`:104` 的 `_read()` | 对 `session.create`、`chat.send` 记录各自 wire request ID、`await self.socket.send()` 开始与返回、reader 将匹配响应交给 pending waiter 的时刻和调用方退出结果。用 wire ID 对齐网关既有事件。`chat.send` 的发送边界用于本段，响应等待单独记录。 |
| `server.py:2387` 的会话绑定分支，`workswarm_adapter.py:2357` 的 `_prepare_turn()`，`:1862` 的 `_install_tool_server()` 与 `:1896` 的 `_write_tool_entries()` | 记录会话打开返回、Task 会话绑定事务完成及 `after_session_open()` 完成。发送前记录物理会话发送锁的等待、`_prepare_turn()` 起止。进入 MCP 配置写入时，拆出 `tool_config_lock` 等待、工作线程启动、`portalocker` 文件锁等待、配置重写；命中已有配置时记录复用分支。普通流和 retained context 共用的准备及传输入口统一记录。 |

在现有 Bridge 诊断日志中，以 Turn/Task 和本次 attempt 关联两个 wire request ID，记录连接、物理会话标识、阶段、单调时钟耗时与受控结果。沿实际执行顺序记录，到达的阶段才有时间值。创建、发送和回包分别反映相应边界。锁内只采时间和必要状态，锁外输出有界的结构化摘要。字段使用固定白名单。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Bridge 记录本地准备、发送和回包边界，WorkSwarm Gateway 和 AgentServer 沿用现有创建、转发与消息日志用于交叉核对。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- 分别运行首建、复用已打开会话和重连校验。首建可以串起 `execute`、创建回包、绑定、`chat.send` 与现有网关事件。复用可直接看到复用分支和实际经过的准备阶段。
- 分别用受控阻塞拉长 `open_lock`、WebSocket 建连、`creating` 状态落盘、创建回包、MCP 文件锁和配置重写。看日志能够定位到注入的阶段，父区间与子阶段归算避免重复。
- 覆盖创建与发送时的取消、超时及连接中断。验收实际到达的阶段和结果标记，并用原有用例核对幂等创建、连接复用和发送行为。
- 比较打点开启前后相同负载下的发送前时延、首字延迟和日志量。用带测试占位内容的录制核对诊断字段白名单。

issue:1983.body:
### Background and Goal Description

Weather is being re-enabled (#1335, #1921). Weather, food and places-of-interest requests often name no place: "how's the weather tomorrow", "明天要带伞吗", "附近有啥好吃的". DigitalMate has to decide which place such a request means:
- **A place from the conversation.** You talked about a trip to Vancouver and immediately ask about tomorrow's weather.
- **Where the person is now.** The same question two hours later, which is probably unrelated to the trip.
- **Unknown.** In that case it should ask.

Today nothing makes this decision:
- **Beebou can't tell time.** Its model input carries no message times or current date, so it cannot tell a 2-hour gap from 2 seconds, or which day "tomorrow" is.
- **The device-city rules don't cover it.** The device-city contract (`DWC-C3`, #1926) forbids inferring a city from the IP address, memory, a cache or a default, and requires asking when the phone has no city. It does not say when to use the conversation's place instead of asking the phone.
- **Delegation loses the context.** A Bee does not see the chat, so a place from the conversation is lost unless Beebou writes it into the task.
- **Home weather is too narrow.** It is a single configured city, triggered by one exact consent sentence and for today only.

Goal: a verifiable rule for which place a location-dependent request means, and for when the Host asks the phone for its city, asks the person, or keeps the chat going. It must land before the device-city reader is registered as a Bee tool (#1335).

### Proposed Solution

Design note: `docs/implementations/contracts/place-resolution-v1.md` (draft PR to follow).
- **Order:** a place named in the message, then a fresh place from the conversation, then the current location (with permission), then ask with a choice card.
- **Time context:** the Host stamps each user message in the model input with the local date and the gap since the previous message. The Host, not the model, decides whether the conversation's place is still fresh, using a time limit in a config file.
- **Tool argument:** tools that need a place (`native_weather`, place and food search, and the device-city reader) take a `place` argument with a `source` (`named`, `conversation`, `current_location`) and a quoted span from the message. The Host verifies the quote and refuses a stale `conversation` place. The device-city reader runs only for `current_location`.
- **Delegation:** a `create_bee` request for a location-dependent task carries the resolved `place`.
- **When unsure:** a one-tap `ask_choice` card with the conversation's place, "Where I am now" and "Another city". The answer always names the place it used.
- **Test set:** English and Chinese phrasings (weather, food, places of interest), each crossed with timing and context.

### Open questions
1. The default time limit for a fresh place (proposed: 30 minutes).
2. After the limit: ask with the card, or use the current location and say so.
3. Precision for food and places of interest: city level, or upgrade to a precise location on request (ADR 0025).
4. Trip-date mismatch: "trip to Vancouver next month" plus "weather tomorrow" probably means here. Is it enough to leave this to the model, given dates?

Refs #1335, #1921, #1926, #1955, ADR 0025, ADR 0026, ADR 0033. Part of #737.

issue:1988.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

一次现网请求从 WorkSwarm 网关入队到 Agent 根 span 开始耗时 **3.561 秒**，其中 Adapter 记录「处理流式请求」到 `run_stream_task started` 占 **2.476 秒**。同一问法复用同一个物理会话时，这段准备耗时 **3.512 秒**。现有起止点还拆不开会话 Adapter 获取、MCP 同步和流任务调度。

首次 Agent 根 span 为 **6.640 秒**，其中一轮 ReAct 为 **5.276 秒**。该次轨迹已关联到网关首段正文，但缺少本轮模型客户端 span。Agent Core 源码已有模型调用起止与首 chunk 计时，需要核对实际模型路径、父 span 和导出记录能否串起来。

本项承接 #1030 的诊断关联需求，与 #974 的首字指标核验共用计时口径。#1982 覆盖本请求进入 WorkSwarm 之前的 Bridge 发送阶段。

### Design Ideas

源码参考 `26790238f9fc`。WorkSwarm 文件相对于 `harness/workswarm/jiuwenswarm/`，Agent Core 文件相对于 `harness/agent-core/openjiuwen/`。

#### 3.2 WorkSwarm 准备并启动流任务

| 代码位置 | 需要补的点 |
| --- | --- |
| `server/runtime/agent_adapter/interface.py:3571` 的 `JiuWenSwarm.process_message_stream()` | 沿用用户历史写入后「处理流式请求」的起点。记录 `_build_inputs()` 和 `await reconcile_session_mcp()` 的开始与返回。执行澄清历史写入或 `MEMORY_BEFORE_CHAT` 钩子时，分别记录耗时。 |
| 同文件 `:4074` 的 `asyncio.create_task(run_stream_task())`，与 `:4022` 的 `run_stream_task()` 首行 | 记录流任务提交及实际开始两个时间点，区分提交前的准备和提交后等事件循环调度的耗时。 |
| `server/runtime/agent_adapter/interface_deep.py:5813` 的 `reconcile_session_mcp()`，包含 `:4113` 的 `_get_or_create_session_adapter()` | 记录获取会话 Adapter 的起止及实际命中、创建或重建分支，再分别记录 MCP 注册、卸载、`refresh_skill_rails()` 的耗时及数量。保留失败或跳过结果，使用有界汇总。 |
| `server/runtime/agent_adapter/interface_deep.py:12795` 的 `_apply_runtime_config()` | 给现有 `runtime config applied` 分项日志补 `runtime_config.request_id`。沿用 `StageTimer` 中的 `cwd_seed`、`rails_for_mode`、`session_tools` 等字段，与流启动和根 span 按请求关联。 |

#### 3.3 关联模型调用和单轮 ReAct

- 在 `extensions/observability/callback_handler.py:485` 的 `on_llm_stream_input()` 核对实际流式模型路径能打开 LLM span，在 `:528` 的 `on_llm_stream_output()` 核对现有 `gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk`，在 `:626` 的 `on_llm_stream_completed()` 和 `:686` 的错误回调核对结束及结果记录。优先复用这些事件，实际调用路径遗漏的生命周期事件在对应客户端入口补齐。
- 用 WorkSwarm `observability/runtime.py:31` 的 `log_runtime_correlation()`、现有 trajectory sink 和 Agent Core 的父 span 上下文，核对按本轮 `request_id` 能取回 LLM span 并关联到正确的 ReAct。可据此量出 ReAct 开始到模型客户端调用、调用到首 chunk、调用结束到 ReAct 结束。首 chunk 与网关首段正文沿用各自的时间点。

复用现有诊断与轨迹输出。新增分项采用单调时钟，按请求记录分支、阶段、耗时、结果及必要计数。诊断字段使用白名单，内容类字段使用计数或长度。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

WorkSwarm 负责流启动与 MCP 分项，以及诊断记录关联。Agent Core 负责模型客户端 span 的生命周期。网关已有首段正文事件用于对齐。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- 通过真实流式入口覆盖物理会话首建和复用，核对每个实际执行的准备阶段能关联到同一请求。分别人为延迟 Adapter 获取、MCP 注册和流任务调度，确认延迟归到对应阶段，父子计时可按时间线核对。
- 用有首 chunk 延迟的受控模型流，验证部署配置下从 WorkSwarm 轨迹能读到模型调用起止、首 chunk 与正确的 ReAct 关联。覆盖同一物理会话上的连续请求，以及模型流错误或取消。缺失阶段保持为空。
- 用相同负载对比加点前后的启动耗时、首段正文耗时和日志量，验证导出只包含诊断字段。

issue:1990.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

一次现网请求中，WorkSwarm 从「处理流式请求」到流任务启动耗时 **2.476 秒**。同一问法换了 Task、复用了同一物理会话，对应阶段耗时 **3.512 秒**。需要验证两次执行是否命中任务级 MCP 切换，以及它给阶段 3.2 带来的耗时。

按调查基线 `26790238f9fc`，Bridge 的 `workswarm_adapter.py::_tool_server_name()` 按 Task ID 和执行代次生成任务级 MCP 名称，`_install_tool_server()` 写入任务专属 stdio 服务，`_task_mcp_selection()` 将名称放入 `chat.send`。WorkSwarm 的 `JiuWenSwarm.process_message_stream()` 会先等待 `JiuWenSwarmDeepAdapter.reconcile_session_mcp()`。当新旧选择不同时，该方法依次等待新服务的注册、旧服务的卸载和技能刷新。注册路径包含启动 stdio 进程、握手和 `tools/list`。技能刷新还会重新读取技能状态、扫描目录和清理会话的技能基线。 [Bridge 任务级 MCP](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/26790238f9fce8f8df9fc6acc63c08643b7afdb4/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/workswarm_adapter.py#L1845-L1888) · [WorkSwarm MCP 同步](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/26790238f9fce8f8df9fc6acc63c08643b7afdb4/harness/workswarm/jiuwenswarm/server/runtime/agent_adapter/interface_deep.py#L5813-L5895) · [技能刷新](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/26790238f9fce8f8df9fc6acc63c08643b7afdb4/harness/workswarm/jiuwenswarm/server/runtime/agent_adapter/interface_deep.py#L9617-L9695)

隔离实验固定会话 Adapter，直接执行原 `reconcile_session_mcp()` 并使用真实 DigitalMate stdio 服务。5 次换 Task 耗时 **1.59–1.63 秒**，其中新进程启动和握手约 **1.46–1.51 秒**，旧服务关闭约 **99–116 毫秒**。同一 Task 重复执行时未触发注册和卸载。实验使用固定 Adapter 和技能刷新替身，覆盖真实 stdio 握手、工具枚举及关闭。现网仍需核对切换分支和各项耗时。

### Design Ideas

从 WorkSwarm 的 `reconcile_session_mcp()` 入手归因，适用范围是本轮选择了 Bridge 任务级 stdio MCP 的执行路径。以实测为依据评估缩短新服务准备、旧服务退出的关键路径，或在技能根目录和状态确实未变时减少重复技能扫描。现有按 Task 和执行代次的授权绑定、旧任务凭据的生命周期、可见工具和技能的判定是回归验收条件。

#### 依赖的打点信息

- **#1988 的 3.2 分项是本单归因和验收的前置数据。** 按 `request_id` 取到 Adapter 实际复用、创建或重建分支，MCP 注册、卸载、技能刷新各自的耗时、数量及结果，以及 `reconcile_session_mcp()` 起止到 `run_stream_task` 的边界。用这些字段确认同一物理会话换 Task 时是否发生任务级 MCP 切换，量出它的耗时贡献。
- **#1982 的发送关联字段用于核对 3.1 与 3.2。** 用 Task、执行尝试、物理会话和 `chat.send` wire request ID 串起 Bridge 与 WorkSwarm。对齐 Bridge 端任务 MCP 配置文件锁、写入及发送计时和 WorkSwarm 端注册、卸载计时，分别归账。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

WorkSwarm Adapter 是阶段 3.2 优化入口。Bridge 提供当前执行对应的 MCP 选择和请求关联字段，Agent Core 的 stdio 传输与资源管理用于核对连接及释放成本。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- 用同一物理会话、匹配的业务输入对照同一 Task 同一执行代次和连续两个 Task。使用真实 DigitalMate stdio 进程，根据 #1988 分项核对 Adapter、MCP 增删、技能刷新和流启动，记录流程分支和样本数。
- 按 #1982 和 #1988 的字段完成优化前后对照，比较流启动分段和首段正文耗时。用观测到的主要耗时决定优化环节并报告对应收益。
- 回归本次 Task 的工具可用性、上一 Task 凭据的生命周期和技能启停。覆盖真正发生技能变化的场景，确保工具选择、权限和技能刷新正确。

issue:1992.body:
### Context

DigitalMate 鸿蒙客户端「设置 → 权限管理」里的日历和位置卡片，以及对话里现有的「设备位置」授权卡。

### Test Environment

### Problem Description & Suggestions

权限管理当前用复选框表示授权，对话的位置授权则使用单独的一组按钮。两处的授权入口和状态样式不一致。

设置首页的「云端连接」下一行应是「权限管理」。「应用连接」入口暂时从设置中移除。

issue:2000.body:
## Gap
`native_weather` returns only the current day. The provider (`server_engine/engine_weather.py`) sends `forecast_days=1`, and neither the tool (`search_mcp.native_weather(location, region)`) nor `engine_tools_mcp.native_weather(location)` takes a date. So "how's the weather tomorrow", "this weekend", "on Friday" or "next 3 days" can't be answered. Place resolution step 1 (#1991) now gives Beebou the date and time zone, but the tool can't use them.

## Owner decision (2026-11-18)
The default is today, but the tool must accept the dates the user asks about: tomorrow, a weekday, a specific date or a short range.

## Proposed scope
- The Bee-facing `native_weather` gets an optional date argument next to `place`, either `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) or `start_date` + `days`. Without it, the tool uses today in the task's time zone, which is the PLR-C2 zone (the client's reported zone, else the workspace default).
- Beebou resolves relative dates, such as "tomorrow" or "周五", against the time line, and writes a concrete date into the Bee task. The Bee never works out "tomorrow" on its own.
- The provider requests the right forecast window: Open-Meteo `start_date`/`end_date`, or `forecast_days`.
  - Dates beyond the provider's forecast horizon are refused with a clear model-readable reason.
  - Past dates are either served from the historical API or refused. Decide which in the PR.
  - The horizon, the maximum range and any history window go in config, not code.
- Answers name both the place and the date(s) (PLR-C8 style), and cite the forecast date or dates.
- Beebou's Home weather path (`HomeWeather`, today-only consent) is out of scope unless trivially shared.

## Ordering
This builds on #1995 (PlaceGuard, the Bee `native_weather` schema). Start it after #1995 merges, so the schema changes land once.

## Done when
- Deterministic tests cover: the default today in the task's time zone, a single date, a range, a date beyond the horizon, a past date, and invalid input.
- Provider query parameters are asserted.
- The Bee schema is asserted.
- Both Chinese and English relative-date phrasings resolve to concrete dates in Beebou's dispatch.

Refs #1983.

issue:2001.body:
### Problem

Upgrading a v0.1.12 workspace leaves its whole conversation and memory history out of Global Memory.

At the first Bridge start, `LiveIngestionJob` records the owner's cutoff. That is the high water of `engine-tasks-v1`, `legacy-memory-v1` and `hive-beebou-v1` at that moment. Live ingestion only covers positions above the cutoff. Under §7b, positions at or below it belong to `BackfillRunner(handoff=...)`. `BackfillRunner` has no production caller (only tests), so pre-upgrade turns never reach Global Memory.

### Fix

Bridge startup drains the one-time backfill as part of the same job. After the cutoff is authorized, there is one runner per authorized source, gated by `live.toml [live] backfill` (default true). Progress is durable, so the backfill runs once per workspace. There is no model judge, matching live ingestion.

Done when an upgraded old workspace has its old tasks, approved memories and Beebou turns readable in Global Memory as historical fragments, a restart adds nothing, and turns after the cutoff still go through live ingestion.

Follow-up from #1665 (post-Hive nonblocking collection); related #1312, #1313.

### Checklist

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

在最新 main 上按 `harness/personal-agent/deploy/Dockerfile` 构建服务端镜像会**直接失败**，无法产出镜像。

失败时的报错（BuildKit，`linux/amd64`，HK 构建 Pod）：

```
#26 [bot-build 23/27] COPY temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city /build/temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city
#26 ERROR: failed to calculate checksum of ref m5puogazp4dnpu61wd380ldh7::phcc7z6itwvzrp0cc8u7gt6zu:
    "/temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city": not found
...
Dockerfile:62
  62 | >>> COPY temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city /build/temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city
error: failed to solve: failed to compute cache key: failed to calculate checksum of ref ...: not found
```

**根因**：真正的构建上下文过滤器是 `harness/personal-agent/deploy/Dockerfile.dockerignore`（与 Dockerfile 同名的 `<Dockerfile>.dockerignore`，BuildKit 优先于仓库根的 `.dockerignore`）。它是白名单式规则（先 `**` 全排除，再逐条 `!` 放行）。当前它放行了 16 个 temp 模块，但**没有放行 `temp/device-weather-city`**：

```
!temp/beebou/
!temp/composio-mail/
!temp/connection-foundation/
!temp/report-goals/
!temp/phone-calendar-commands/
!temp/history-context-recovery/
!temp/feishu-connector/
!temp/mail-signal-pipeline/
!temp/hive-worker/
!temp/hive-runtime/
!temp/hive-memory/
!temp/hive-beebou/
!temp/hive-tools/
!temp/hive-browser-helper/
!temp/bee-artifacts/
!temp/skill-plugins/
```

被 `.dockerignore` 排除的路径，在 BuildKit 里表现为 “not found”，于是 COPY 失败。仓库里该目录本身是存在的（`git ls-files temp/device-weather-city` 有输出，包含 `src/dm_device_weather_city/__init__.py` 等），所以不是文件缺失，纯粹是白名单漏配。

**影响**：任何人基于当前 main 构建服务端镜像都会失败；端侧 HAP 不受影响。

**修复建议**：在 `harness/personal-agent/deploy/Dockerfile.dockerignore` 中按现有格式补上（与 `bee-artifacts` 同构）：

```
!temp/device-weather-city/
temp/device-weather-city/**
!temp/device-weather-city/src/
temp/device-weather-city/src/**
!temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city/
!temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city/**
temp/device-weather-city/src/**/__pycache__/
temp/device-weather-city/src/**/*.pyc
```

本地已验证：补上后同一 Pod 内重新克隆 `6a2d8fdf2` 并构建，`COPY` 步骤通过（构建继续进行到后续阶段）。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 源码：main `38c4d124743082f8a91f28db748cdb6b84835837`（2026-11-18 16:26 +08）
- 构建：ADX `adx-jiuwen-test-6` 内独立 BuildKit Pod（buildkit v0.25.2），`linux/amd64`，`buildctl --frontend dockerfile.v0 --local dockerfile=<ctx>/harness/personal-agent/deploy`
- Dockerfile：`harness/personal-agent/deploy/Dockerfile` 第 62 行
- 过滤器：`harness/personal-agent/deploy/Dockerfile.dockerignore`（295 行）
- 命令（节选）：

```
buildctl --addr unix:///run/user/1000/buildkit/buildkitd.sock build \
  --frontend dockerfile.v0 \
  --local context=$CONTEXT \
  --local dockerfile=$CONTEXT/harness/personal-agent/deploy \
  --opt filename=Dockerfile \
  --opt platform=linux/amd64 \
  --output type=image,name=<IMAGE>,push=true
```

### Additional Information

- 引入该 COPY 的改动（新增 `temp/device-weather-city` 模块）没有同步更新 `Dockerfile.dockerignore`，属于构建输入清单漏配。
- 同类历史问题可参考仓库中其他 temp 模块的白名单段落，格式已统一。
- 关联：#1789（天气能力与文件交付）、#1665（汇总页）

### Version Information

- main：`38c4d124743082f8a91f28db748cdb6b84835837`
- 复现时间：2026-11-18 17:27 / 17:45（Asia/Shanghai），两次均在同一位置失败
- 未涉及端侧 HAP

### Screenshots / Recordings

构建日志文本证据已附在上方代码块中（BuildKit 报错 + Dockerfile 行号 + 白名单清单）。该问题是构建管线缺陷，无 UI 截图；如需原始日志可提供 `build-*.log`（约 7 KB，失败在依赖层之前的 COPY 阶段）。

- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

从某个 Bee 直接进入它的对话页（标题为 Bee 名称，如「足球欧冠赛果助手」，状态「休息中」，输入框提示「发消息给 足球欧冠赛果助手」）时，**助手回复的 Markdown 完全没有渲染，语法原样显示**。

截图中同一条回复里可以看到：

- 标题语法原样：`## 结论：今天（2026年11月17日）没有欧冠比赛`
- 加粗语法原样：`**11 月 17 日（周二）**`、`**第5轮（11月24-25日）**`
- 表格语法原样：``|主队|比分|客队|`` 与分隔行没被渲染成表格
- 分隔线 `---`、列表包裹文本一并按纯文本输出

同样的内容在 Home 主对话里是正常渲染的（Home 助手回复走 `CloudMarkdownView`）。

**代码定位（main `34a156f2`）**

- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/DigitalMateHome/HiveBeeConversation.ets:437`
  ```ts
  Text(row.text).fontSize(16).lineHeight(24).fontColor('#332313')
  ```
  助手/Beebou 侧的正文用的是 `Text` 纯文本渲染，没有走 Markdown 组件。
- 对照：Home 的回答渲染使用 `CloudMarkdownView`（`DigitalMateHome/Index.ets` 的 `ChatRowContent` 分支），支持标题、加粗、表格、列表、代码块、链接与流式。

**期望**：Bee 直达会话中，助手侧的正文与 Home 保持一致，使用同一套 Markdown 渲染组件；用户消息、系统提示、过程/状态行仍可保持纯文本。

**影响**：Bee 的直接输出多为结构化报告（结论 + 表格 + 分级标题），纯文本渲染可读性显著下降，表格数据几乎无法阅读。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 端：DigitalMate HarmonyOS 客户端，20026 验收包（main `38c4d124` + #1924 + 构建修复），HAP sha256 `e6464ba2e94ac8168e7e2c38481abd9ef60e6ce6ac02aeec19fd8cb7017a2f1a`
- 云：ADX `adx-jiuwen-test-6`，tenant `jiuwen-test-6`，模板 alias `production` → v25，镜像 `pr1924v2-20261118-1745-6a2d8fd-test-6`
- 设备：HarmonyOS 真机（CRS-AL00），截图时间 2026-11-18 08:53（设备本地时间）
- 触发路径：Home → 进入某个 Bee 的会话（不是 Home 主对话）

### Additional Information

- 关联：#1665（post-HIVE 非阻塞事项汇总）
- 可能的相关：#1566（对话正文显示不全）、#1219（附件消息气泡重复）属不同问题，本条只针对 Bee 直达会话的 Markdown 渲染缺失
- 建议修复方式：在 `HiveBeeConversation.ets` 的助手分支替换为 `CloudMarkdownView`，复用 Home 的参数（`streaming`、链接回调等）；用户/系统/过程行保持 `Text` 不变。修复后需回归：#1566 所述长文本截断、表格横向溢出、代码块高度、以及流式回复时的重绘性能。

### Version Information

- 客户端：0.1.0（versionCode 10006），20026 验收包，HAP sha256 `e6464ba2…`
- 服务端镜像：`pr1978` 未部署；当前 20026 运行 `pr1924v2-20261118-1745-6a2d8fd-test-6`
- 源码基线：main `34a156f201627497f6fe92974c071cf25586899c`

![Bee 直达会话 Markdown 未渲染](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/a8bf67c3320d4ff527db43725ed04aa2f4506583/issues/assets/bee-direct-chat-markdown-20261118.png)

issue:223.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**

正常对话的首 token 时延（从点击发送到界面出现第一个可见字符）约 **5s**；一旦涉及联网搜索或工具调用，首次可见反馈常常超过 **20s**，期间界面基本空白，用户容易误以为卡住或失败。

**复现步骤**

1. 手机端 Digital Mate 打开与 Beebou 的对话。
2. 发送一个普通问题，例如「现在从公司回小区，地铁和打车哪个快」。
3. 从点击发送开始计时，到出现第一个可见文本 / 流式片段：约 5s。
4. 再发送一个需要联网搜索或工具调用的问题。
5. 首次可见反馈：>20s，等待期间没有进度或状态提示。

**预期行为**

- 首 token 目标：<1s；业界主流 agent 约 **500ms** 量级。
- 如果必须先做路由 / 分类 / 搜索 / 工具调用，应立即输出可见状态（如「正在检索…」），不要整段空白。
- 最终答案应流式增量输出，而不是全部生成完再一次性显示。

**实际行为**

- 普通对话 TTFT ≈ 5s；
- 含搜索 / 工具调用 ≈ 20s+；
- 等待期间缺少即时反馈，容易被误判为失败。

**可能原因（供参考）**

- 首 token 之前的串行链路过长：route → classify → brief → 工具调用 → 联网搜索，全部完成才开始输出；
- 响应不是增量流式，或流式片段被缓冲到完成后才渲染；
- 云端执行服务（Orbit Cloud）与客户端之间存在额外重连 / 轮询等待；
- 客户端与云端之间的状态同步延迟。

**建议**

- 设定 TTFT 预算：普通对话 p50 < 1s、p90 < 2s；工具类任务先出状态、再出结果。
- 在首 token 之前先发一条轻量状态消息（流式占位），不要空白等待。
- 搜索 / 工具调用尽量并行化，或先把「正在检索」回传给客户端。
- Orbit 已记录每轮 `Run.first_text_ms` 和 step 耗时瀑布，可直接用来量化 route / brief / execute 各阶段并作为回归指标。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 设备：手机（型号未记录）
- 系统：HarmonyOS / Android（具体版本待补充）
- 客户端：Digital Mate 测试包（版本号未记录）
- 服务端：Orbit Cloud
- 网络：正常 Wi-Fi / 运营商网络
- 复现时间：约 03:48（Asia/Shanghai）

### Additional Information

- 同类问题参考：业界主流 agent 在同类问答中约 500ms 量级开始输出，并会先给出「搜索 3 个关键词，参考 14 篇资料」这类过程反馈。
- 度量说明：当前 TTFT 为人工目测估计，建议后续用客户端埋点或 Orbit 的 `first_text_ms` 量化。
- 影响：等待感强，用户容易重复发送或退出；含工具调用时体验接近「卡死」。

### Version Information

- 仓库：openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate
- 分支：fix/foreground-reconnect-recovery
- commit：68a25a3f
- 上游基线：main

issue:377.body:
### Checklist

- [x] 已搜索仓库内相关 issue，未找到同一问题（相近 issue 已在正文中注明区别）。
- [x] 已在 2026-10-30 内测群反馈中复现/收集到现场证据。
- [x] 已提供截图与可复现步骤。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：让助手设闹钟，回复「闹钟已经设置成功」，但手机系统闹钟 App 里看不到这条闹钟；同时助手给出的提醒卡片写着 `Zone: UTC（你的本地时间）`，时区标注自相矛盾。

群内原始反馈（2026-10-30 20:19，木稀）：「闹钟里圈看不到」。同学追问时，胡犇回复「目前还不具备操作手机 app 能力」。同一时段另一张截图里，助手明确说明：

> 闹钟已经设置成功。
> 目前系统允许创建闹钟提醒，但不会把这些闹钟展示到闹钟 App 的列表中。你可以在 WorkBuddy 内向我询问、取消或重新设置这个闹钟。

复现步骤：
1. 对话输入「帮我定一个明天早上 7:03 的闹钟。」
2. 在底部弹窗点「确认」。
3. 打开系统闹钟 App 查看；并查看助手返回的提醒卡片。

实际结果：
- 助手提示设置成功，但系统闹钟列表中没有该闹钟。
- 提醒卡片显示 `Zone: UTC（你的本地时间）`、`Host: 需在该时间设备保持在线`。
- 用户无法区分「应用内提醒」和「系统闹钟」，只能去系统闹钟里核对然后发现没有。

预期结果：
- 要么真正创建系统闹钟（或系统级定时通知），要么在确认前就把「仅应用内提醒、不进系统闹钟」讲清楚。
- 时区只显示一种且为用户本地时区（如 `Asia/Shanghai`），不要 `UTC` 与「你的本地时间」并列。
- 「设备需保持在线才触发」属于关键限制，应在设置前确认，而不是设置成功后再说。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 应用：DigitalMate（Beebou）手机端 / WorkBuddy 客户端
- 系统：HarmonyOS，截图为 4G/5G 移动网络
- 云端：ADX 测试云 `wss://1.94.211.46/orbit/ws`，Orbit 模板 `v15-workspace-20261028-a974262d1-8ed6d181-no-split`
- 设备型号与 App 版本：截图未显示，待报告人补充
- 反馈来源：DigitalMate 内测群（29 人），2026-10-30（Asia/Shanghai）

### Additional Information

- 即使最终确认「不写入系统闹钟」是产品取舍，也建议在确认弹窗上直接标注「仅在应用内提醒」，避免用户去系统闹钟 App 核对后认为功能失效。

issue:525.body:
### Context

v0.1.6 发布到应用市场后，内测同学在日常使用中对比其它 AI 产品，对输入区的语音交互提出优化建议。同一时段另一位同学用一段录屏（0:07）展示了「这款 AI 产品是这样的」，作为交互参照。

### Test Environment

- 应用：DigitalMate / Beebou 手机端
- 版本：v0.1.6（当日发布到鸿蒙应用市场，报告人截图中的「版本更新 0.1.6」可核对）
- 系统：HarmonyOS
- 反馈来源：DigitalMate 内测群（30 人），2026-11-03（Asia/Shanghai）

### Problem Description & Suggestions

**现象**：输入框的提示语是「发消息或者按住说」，但按住说话的入口与手感跟用户已经习惯的主流 AI 产品不一致，用户明确要求优化。

群内原始反馈（2026-11-03 18:17，王守玉）：

> 输入区的「发消息或者按住说」，建议搞搞，现在用其他 AI 产品，习惯住说了😅

（「习惯住说了」应为「习惯按住说了」——即从其它产品迁移过来后，原有肌肉记忆在这里不成立。）

**建议**（供讨论，最终方案需与提出人对齐）：

1. 明确按住说话的完整手势契约：按下开始录音 → 松手发送 → 上滑取消 → 录音过短给出提示。当前提示语只说了「按住说」，没说松手/取消怎么处理。
2. 让提示语与真实行为一致：如果按住说话只是次要入口，就不要把它写进占位提示；如果它是主入口，麦克风按钮的可点区域与视觉权重应与之匹配。
3. 录音状态要有明确反馈：波形/计时/「松手发送」文案，避免用户不知道自己处于录音态。
4. 与语音识别质量分开跟踪（识别准确率见 #328），本条只谈交互与提示。

### Screenshots / Recordings

![王守玉在群内提出输入区按住说话的优化建议](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/test-evidence-20261028/test-evidence/20261103/20261103_1817_voice_hold_to_talk.jpg?raw=true)

### Additional Information (optional)

- 关联：姜成林随后贴出的 0:07 录屏（群内 2026-11-03 18:2x）用来说明「这款 AI 产品是这样的」，本次未对该录屏做逐帧转写；如需要精确对齐手势细节，建议向王守玉/姜成林确认参照产品与期望行为。
- 与 #328（语音输入识别准确率）互补：那条关注识别质量，本条关注入口与手势反馈。

### 🚀 Background Description

Establish E2E coverage for **16 DigitalMate cases: 7 in E4 (artifacts and system integration), 7 in E5 (lifecycle and recovery), and 2 in E6 (installation, release, and compliance)**.

Reuse existing workflows, complete deterministic criteria, and collect actual local execution with traceable evidence. #533 retains the original scenarios and historical records. This issue tracks their migration and re-acceptance under the tiered specification; historical passes do not count as stable passes of the current case version.

### Design Ideas

- Criteria are defined in `tests/cases`; workflows, drivers, assertions, and evidence entry points are in `tests/e2e`.
- #585, #586, and #587 retain the original definitions and partial results. Replacement delivery consists of one PR per E tier, linked to this issue, with the cases, execution entry points, actual results, and screenshots.
- Track specification, implementation, execution, stability, PR, and merge status separately by case version. JSON validation, mocks, historical passes, and CI success do not establish current business acceptance.
- Complete each current case once and retain all required assertions. Repeat only after a relevant change or a new failure; report repeated-run stability separately.

### Involved Public APIs

Use the actual App and normal cloud protocol to verify files, attachments, tasks, interactions, and system resources. Fault controls must be restricted to isolated resources owned by the current run. Server success receipts, login state, and assertions must not be fabricated or bypassed.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Coverage includes `tests/e2e/workflow`, file and attachment operations, task recovery, permissions, reminders, first launch, and upgrades. Tier groups share assertion support. This issue does not expand the separate E0–E3 or ST supplementation scope.

### Test Design and Test Plan

E4 checks external file contents and hashes, artifact versions, attachment ownership, permissions, and system resource differences. E5 checks the in-flight state before interruption, actual device controls, task uniqueness, drafts/cards, and terminal state after recovery. E6 checks clean installation, agreement state, package signing/version/release configuration, and retained upgrade data.

#### Final objectives, acceptance criteria and benefit reporting (confirmed 2026-11-09)

<!-- DM31:ACCEPTANCE-ENVIRONMENT:20261117 -->
**Acceptance environment (2026-11-17 maintainer clarification).** When a work package requires end-to-end deployment or client acceptance, deploy the exact candidate to an authorized test environment and run the applicable scenarios on the emulator using the original client/unchanged HAP where required. Validate the real default assembly, startup, Gateway/owner paths, persistence, compatibility and rollback there as applicable. References to production assembly mean the actual supported deployment path and configuration exercised in the test environment. Deploying into the production environment, moving the production alias, and switching live user traffic belong to separate release operations and are not conditions for closing this refactor. All other applicable acceptance assertions, CI, independent QA, A/B and repeat requirements, hard dependencies, and the original 103-work-package closeout accounting remain in force. If deployment/emulator is the only remaining acceptance item, run and record it in the test environment and close the work package once its actual remaining assertions pass.

**Overall objective:** Preserve supported functionality, client compatibility and data semantics while migrating the server to components with clear responsibilities, a single writer for each authoritative state domain, and collaboration through public contracts. Complete source-directory and documentation-governance convergence, make common feature changes and component substitutions local in scope, and demonstrate through actual execution that critical paths have no significant performance regression.

This section consolidates maintainer-confirmed final deliverables and reporting requirements for this master tracker and Q11 #828. **Accepted requirements do not establish completed implementation or verification.** The existing frozen baselines, supported scope, contracts, client acceptance and stricter gates below remain binding. This section authorizes no new product semantics, relaxes no existing gate, reopens no accepted task, and does not accumulate all final acceptance under a single foundation component such as A02. Each child task closes against its original, explicit deliverable boundary; its owning task retains any outstanding final integration obligation, summarized here.

**1. Required deliverables and evidence-based acceptance**

| Objective | Observable acceptance criteria | Primary evidence and ownership |
|---|---|---|
| Clear component responsibilities and dependency boundaries, independently verifiable and replaceable through contracts | Components in migration scope have named owners, public interfaces and declared acyclic dependencies. Each authoritative state domain has one writer. Cross-component calls use public proxies, without accessing another component's private objects or authoritative tables. The actual default production entry reaches the new owner; migrated capabilities have no duplicate authority, silent legacy-executor fallback or reconnectable bypass. Representative implementation substitutions use established extension interfaces without modifying callers' internal logic. Independent deployment of every component and zero dependencies are not required. | Ownership/interface inventory, real call and write traces, boundary counterexamples, substitution and component tests; existing architecture, component and G05/G10 gates apply. Transitional legacy deviations still require an owner, cleanup task and bounded exit condition; they do not establish final migration completion. |
| Remove duplicate responsibilities and retired execution paths; converge the source layout | Every affected old path has an explicit migrate, retain or retire disposition. Server layout converges on the accepted architecture-foundation target while preserving unrelated `digitalmate/` client code, business code and dependencies with pinned provenance. Entry points, builds, imports, tests and deployment use the correct paths. Deletions require reference, call-path and functional evidence. Do not remove functionality to meet a line-count target or mechanically copy an entire branch. | D01 #845 path dispositions, entry mapping, clean installation/build and execution verification; code measurements are reported separately under the rules below. |
| Bounded impact and verification cost for common changes | Compare 3–5 representative changes before and after migration, such as model/tool adaptation, implementation substitution and an internal component-rule change. Internal changes stay with their owner; adapter changes use the adapter and necessary registration without modifying unrelated core code. Genuine shared-contract changes still require owner coordination; there is no promise that every request changes only one component. Developers can locate owners, contracts, entries and verification commands from documentation. | For each case, record baseline/candidate implementations or a reproducible change exercise, affected components/owners/files, unrelated core changes, verification environment/steps/time and component-level testability. Directory counts alone do not establish development efficiency. |
| Preserve functionality, client compatibility and data semantics | Retain the original frozen-baseline, supported configuration/API, full default Harness and unchanged-HAP A/B acceptance obligations, including files/artifacts, history, answer/retry/continue/cancel and the other established capabilities. Preserve persisted records and identities. Simplified probes, fake owners and component tests cannot replace actual client acceptance. | Existing Q04–Q10, capability matrix, identical HAP/driver/assertions, real production participants and deployment evidence; retain original failures and disposition differences individually. |
| Explainable and traceable failure, cancellation and recovery behavior | Verify duplicate requests, lost post-commit receipts, concurrency, Stop and unknown-outcome handling under existing contracts. Execution authority cannot resume after Stop. Correlate requests with M/S/R, attempts/actual implementations, commits and outcomes to identify the responsible component. Prove only the accepted recovery and bounded history-retention scope, without extending it to automatic continuation after arbitrary crashes. | Normal and fault evidence through real owners/persistence, Q03 tracing, existing lifecycle/Store contracts and negative cases; identify controlled substitutes and their scope. |
| Reproducible delivery and authoritative contributor guidance | Trace source, dependencies, build configuration, images and actual installed/runtime identities; verify clean deployment and existing rollback boundaries. AGENTS.md contains stable principles and protocol entry points while retaining effective constraints. Documentation establishes authoritative sources, navigation, old-document dispositions and repaired links under `protocols/specs/adr/procedures/lessons/verification/updates`, distinguishing proposed, accepted, implemented and verified status. | Existing build/deployment and G05 verification, D02 #847, D03 #848 and D01 final reference reconciliation; historical evidence proves only its named revision and scope. |
| No significant critical-path performance regression | Measure server overhead under comparable environments and workloads, reporting actual end-to-end behavior separately. Meet existing stricter service objectives and deadlines. Freeze baselines, measurement methods and tolerances before the final comparison; do not infer performance from architecture or widen thresholds after observing failures. | Comparative report under the performance rules below, included in Q11's final verdict; no unmeasured claim of “no regression.” |

**2. Required factual benefit reporting, without promised improvement percentages**

- **Code reduction:** Fix start/end SHAs and the first-party production-code counting scope. Separately report (1) evidenced removal of duplicate, unreachable or retired code, (2) added contract, adapter and reliability code, and (3) net production-code change. Report changes outside the first two categories separately so totals reconcile. Moves, copying followed by deletion, and formatting-only changes do not count as deduplication benefits. Count tests, documentation, generated code and third-party code with pinned provenance separately. Supply the counting tool, configuration, exclusions and representative deletion evidence. No reduction of N lines or N% is promised; a net increase does not automatically fail acceptance.
- **Development cost:** For the representative cases above, report change impact, environment preparation, required verification steps and elapsed time. Distinguish human work, tool waiting and test execution, and state sample limitations. Do not directly translate agent concurrency, model differences or one exercise into developer-productivity gains. Report measured improvement, no improvement or trade-offs without promising a productivity percentage.
- **Performance:** Keep hardware/resource limits, data volume, concurrency, workload and warm-up strategy comparable for server measurements. Use fixed model/tool responses to isolate external variability. Cover applicable queuing/submission, history reads, cancellation acknowledgement and execution-scheduling overhead. Report p50/p95, applicable throughput under fixed-load and saturation conditions, peak memory, and success/error/timeout rates so dropped work cannot appear as a speed gain. Separately report real end-to-end time using the same client and scenarios, explicitly identifying model/network and other external effects instead of combining the two into one conclusion. Record sample counts, repetitions, variability, commands and raw results.
- **Performance tolerances for baseline calibration only:** Evaluation may start from “p95 latency and peak memory increase by no more than 10% relative to baseline; throughput remains at least 95% of baseline.” These are **candidate tolerances, not active gates, passing results or exemptions from existing stricter objectives**. First measure baseline noise and applicable service objectives. The responsible owner then specifies absolute deadlines, applicable metrics and final thresholds, freezes them, and runs the candidate comparison. Record and disposition every unmet condition. Test-scanning/CI speed improvements count only toward verification cost, not product runtime performance.

**3. Consistent acceptance and progress reporting**

1. Trace every conclusion through “requirement/objective → owner and task → exact baseline/candidate SHA → actual entry and participants → commands, environment, results and evidence → outstanding work/blocker and next responsible owner.” Label evidence as source, component, integration, deployment or unchanged-HAP scope; these scopes are not interchangeable. Retain initial failures and subsequent runs without overwriting history.
2. Keep `proposed / accepted / implemented / verified` distinct, and keep execution outcomes `PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT_RUN / INVALID` distinct. Completed documentation, a merged PR, increased test counts, reachable infrastructure or a successfully built image does not automatically establish production migration or client acceptance.
3. Close child tasks against their original acceptance criteria and backfill post-merge evidence, residual work and downstream dependencies. Do not expand a foundation package merely to close the master tracker. Report overall task counts, source integration, deployment and client acceptance separately. Without new formally tracked tasks, this section changes no denominator and manufactures no completion count.
4. The final #737 / Q11 #828 report consolidates the required deliverables, measured benefits and unresolved differences above. No minimum positive reduction in net code, development effort or additional runtime cost is promised, but the corresponding measurements and reproducible reports are required. Outstanding unrun, invalid or blocked mandatory acceptance prevents an unconditional refactor-completion claim. Existing difference-disposition and authorization rules continue to apply; retain visible limitations and their scope.

### Proposed Solution

**Architecture:** Message/Session/Run are core identities. The trusted Home ingress targets Beebou and its Harness proposes Bee selection under the accepted Hive contracts; Agent Service validates the target and Session Manager owns admission/recovery; SQLite Store owns authoritative DM records; backend owns execution coordination/controls/final publication; Harness owns loop policy; Runtime owns same-process Python assembly/readiness/lifecycle. Every parent/child/summary/compression/vision/skill model/tool/context effect follows HostAPI. Public proxies mediate cross-component operations. Exact Registry factories bind sessions; replacement works without installed default Core. Room is a compatibility projection. Artifact bytes survive execution workspace release. Gateways dispatch/normalize evidence, host hooks own application policy, BudgetProvider alone owns balances, Store owns attempt/turn accounting. Stop permanently closes execution authority; late accounting cannot reopen it or change terminal outcome.

**Main reuse strategy:** retain the pinned normal DeepAgent/task-loop/ReAct algorithms, prompt attachment logic, default general-purpose children and six controls, six office skills, pure file/image/office validation and provider business leaves. In the original pre-Hive baseline, both ordinary/simple modes selected `agent.work.normal`; reconcile the current Hive bindings explicitly and do not mistake simple heuristics for a current model-only path. Team is off by default but supported explicit configuration must have a migration path. Rehome model/tool dispatch, SDK checkpoint/history, child persistence, compaction inference, vision reads and skill process I/O to their host/provider owners. Do not retain WorkSwarm supervisor, Session DB, EngineService or DeepAdapter global bootstrap as a second execution authority. Existing UI and wire consumers remain the comparison target.

**立即启动的五条协调线。** ① Store/Manager 与 #1279 后继链；② Host/Plugin Gateway/Harness 边界；③ Mobile Gateway/应用与领域 provider；④ D01/D03/架构清单与政策生产者；⑤ 独立 QA/G10/Ops。当前已有原生前置全部满足的任务为 #746、#752、#754、#758、#762、#767、#769、#799、#814。这表示可开工，不表示有具名执行资源或通过回执。每条线在下次交接登记执行人、独立 reviewer、实际基线、可写路径与 ETA，未落实写 UNKNOWN，不虚构会话/租约。

**共享修改串行点。** Store schema/codec/事务一个 owner；Host 生命周期一个 owner；Runtime/Bridge 装配一个集成 owner；架构 registry、公共类型及包映射先由生产者审阅合入。各业务 owner 可并行做窄切片，禁止多人整块重写 server.py 或搬整个 temp/hive-runtime。迁移每个分区时同步 caller、测试、打包、登记和模块文档，验收后删除该分区旧 adapter/force-include/registration。

#### 12 月 7 日架构政策退出关口

在 `498bc351`，[docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4/docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json) 有 **242 个 legacy_inventory 模块、87 个 components、0 exceptions，expires=2026-12-07**。[tools/architecture/check.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4/tools/architecture/check.py) 在 UTC 日期超过 expiry 且清单非空时报告 AR10，domains 检查同样检查日期。本计划按到期前收口，不能利用日期比较边界拖延。该期限独立于 #963 原 11/22 全交付目标，不能把后者静默延期。

- **11/17 18:00 CST，W0 清单/合同冻结目标。** D01 将 242 模块逐行映射到上述十包、当前/目标 owner、实际 caller/writer、保留/迁移/退役、验收和 ETA。D03 首批修正当前文档入口，接口未获评审的写 proposal。原 #737 任务/硬边、计划分支生成输入一并对齐，旧 render 不得覆盖本轮。
- **11/18–11/22，W1 第一波实现目标。** 优先真实默认入口、Manager/Store、Host/Plugin Gateway 和可独立落地的兼容门面。#1279 只接一次切流后基线并独审精确验证，再按 #1260→#1261→#1257。先核对 #1605 实际 main 受影响复验回执，缺失则补在后续执行计划，不能把分支 G5/G6 移标 main。本轮无新运行。
- **11/23–11/29，W2 领域切片目标。** Source/Artifact/Office、连接器、Memory、调度各按原依赖集成，逐模块转入可执行 enforcement 或有证据退役。边界不清的大模块先按内部职责拆，禁止仅改 checked 标志或搬目录以消除清单。
- **11/30–12/04，W3 清零目标。** 默认装配、安装/来源、反旁路、reader/writer、目录与文档联合验收，legacy_inventory 清零；未完成项逐项 owner/ETA，不能用通配豁免替换。
- **12/05–12/06，缓冲。** 政策与实际 main 独立复核，留失败修复/安装证明容量。12/07 保留为现行硬退出日期。若 11/22 或其后检查点证明容量不足，立即公布风险与实际剩余项；任何延期需逐 owner/任务的明确评审，当前不批准延长。

W0–W3 是新的架构工作目标，尚无具名容量承诺或实测总工时，**AT_RISK，最终完成 ETA UNKNOWN**。完整 #737 收尾还需原产品/生产/性能/独立 QA，legacy 清零不代表整体完成。

#### 证据、进度和后续会话规则

每个切片记录基线/候选/实际 merge SHA、真实 caller/状态 writer、允许依赖、精确门禁与 artifact、镜像/config/HAP、实际参与者/替身、失败/未运行、原 Issue 剩余义务。旧证据仅在逐项证明输入等价时复用，身份不改。#1636 分套件预算按实际启用规则使用，#1656 上传容错不免除可回读证据。#1605 的 admin/base-policy 自举记录只适用于该合入，后续正常 producer-first/CI/独审规则不变。

#1316 报告 Hive G5 13 PASS/0 FAIL/1 BLOCKED/3 NOT_RUN，G6 5 PASS/0 FAIL/3 BLOCKED/1 NOT_RUN，并记录延期/已知限制；这是切流范围的接受，不给 #737 原 87 个开放包补发通过。本次不运行测试、CI、部署、设备，也不改代码或工程文档。下一实现批必须把源码、组件边界与 docs/implementations/modules 同步收敛。

#### Work-package detail and previous tracker versions

Issue links in the four cutover groups are the current package register. The
[original package tree](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737/sub_issues)
retains the underlying work packages and native dependencies. Delivery details
remain with the package owners and [milestone tracker #963](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/963).
The [class migration checklist](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/docs/implementations/migration/class-migration-checklist.md)
and [architecture](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/docs/architecture/README.md)
retain the detailed source map. The earlier long-form tracker is available in
this issue's edit history.

### Test Verification

**Two independent release gates:**

1. **Architecture and production assembly:** AR01–AR10 static import/export/dependency/cycle/private-access/DB-domain/Harness-I/O/legacy-executor/install-origin rules plus legal and violating fixtures. Runtime ST from actual default public entry verifies Router→AS→HostAPI→Store, authenticated scope, exact versions/selection, Stop fences, physically Core-free replacement and dispatch exclusively at provider boundaries. Deliberate bypass mutants must fail. Real owners/SQLite are not replaced by fakes when asserting ownership.
2. **Frozen-main behavior:** same HAP hash, driver SHA, case/assertion versions and comparable data; only backend identity changes. Capture old/new source/image/build/configuration and run IDs. Each new pass traces phone M→new S/R→Host call→authoritative record. CHAT-01/02 first; then all frozen-main scenarios (36 manifest entries, including supplemental disposition) and supported API/configuration behaviors, not only historical 23 E2E. File/Office/image/history/reference/interaction/cancel/supplement/reconnect/restart are explicit groups. PPT must contain actual requested title/file, remain readable after workspace release, and open from the original phone. Official historical 7c build and alternative compilation evidence stay separate.

Retain PASS, FAIL, environment-BLOCKED and NOT-RUN separately; also preserve validator INVALID where applicable. Old failures are not hidden or waived by a new pass. Real-provider, component, phone and deployed-image results have distinct scope. Every batch reruns impacted cross-component tests on the integrated head. Independent QA does not approve its own implementation.

**Early counterexample gates:** #712 before-admission metadata validation and known pre-execution failure classification are independently corrected candidate findings, still require main regression. #723 is bounded same-S feasibility only. Real pre-R authentication scope/BGE attempts, physical retry identity, null/missing versus zero, true pre-completion reply deltas, atomic budget reserve/settle, unknown liability, post-Stop settlement and production outcome/accounting inspect all receive explicit tasks. TEST-ONLY writers, parent-only proxy injection and minimal Core examples cannot satisfy these gates.

**CI reuse and enforcement:** retain Node/Hypium/ArkTS and existing `pr-ready`; reuse credential-free server regression selection and case assertions. New Python architecture/server suites are not already covered by them. Missing/skipped/cancelled/zero-case mandatory suites fail the new aggregate. Trusted base owns policy/scanner configuration; rule changes require trusted review and candidate self-tests. Historical survey access reported branch protection disabled, CODEOWNERS absent and ruleset reads403; these are frozen planning observations, not current administration proof. The latest [G09 acceptance readback](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/745#issuecomment-6709027699) records branch-protection access404/unavailable, which does not establish that no rules exist. G10 still requires administrator activation/readback and a negative merge test before enforcement may be claimed.

**Evidence-pending / not separately published:** no new main Bug/UX finding has sufficient standalone reproduced visual evidence in this survey. Existing bugs remain linked. Candidate-only gaps are migration regression requirements, not relabeled main incidents. Any later main defect without screenshot/recording remains in this register until the Bug template can be satisfied; nothing is silently deleted.

**Definition of done:** closing every child is necessary but insufficient. Independent full architecture/production-assembly verdict, complete frozen-main comparison with accepted dispositions, supported conditional paths, pinned build provenance and compatibility/rollback/old-writer checks must pass. No code implementation, feature parity or deployment is claimed by publishing this plan.

<!-- DM31:GOVERNANCE-FINAL-ACCEPTANCE -->

**Final governance acceptance** also requires actual directory convergence with exhaustive source disposition and no stale supported entry/import/build/deploy/test references; merged stable AGENTS guidance with the original mandatory repository rules preserved; and substantive documentation authority/navigation, complete original-file disposition, repaired moved links, and status/evidence consistent with actual main. D02/D03 initial developer guidance proceeds now. Final D01 runtime and D03 affected-reference reconciliation remain tracked until verified. These requirements are native blockers on Q11 and retain all production/behavior gates above.

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-G10`.

**Outcome:** Trusted scanner/policy changes require independent owners and failing required checks actually prevent merge.

**Owner:** Repository administrator. **Batch:** P0: contracts, inventory and early gates. **Size:** 0.5 working day; existing leaves reused, prerequisites excluded.

**Not responsible for:**
- Do not claim current branch protection exists
- No invented maintainer handles

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** Produce the stated contract, inventory, checker or independent evidence artifact using `AGENTS.md::PR Conventions` as the concrete source. Preserve the accepted owner and scope; this preparation/verification task does not claim code migration.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** .github/CODEOWNERS; docs/plans/v31-server-migration/required-checks.md (planned artifacts; retain existing shared drivers/assertions)

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/AGENTS.md) — `PR Conventions`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [.github/workflows/ci.yml](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/.github/workflows/ci.yml) — `job names`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [.github/workflows/pr-ready.yml](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/.github/workflows/pr-ready.yml) — `pr-ready status`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Current checks and explicit maintainer authority

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Unreviewed allowlist expansion
- Status-only gate described as merge protection

**Writable boundary:**
- .github/CODEOWNERS
- docs/plans/v31-server-migration/required-checks.md

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-G09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/745) (**FULFILLED/CLOSED**; retained dependency history)

**Blocks:** [DM31-Q11](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/828)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A01](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/738), [DM31-A14](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/739), [DM31-A19](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/740), [DM31-A20](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/741)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Assign actual owners to scanner/policy/workflow/contracts and module paths
- Record before/after API evidence with inaccessible distinct from absent
- Require architecture-conformance, server-ut-st and existing checks under exact verified names
- Verify failing test PR cannot merge; successful updated-head PR can
- If plan/admin capability unavailable, enforcement remains BLOCKED

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Readback:** gh api repos/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/branches/main; administrator retrieves effective protection/rules/check sources and demonstrates blocked negative/correct positive PR under authorized settings.

**Participants:** Repository administrator and actual GitHub branch rules; no admin rights assumed by planning actor.

**Limitation:** Current branch response is unprotected; rulesets read returned403. Activation remains blocked until administrator evidence exists.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** repository-admin, ruleset-or-protection-plan-support. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** AR10.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-M01`.

**Outcome:** Default mobile admission receives verified owner/workspace/environment identity from the platform adapter before any session lookup.

**Owner:** Mobile Gateway. **Batch:** P1: authoritative spine and first phone vertical. **Size:** 0.5 working day; existing leaves reused, prerequisites excluded.

**Not responsible for:**
- No wholesale EngineService/Bridge/WorkSwarm daemon or session-database wrapper.
- No live deployment, new provider rollout or unconfigured capability enablement in this task.
- No ADX or gVisor deployment changes; obtain verified platform contract rather than invent its workspace_key schema.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** To achieve Default mobile admission receives verified owner/workspace/environment identity from the platform adapter before any session lookup, adapt `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/server.py::create_app.websocket` into `server/mobile_gateway/identity.py::VerifiedWorkspaceBinding; server/mobile_gateway/proxy.py::admit(binding, request)`. Preserve the stated algorithms/behavior and align the named public contracts; remove the listed old authority and I/O.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** server/mobile_gateway/identity.py::VerifiedWorkspaceBinding; server/mobile_gateway/proxy.py::admit(binding, request)

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/server.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/server.py) — `create_app.websocket`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateGatewaySession.ets](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateGatewaySession.ets) — `validateDigitalMateGatewayCredential`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Business and model credentials remain separate
- Grant rotation and explicit unauthorized responses
- Scoped tool tokens cannot read workspace pushes

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Trusting an arbitrary client workspace key or unverified Bearer
- Public reuse of gateway-auth bypass

**Writable boundary:**
- server/mobile_gateway/identity.py
- server/mobile_gateway/proxy.py
- tests/server/mobile_gateway/st/test_identity_binding.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-A01](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/738) (**FULFILLED/CLOSED**; native history retained)

**Blocks:** [DM31-M02](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/763), [DM31-M11](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/777), [DM31-M14](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/784), [DM31-M39](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/829), [DM31-M42](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/832), [DM31-M43](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/833)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A02](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/750), [DM31-A03](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/751), [DM31-A04](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/752), [DM31-A05](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/753)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
**Normal:** Owner A grant bound to workspace WA admits room.home and returns only A snapshots.

**Failure:** Missing verification or request workspace WB under WA returns unauthorized before Router/Store access.

**Concurrency:** Two grants for A rotating while B connects never reuse a cached identity or emit A events to B.


**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Existing:** - **Command:** PYTHONPATH=harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src:harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests python -m unittest discover -s harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests -p 'test_server_scope.py' -v

  **Participants:** Real legacy implementation with temporary storage and suite-controlled fake network/runtime providers; characterization only.


**Planned:** **Command:** python -m unittest -v tests.server.mobile_gateway.st.test_identity_binding

**Participants:** Real Mobile Gateway implementation and public proxies with temporary storage; controlled downstream service/provider replies. Core is not required unless the suite explicitly exercises a Harness run.


**Status:** Not run; planned suites are proposed files, existing commands are characterization checks.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-G05`.

**Outcome:** Generic service works without default Core physically installed and packages install without neighboring checkouts or undeclared transitives.

**Owner:** Packaging owner. **Batch:** P1: authoritative spine and first phone vertical. **Size:** 1 working day; existing leaves reused, prerequisites excluded.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** Produce the stated contract, inventory, checker or independent evidence artifact using `.github/ci-gates.json::gate catalog` as the concrete source. Preserve the accepted owner and scope; this preparation/verification task does not claim code migration.

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [.github/ci-gates.json](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/.github/ci-gates.json) — `gate catalog`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Architecture reference [tests/server/st/test_harness_loading.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/tests/server/st/test_harness_loading.py) — `HarnessLoadingST; IndependentHarnessFactory`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [server/agent_service/harness/plugin.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/harness/plugin.py) — `OpenJiuwenFactory`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

**Preserve:**
- Pinned provider identities and exact recovery binding semantics

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Production imports of tests/fakes/reference snapshot/neighbor paths
- Generic dependencies on default-provider commands

**Writable boundary:**
- scripts/ci/verify_server_install.py

- tests/server/st/test_replacement_no_core.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. **Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-A09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/759), [DM31-G09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/745) (**FULFILLED/CLOSED**; retained dependency history)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Independent Harness passes with Core absent, not merely an import blocker
- Missing bound provider fails explicitly instead of fallback
- Clean isolated install and pip check succeed; neighbor PYTHONPATH disabled
- Production-test and undeclared dependency fixtures fail

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 scripts/ci/server-tests.py --suite replacement-no-core --require-tests --fail-on-skip

**Assertions:** - server-tests.py --suite replacement-no-core --require-tests --fail-on-skip (proposed)
- server-tests.py --suite clean-install --require-tests --fail-on-skip (proposed)

**Participants:** Actual scanner and legal/violating fixtures; runtime suites use real owning public components/SQLite with controlled providers. G05 physically omits Core in its isolated installation. No phone/device claim.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** isolated-package-environment, approved-dependency-locks. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** AR05, AR07.
