Refs #771 (G08) and #737.

## Native rollback case

The real `BeeExecutionBridge` and Hive SQLite writer run against one disposable workspace. A SQLite TEMP trigger aborts insertion of the matching result notice only after the same write has inserted the terminal result. The case observes the native `SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_TRIGGER` error and checks that:

- The original Run claim and witnessed queue head remain. The public task read stays `running`.
- Result, notice and Beebou done report are absent. The scope-bound Gateway returns pending and publishes no terminal frame.
- A new execution attempt is idle. After removing the fault, recovery uses the original Run and witness, advances the task to completed, and publishes the one stored result/notice pair. A second recovery is idle. The controlled WorkSwarm wire receives one `chat.send` across the full test.

The existing lost-ACK/unknown tests retain their original assertions. This adds one test to the existing Hive scenario file. Real participants are the Bridge, scope-bound result handler, WorkSwarm adapter and SQLite Store/writer. The WorkSwarm socket/computation and completion witness are controlled. The fixture leaves `run_turn` unbound and does not exercise configured Host admission, real SC03-D1, device or deployed services.

## Evidence

- Base `498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4`; head `bcb05eb248bd25d5427e7f485c1a1a088910840b`; tree `1e56d55612d93238de2f4e0dce28b7bbb6bdb4fc`.
- macOS CPython 3.13.13, `python -B -m unittest -v hive.test_phase2_bee_execution.BeeExecutionBridgeTests`, candidate source imports in a private temporary environment. 15 passed, zero failures/errors/skips, in 2.721 seconds. Receipt SHA-256 `9c9f0fa106b65f4cec5e9b695ae6dee36024523a271ad0522bfb4211826bcbf9`. The existing test socket reports missing unload-generation support.
- Independent reviewer reproduced a test-oracle gap at `dab9a964`: a deliberate extra transaction changed only the task state to completed after the real notice fault and rollback, and the original oracle passed. The corrected exact head rejects the same mutation at the public task-state assertion. The reviewer independently observed one clean PASS and the expected red mutation. Refs #827.

## Summary

Add an opt-in offline check for the Q10 workflow disposition ledger. The command verifies the published manifest against its existing SHA-256 and revalidates the current snapshot against its Git tree and workflow sources. It requires one explicit NOT_RUN or BLOCKED disposition for each published workflow without an exact current path, version and workflow hash match. The historical daily alternate and the current explicit workflow retain separate identities when their case IDs coincide.

The existing catalog, workflow selection, run-ab interfaces, acceptance assertions and CI triggers are unchanged.

## Verification

- Candidate `e6a6588c1f410831dd16fc5cea784ca49fc75c94`, tree `4dde54605ac4fdb97de781b1824a4cfe300ece52`, implementation base `498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4`.
- The accepted frozen backend source is `f5aab07863aa6265c8c18a3df601bf15b2687b2b` and the recorded client source is `5d6a1645b51f958e195080d22011de6eea34e4b0`. The pinned manifest digest remains `64f589b1dd2be05ace017e2e0a3e63604cebb62b8ddbc2acdc18fd8d540f6bd9`. The QA source check independently checked 106 frozen workflow, calibration and other source blobs against Git.
- On Node 26.0.0, `node --test tests/e2e/workflow/migration.test.mjs tests/e2e/workflow/workflow.test.mjs` gave 156 PASS, zero FAIL and one existing E6 skip because no active E6 release workflow is registered. Local tests exercise the real checker and source inputs together with the existing controlled device and runner fixtures.
- The actual 498 source snapshot has 31 explicit workflows and one alternate. The CLI reconciled the published 38 rows as 18 exact workflow source matches and 20 provisional NOT_RUN dispositions. Six exact workflow paths are missing and 14 present paths have a different case version. The five missing explicit paths are PERM-01, PRIVACY-01, SILENCE-01, TIMEOUT-01 and UPGRADE-01. The sixth is the historical daily FILE-02 alternate. The current explicit FILE-02 v11 has its own path, version and bytes.
- The original implementation head `45c4514c4c83bac9bc0f02b2eca379f86d1aa5ec` incorrectly exited 0 when the frozen alternate was removed from both the working-copy manifest and the ledger. The exact candidate rejects that edit with exit 1 and an explicit frozen SHA-256 diagnostic. A modified current snapshot and missing, duplicate, passing or same-ID substituted alternate dispositions also fail. Independent review passed the exact revised candidate and separately replayed the positive and negative CLI cases.

This Draft supplies source reconciliation. The provisional ledger still needs review by the Q10 coordinator and owning QA lane. ## 本次改动

- 在会话的原生选题卡背面按方案版本匹配推荐依据。补齐分类名和已引用、已加载、计划使用等状态，记忆分类按快照可用状态展示。

## What this adds

Relates to #1930 (does not close it: Bee-side image tasks and the #1762 product boundary remain).

Restores the v0.1.12 image chain for the Hive BeeBou Home path, behind `DIGITALMATE_HIVE_HOME_IMAGE_TRIAL` (default `0`, requires the B11 attachment input root).

- **Admission**: an over-limit image is refused inside the Home admission transaction with the exact v0.1.12 `EngineError(BAD_PARAMS)` message; input and hold roll back together. (Admission of image types themselves already works via `hold_home_input` when the input root is on — verified.)
- **Turn side**: the new legacy adapter `server_engine/hive_home_images.py` (`HiveHomeImages`) resolves the current input's held images through the Attachment owner's public hold reads (`current_home_holds` / `read_current_home_hold`: visibility, digest, 5 MiB) and `model_images.normalize_model_images`. `hive_turn_startup.run_input` passes them as `wire_images` for plain user turns only; a resolution failure drops the image and keeps the text turn.
- **Wire**: `NativeBeebouRunner` wraps the model with a new outermost wire-only `_WireImageModel` projection (mirroring `_ConsumedTerminalModel`/`_QuoteModel`), appending one ephemeral `{role:"user", content:[text, image_url]}` message per image to the provider request. The committed Beebou context stays `{role, content: str}` (#1503); `commit_beebou_context`'s claim-prefix check fails loudly on any leak.
- The deployment's model must accept image content; the switch is the deployment's modality declaration (the gateway passes request payloads verbatim — verified no request-side shape validation).

## Validation

- `temp/hive-runtime/tests/test_home_wire_images.py` — 6 passed; `harness/.../tests/test_hive_home_images.py` — 9 passed; `test_consumed_terminal_context.py` regression — 5 passed (Python 3.11.15 venv). Covers: admitted image reaches the model request while the commit carries no image message; switch off → no image message; empty passthrough; combination with the consumed-terminal projection (claim-frozen indexes); revoked/invisible/unheld/non-image inputs skipped; oversized image refused with the v0.1.12 message; normalization failure drops the image.
- Broader runnable hive-runtime subset: 134 passed; 6 failures pre-exist on the base (Windows symlink/env, stash-verified, unrelated).
- NOT RUN: bridge-composition tests (this checkout lacks the vendored `mandate` wheel) and the hive-beebou suite (PEP 695 needs ≥3.12). `transition.py --check` passes.

Set `DIGITALMATE_HIVE_HOME_IMAGE_TRIAL=0` (default). No persisted format, Store schema, or client change; the switch is off by default so no deployment is affected until it opts in.

## 问题

自 2026-11-13 晚的 nightly 起，device ST 三条 lane 全部死在 'compile independent test HAP'（启动约 10 秒、21 个 ArkTS 错误），从未跑到用例。真实报错在 CI 上不可见：Windows harness 把编译器输出写进 execution-error.txt，而制品上传被 Actions 存储配额挡住（#1710）。

## 根因

Beebou/Hive 客户端工作（#1243、#1644）带来两类破坏：

1. `DigitalMateWireRequest.params` 联合类型被拓宽（DigitalMateHiveParams / HiveNamedTextRequest / HiveChoiceSendRequest / HiveActivityParams）。四个 ObservedSocket（Artifact/Identity/Downlink/Compatibility）按严格联合类型解码 wire JSON 并直接访问 action / room_id / task_id / artifact_id / submission_id / text —— 17 个编译错误。
2. 抽取的生产方法引用了 ST 宿主没有的新成员：send 之后的 signalHiveActivity、attach 等处的 drainAttachmentCleanup、submitPendingAnswer 里的 submitHiveAnswer 与 DIGITALMATE_HIVE_QUESTION_PREFIX 常量。

## 修复

- 四个 ObservedSocket 改为本地结构化接口（ObservedWireParams 可选字段）解码 —— 观测器不再被客户端严格联合类型门禁，对未来联合类型拓宽免疫；
- ComposerHost 供给新成员：signalHiveActivity 无操作（ST 无 Hive 面板，与 e4aedb190 的意图一致）、drainAttachmentCleanup 异步无操作（ST 无清理存储）、submitHiveAnswer 显式 throw（未覆盖面宁可响亮失败）；
- DigitalMateHiveCards 进入拷贝清单并从生成 index 再导出，常量来自真实客户端模块而非复制粘贴；
- SessionProximity 的 ScriptedTransport 用 as DigitalMateRequest 显式收窄（它只记录普通请求）。

## 验证

- `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-device-st.test.mjs`：36/36（含拷贝清单 import 走查守卫）
- `node --test tests/unit/st-live-wire*.test.mjs`：44/44
- `ST_SUITE=compile-only`：business ✅ / session-proximity ✅ / attachment-policy ✅（回归）
- 修复前基线：business 套件 21 个编译错误（本地 /tmp/dm-st-repro-*/build.log）

pr:1978.body:
## Scope
Restore **image delivery** for authenticated Hive Home and claimed Bee inputs, including up to five selections. Relates to #1930 and #1762; neither is closed by this PR and this is **not complete v0.1.12 attachment parity**. Replacement candidate for #1945: do not merge both. No other PR was closed.

Current published head: `66935e7d46ef320ac3873667a23185ddb4b1e152`.
Rebased onto main `34a156f201627497f6fe92974c071cf25586899c`, preserving weather-report isolation, device-city/task-place wiring and existing runtime behavior. Integrates the effective changes from Claude's local `998e5d918`, with additional safety fixes and review regressions.

## Changes
- Preserve the phone picker maximum of five; admit five distinct Home uploads when the image pilot is enabled, preserve order, hold the batch in the admission transaction and reject/roll back invalid or oversized inputs.
- Give multiple sources distinct Attachment-owner holds while preserving original single-PDF lookup. No schema migration.
- Send authorized images through Beebou `image_url` and Bee `chat.send media_items`, with live owner authority, digest and size rechecks. No arbitrary model-provided file paths.
- Keep the 5 MiB per-image model limit distinct from the 10 MiB upload limit. Enabled-image Bee materialization budget accommodates five allowed images.
- Normalize model-bound JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP to bounded JPEG derivatives; PNG/GIF/WebP reject over 16 million pixels before full decoding and resize before alpha compositing. Original attachment bytes stay unchanged.
- Normalization represents the first frame, uses a white background for transparency and may lose fine text/detail. Pixel/byte limits are not a measured provider token-cost guarantee.
- Emit explicit notices for held images that fail read/normalization; distinguish a saved Host filesystem copy from actual model visual access.
- Configure/clear Bee image state under its session lock, including errors/cancellation; no cross-turn/cross-Bee image carryover or persisted wire bytes.
- Include image capability and policy in runtime identity. No old-Bee migration layer, per the pre-release constraint.
- Keep `read_file` text-only; register the trial flag and enroll runtime regression files under the existing CI discovery pattern.
- Keep adapter growth within the existing gate through same-owner configuration/control reuse. Document-read error boundaries are unchanged; no architecture inventory, exemption or line-limit rule was changed.

## v3.1 responsibility alignment (66935e7d4)
Aligns with #1316 / RFC #1228 H-C6 and H-C8/A20, the existing per-Task attachment delivery from #1677/#1670/#1697, and #1996. Proposed/unimplemented v3.1 APIs are not assumed available.

- Introduce independent model-facing `attachment_ids`; `source_ids` remains message lineage. Missing selection on a file-bearing input refuses before delivery with only scoped candidate IDs; `[]` sends none. Each Bee gets its selected current-input subset, never all unrelated files automatically. Host/Attachment owner still authorizes delivery.
- Preserve stable operation IDs, Store fingerprints, original receipts and accepted/applied/completed distinctions. Selection order is canonicalized to admitted-input order. Queue/addressed envelopes stay Host-bound; failed steer does not become a new task.
- Re-read scoped Home image authority at each provider call, after asynchronous projections and after normalization. Revoked images are not resent; owner failure/cancellation never falls back to cached bytes. Keep existing tuple compatibility and wire-only non-persistence.
- Keep Beebou bounded understanding/coordinating, complex file work with relevant Bees. File contents, names and OCR are untrusted data, not authorization. Stop is not withdrawal/deletion or erasure of history.

### Current change verification
- Independently rerun: Home adapter **26**, selection unit **12**, provider-wire **15**, real HiveStore/SQLite **3** tests, all passing (56 total).
- Real Store tests directly import production selection code and exercise stored receipts, same-operation replay after hold withdrawal, changed-subset conflict, selection ordering, two-Bee input isolation and a pending waiting-steer supplement without a new task. Transaction container, Host candidate/hold callbacks, waiting observation and receiver adapter are explicit substitutes. **Not complete EngineStore/Repository/Bridge authorization acceptance.**
- Beebou delegation/dispatch-receipt/pending-steer/selection: **30 passed, 1 skipped, 13 subtests passed**.
- Architecture: **346 of 588 files checked, no new findings**, only existing baseline warnings. `git diff --check` passed. Independent final review found no new publication blocker.
- Broader runtime directory run: **165 passed, 145 subtests**, stopped at 3 Windows-related failures (CRLF byte-limit, symlink privilege, POSIX mode). Not a green full suite.
- Broader Beebou collection blocked by missing `jsonschema`; full Bridge/EngineStore paths have missing `keyring`/`aiosqlite` and Windows POSIX limitations. No dependency installation, platform emulation or weakened gates.
- Current-head remote observation: [repo-size-guard run 44308078571](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/44308078571) completed successfully. Combined commit statuses are empty. This does not prove the full CI check rollup; checks below are explicitly historical.

### Precise boundaries
Home image projection cannot recall provider-visible content or erase conversation understanding. Existing Attachment-owner rules govern per-Task copy revocation and cleanup. Already-accepted receipt replay is verified for hold withdrawal, not erasure of the original delivered input. Existing consumption preserves that row; a future erasure flow needs Host status/reconciliation rather than relaxed model authorization. No Stop resurrection or global copy-deletion API is introduced.
Historical #1697 G5 text evidence (14 PASS / 0 FAIL / 3 NOT_RUN) is not image/binary acceptance. No real vision provider, five-image device run, full Bridge composition, installation, deployment or full v0.1.12 file UX claim. Design/acceptance detail: [HAD contract](docs/implementations/contracts/hive-attachment-delegation-v1.md).

## Earlier integration verification (d81b514a)
Local verification after the final rebase:
- **Home: 20 unittest cases passed; Bee image owner: 13 passed** (33 total). These include actual wiring assertions, three in-memory deletion counterexamples, owner/size/integrity checks, and the 6 MiB materialized-file versus 5 MiB model-input refusal regression.
- Six same-owner contracts passed against both pre-refactor and final methods: configuration guards/side-effect ordering, control/snapshot combinations, and document-read failure behavior.
- Architecture scan: **588 files, 346 checked, zero findings**. `git diff --check` passed.
- Direct production-function checks passed for PNG/GIF/WebP derivatives, transparent 12 MP image resizing, PNG EXIF orientation, animated GIF first-frame selection, and predecode pixel-budget rejection. The oversized-dimensions case uses a mock; no OOM experiment was performed.
- Independent code reviews found no remaining blocker in the final local changes.

### Historical remote checks observed for d81b514a
- [repo-size-guard](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/44298482220): completed successfully.
- Commit status `pr-ready`: success.
- These observations **do not establish that every CI check passed**. The available workflow query covers pull-request-triggered runs on its first page; a complete check-runs rollup was not available through the authenticated connector, and local GitHub CLI is not signed in.

### Not run / known failures
- Full Bridge pytest collection for `test_model_images.py`, `test_workswarm_bee_images.py` and `test_hive_bee_images_wire.py` was blocked by missing `keyring` in the existing Python 3.12 environment. These full suites are **NOT_RUN locally on the final integration**, not passing suites. No dependency installation or weakened gate was used.
- Existing input-source materialization suite: **5 passed, 2 failed due to Windows platform constraints** (symlink WinError 1314; POSIX 0700 expectation observed as 0777). No security assertions or system permissions were relaxed. Linux verification remains required.
- Earlier Linux counts (49 image/integration cases, 9 owner-security cases and 111 runtime-discovery cases) belonged to earlier PR revisions. They are historical evidence, **not reruns of this head**. The earlier expanded Linux run also had two node-execution PermissionError failures.
- Earlier configuration-inventory validation reported pre-existing `report.goal.download` classification drift; that full validation was not re-established as green on this head.
- Source/owner tests and controlled transport substitutes do not establish full Bridge composition, five-image real-provider acceptance, real WorkSwarm acceptance, visual quality, provider token usage, or physical HarmonyOS-device acceptance.
- **No real vision-provider run, device test, installer build, deployment or feature enablement was performed.** Full non-image attachment experience, reply/follows combinations and complete attachment parity remain separate work.

## Review follow-up
Code/tests address:
- [F3](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1978#discussion_r4611410025): assert both Home wiring calls and Bee `image_inputs`; verify that deleting each connection is detected.
- [F4](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1978#discussion_r4611410028): explicitly clarify that a saved Host copy does not make a rejected image visually available; preserve user text and test a real temporary 6 MiB materialization.
- [F5](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1978#discussion_r4611410033): point to `test_hive_bee_images_wire.py` and retain the non-full-composition/live-acceptance caveat.

Latest GitHub read-back on head 66935e7d4 shows F1–F5 resolved by agent-ci-infra-bot; F4/F5 remain marked outdated. This update did not resolve any thread or post a review comment, and resolution is not full integration/device acceptance.

## User-run image validation
- Use this PR's candidate commit, a vision-capable model, `DIGITALMATE_HIVE_HOME_IMAGE_TRIAL=1`, and `[inputs] enabled = true` in `temp/hive-tools/src/dm_hive_tools/config/tools.toml`. These are prerequisites, not settings changed by this PR.
- JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP: each image at most **5 MiB**, **1–5 images** per Home input. Upload's 10 MiB allowance is not the model limit.
- Single image: ask a visible fact absent from its filename/question. Five images: check a separate identifiable fact from every image in order. For complex comparison, check the selected images reach the relevant Bee but not unrelated Bees.
- Next text-only turn must not carry old image bytes.
- Distinguish admission errors (oversized or unavailable source: reject the entire batch) from post-admission decoding failures (drop that image with a named not-sent notice; valid images/text may continue). Confirm a subsequent text request still works.
- Record exact candidate/client/runtime/model versions and per-image expected/actual outcomes. These real-model/device checks remain **not performed by this PR** and are left to the user's candidate validation. No deployment/merge has been performed.

## Rollout / rollback
`DIGITALMATE_HIVE_HOME_IMAGE_TRIAL=0` remains the default; enabling requires the attachment input root. Changed runtime dependencies fail closed. PR readiness is retained as requested, **not a declaration of rollout readiness**. See `temp/hive-runtime/bee-input-images.md` for the maintained capability and acceptance boundaries.

Closes #1970

关联 #1030。

## 实现

- 在现有 `brief.memory` 步骤的 `note` 中记录 `search_id`。`memory.search` 汇总目录读取及锁等待、候选去重、后端读取、校验、排序和最终复核。`durations_ms` 各区间互不重叠，`completed_read_ms` 分解其中已完成的后端读取。
- `memory.read` 使用单调时钟记录读许可、协程调度、默认执行器排队、后端锁、执行和回到调用方的时间。超时或取消时记录调用方结果，后台结束后以同一 `operation_id` 补齐后端结果和许可释放。
- 给 snapshot 列表标记来源，通过 `lock_id` 对照搜索和列表的锁占用。列表按 `get_many`、缺项后的 `fallback_get` 和 `get` 汇总，并保留最多八次最长占锁明细。检索保留前八次目录分页的明细和异常读取。

## 路径与设计

- 生产入口为 `server_engine.engine_cli serve`。记忆读取、校验和 FIFO 锁由现有 `EngineMemory` 管理（DM31-M38）。Bridge 的 `diagnostics` 通过既有进程日志通道输出版本化、无内容的 JSON。
- Share log 从现有的 `DIGITALMATE_BRIDGE_LOG` 所指定的文件或工作区的 `agent-bridge.log` 收录日志。托管环境可按 `digitalmate.memory.read` 或 `event_type` 查询进程日志，再用 `search_id` 对照 `turns.jsonl`。
- 实现基线 `0b13c3cfd43f7258cf6f09c842f114a46f03b8b9`，测试提交 `3aaa36422de47f19aa578c8346e053651505420f`。[Feature 设计草稿 v1](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/3aaa36422de47f19aa578c8346e053651505420f/docs/assets/feature-design/memory-read-timing-1970-design-v1.pptx) 待记忆和诊断 owner 评审。

## 验证

- Windows CPython 3.13.12，pytest 9.0.3，从当前提交加载 Bridge、迁移期包与契约源码。运行 `test_engine_memory_async.py`、`test_engine_memory.py`、`test_engine_memory_cap.py`、`test_engine_memory_changes.py`、`test_engine_memory_redaction.py`、`test_engine_brief.py`、`test_engine_request_snapshot.py` 和 `test_hive_profile_log.py`，313 个用例及 886 个子用例通过。用例使用真实 SQLite 目录与内容库、共享锁和默认执行器，并注入阶段延迟、错误、批量缺项和回退。Share log 用已采集的测试日志验证关联键。

- `test_every_emitter_nulls_prose_and_keeps_identifier_like_tokens` 依赖 Windows 缺少的 `os.O_DIRECTORY`，留待 Linux 运行。真实 mem2 和现网日志采集待环境验证。

Dockerfile / Dockerfile.dockerignore 的缺失项（weather 包 COPY 与白名单）已由 main 上的 `ff400bcc0` 与 PR #1979 修复，本 PR 不再包含，避免重复与冲突。

pr:1995.body:
Refs #1983

Rollout step 3 of [place resolution v1](docs/implementations/contracts/place-resolution-v1.md): **PLR-C6** (the `place` argument and Host verification) and **PLR-C10** (the place-aware tool extension point), with `native_weather` as the first adopter.

Place-aware tools are **Bee tools**. The place is verified on Beebou's side, where the conversation is, and enforced on the Bee's side, where the tool runs. Beebou's catalog and its Home weather path (`HomeWeather`) are unchanged.

## Beebou side: `dispatch` (mode new)
- `dispatch` gains an optional `place` object `{source, name, quote, quote_message_id, choice_ref}`. A `steer` cannot carry one.
- The Host checks it before any effect:
  - `named`: the quote occurs, casefolded, in the current user message.
  - `conversation`: `choice_ref` is the place card this input answered, the chosen option is this quote, message and name, and the quoted message was in the window recorded with the card.
  - `current_location`: always accepted at dispatch.
- The card record is step 2's `place_card` in the accepted `ask_choice` result (#1994, merged). `HiveTurnStartup._place_choice` reads it with step 2's `chosen_place` and builds a `CardChoice` (card reply ID, source, name, quote, quote message ID, window). Step 2's chosen-place notes now carry the exact place object to dispatch, and its `decision_rule` tells Beebou to pass `place` on dispatch. Step 2 and step 3 keys share the one `load_place_resolution` key set.
- A refusal (`PLACE_QUOTE_MISSING`, `PLACE_NOT_CHOSEN`, `PLACE_STALE`, `PLACE_SOURCE_INVALID`) is a tool result with `reason`, `effect_entered: false` and a config `detail` that sends the model back through PLR-C4. Nothing is delivered.
- An accepted place is stored with the new Bee task in the Host-owned `TaskPlaces`. A Host line in the task text states the exact object.

## Bee side: `PlaceGuard`
- A tool opts in with `place = "city"` on `BeeEffectTool`. For product tools that is `bee_product_search.PLACE_TOOLS`. The hive-tools catalog and Registry descriptors get the same field as a hook.
- The Bee's product search MCP lists a declared tool with the `place` schema instead of the free-text `location`. The listing comes from `DIGITALMATE_SEARCH_PLACE_TOOLS`, which only an owned Bee's environment carries, so other runtimes keep the old listing.
- The gate refuses:
  - a task with no stored place (`PLACE_MISSING`);
  - any place other than the task's stored one (`PLACE_MISMATCH`);
  - a malformed place or a free-text location (`PLACE_SOURCE_INVALID`);
  - a `current_location` call whose `name` is not a completed `device_weather_city` result of the same task. The reader records each result in `TaskPlaces`, and the Bee passes `{source: current_location, name: city}` (or `"city, region"`). Without a result the call is refused and nothing is guessed. This matches step 2's `device_weather_rule`.
- A task-bound refusal is an `EffectRefused` grant whose reason the gate shows to the model.
- The provider receives only `{"location": name}`, so `native_weather` itself is unchanged.

## Compatibility decision
There is no free-text compatibility path: this is the safe default, documented in PLR-C6. A Bee task with no Host place gets `PLACE_MISSING` from place-aware tools. Like the #1788 dispatch grant, the stored place is process memory, so after a restart a running task's place-aware tools refuse until it is dispatched again.

## Model-facing `native_weather` (Bee)
Before: `{location: string (required), region: string|null}`, described as "Get today's weather using a city and its administrative region, a location ID, or coordinates…"

After: `{place: {source: named|conversation|current_location (required), name, quote, quote_message_id, choice_ref}}` (required, no other fields), described as "Get today's weather for this task's place. Pass the task's place object exactly as the task states it…" The full schema is asserted in `test_hive_bee_place_listing.py`.

## Config
- `place_resolution.toml` gains `dispatch_place_description`, `refusal_detail` and `task_place_note`. They are part of `PLACE_RESOLUTION_KEYS`, read by the same `load_place_resolution`.
- The new `dm_hive_runtime/config/place_guard.toml` holds the place object's field descriptions, the Bee description, the Bee refusal details and the `max_chars` bound.
- Nothing logs a place name or a quote.

## Verification (local, Python 3.13 venv, vendored openjiuwen)
- New tests:
  - `temp/hive-runtime/tests/test_place_guard.py`: each PLR-C6 check and refusal, the step-2 record reader, schema replacement for a declared test tool and for `native_weather`, the Bee mismatch, missing place and current location, provider input (name only) and no place text in logs.
  - `tests/test_hive_beebou_place_dispatch.py`: the dispatch refusals as tool results, the place stored with the task, the place carried from dispatch to the Bee tool, the dispatch schema and the no-logs check.
  - `tests/test_hive_bee_place_listing.py`: the MCP listing before and after, and the child environment.
- Updated: `test_hive_bee_product_search.py`. The real Host/Store/gate tests now record a task place and call `native_weather` with `place`.
- Results:
  - Hive, Bee, search, weather, workswarm and server suites, plus `temp/{hive-beebou,hive-runtime,hive-tools,beebou,device-weather-city}`: 1815 passed with `-n 8`.
  - Under parallel load, 5 failures and 15 errors appeared in `test_server_scope`, `test_server_auth`, `test_workswarm_context_consumer` and `test_hive_tools_write_exec`. Those suites pass when run serially (80 passed in the server/workswarm group), so they are flaky under load, not regressions.
- The architecture gate (`tools/architecture/check.py`) is clean.
- Not run: a real-model PLR-S run, and a device or emulator run.

## Follow-ups (not in this PR)
- Step 4: register the device-city reader through Registry with `place`. The DWC-C2 check here stays unchanged.
- Merging with #1994: combine the toml keys and `PLACE_RESOLUTION_KEYS` and the `HiveTurnStartup` / `HiveBeebouTools` constructor lines, and update Beebou's decision rule to pass `place` on dispatch.

pr:1996.body:
## Summary
- Consolidate Beebou's six responsibilities and coordinator/worker boundary under implementations; keep bounded simple reads and owner-mediated coordination distinct from general execution.
- Add one authoritative capability-governance protocol and retain the existing feature-development anchor as a navigation entry.
- New/materially expanded capabilities require architecture design/review and keeping the responsible architecture/Beebou roles informed. No new universal two-owner approval gate; existing change-control acceptance still applies when accepted guarantees change.
- No personal names in the maintained guidance; no runtime tool, credential, permission or connection-flow change.

## Main reconciliation
Related issue: #1842. #1924 is merged.
Rebuilt this documentation-only branch on main `6a432a4a8b9bf2993e9401755dc9d74b1ef257ab`, including the merged capability implementation at `d05272174b24f0e007cffcb462dd881eb7843e6a`.
Preserved the six-responsibility table, source observations, dynamic metadata and trust-boundary evidence, historical source revisions and NOT_RUN acceptance limits. Removed duplicate governance text from feature-development in favor of its canonical protocol. Documentation-only changes; the subsequent filename audit also migrates the owned streaming draft.

## PR references
No blanket ban on PR numbers was found in AGENTS or the maintained contributor protocols. Documentation maintenance explicitly requires preserving historical source/evidence and links.
Accordingly, removed PR identifiers from the contract title and dynamic-metadata section title, corrected obsolete candidate/unmerged wording, and retained PR links in source-provenance sections. The maintained contract now uses `hive-assistant-capabilities.md` without an issue number. The old numbered path is only a compatibility pointer preserving prior anchors; the contract index points to the new subject-based path. Issue #1842 (not #1942) is retained only as source provenance. Both sides of the new main update logs were preserved. This is a maintainability cleanup, not a newly invented repository rule.

## Verification
- Checked 206 relative Markdown target paths across the twelve changed documents against the fetched latest-main tree plus new files: no missing targets.
- Checked trailing whitespace and conflict markers: none.
- Fetched all twelve published files back and compared exact content: all match.
- Verified retained trust-boundary evidence against merged main; no verification result was promoted.
- GitHub changed-file list confirms documentation only; pre-review PR head verified at `bb066796bb6021b9b196703230b21ade71d18a0f`.
- Earlier local conflict resolution passed git diff --check. Local architecture check under default Python failed due to an unsupported old interpreter; Python 3.12 rerun was blocked by Windows transport disconnection. Final revision did not get a successful local architecture run.
- Runtime/live-model/device/provider/deployment checks NOT_RUN (documentation-only).
- CI results are tracked separately, without bypassing gates. Not merged by this task.

## Review corrections

## Root cause

The transcript merged raw snapshot/history rows only by row ID and appended optimistic rows without carrying their submission identity. Different projections of one admitted user `message_id` (`submission_id` on the wire) could therefore remain as separate user bubbles around the failure reply.

## Fix

- Collapse only visible principal `message` rows sharing a stable `submission_id`, retaining the first authoritative row in transcript order.
- Carry `submissionId` on optimistic user rows and let the committed row win during transcript interleaving.
- Do not compare message text; different submissions with identical text and all assistant rows remain independent. Raw history cursors and pagination remain unchanged.

Fixes #1942

pr:2002.body:
Fixes #2001

### Why

At the first Bridge start, `LiveIngestionJob` records the owner's cutoff, and live ingestion covers only positions above it. Under §7b, positions at or below the cutoff belong to `BackfillRunner(handoff=...)`, but nothing in production called it. An upgraded v0.1.12 workspace therefore never got its old Home tasks, approved memories or Beebou turns into Global Memory.

### What

- `LiveIngestionJob.start()` authorizes the cutoff as before. It then builds one `BackfillRunner.in_directory(<provider dir>, source, provider, handoff=ledger.for_source(id))` per authorized source.
- `LiveIngestionJob.backfill()` drains each unfinished runner before every live pass. A source whose pass fails, or whose provider answer is unknown, is retried on the next tick without holding the other sources. Progress is durable per source (`hive-history-backfill.<source_id>.sqlite3`), so it runs once per workspace and a finished source is skipped.
- `live.toml [live] backfill = true` is the switch. The settings parser validates it.
- No model judge is wired. As in live ingestion, old turns are classified by rules and citations only, and ambiguous ones are kept as unclassified fragments.
- Docs: `temp/hive-memory/README.md` and §7b of `beebou-hive-phase3-delivery.md`.

### Tests

New `JobBackfillTests` in `test_hive_memory_live.py`, on the real legacy store, Hive Store and provider:
- the first start backfills old tasks, memory and the Beebou turn as historical, while a later task goes through live;
- a restart in a new process adds no unit, ingest call or publication;
- `backfill = false` leaves the old library out.

Local runs on Python 3.13:
- `temp/hive-memory/tests`: 74 passed
- `test_hive_live_ingestion_startup.py` and `test_hive_memory_home_feed_boundary.py`: 9 passed
- `tests/architecture` import, domain and transition checks: 71 passed

## Summary The architecture CI gate checks static imports and registrations only. It cannot tell whether policy sits in the right owner, whether an adapter stays thin, whether a second writer appears at runtime, or whether code matches its reviewed design. This PR collects the Issue-to-merge rules, which are currently spread across `AGENTS.md`, `temp/AGENTS.md`, the protocols and the migration developer guide, into one protocol page with traceable IDs, plus a skill that coding agents follow. - **`docs/protocols/development.md`**: stable `DEV-01..15` rules, each linked to its authoritative source. Lanes **B** (bug fix), **F** (feature within accepted boundaries) and **A** (architecture-changing feature) have their own design obligations (`DEV-F1..F6`, `DEV-A1..A6`). The page also covers the `temp//` placement table and design upload and versioning under `docs/assets/feature-design/`. It defines the `

-D/S/C/T` traceability IDs, a **PR trace block**, and a ten-question self-review for what CI misses. - **`.agents/skills/digitalmate-development/`**: the ordered procedure (`SKILL.md`), `references/design-upload.md`, and `scripts/check_trace.py`, a stdlib checker for the PR trace block. The checker verifies that the design, spec, ADR, `ownership.json` and test files exist, that the design is indexed, that lane A IDs are defined in the spec, and that every check has a status. It is a contributor tool, not a CI gate. - **`docs/protocols/README.md`** gets an emphasized entry block and a new task row. `feature-development.md` and the existing `digitalmate-dev` skill cross-link to the new page. `UPDATES.md` has a dated entry. Fixes #1726

## 设计与 owner

设计稿：`docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-status-consumption-1726.md`，已链接到 Issue #1726 的 Design Ideas。

- Session Store 仍是唯一持久 writer；Host 保留模型、工具和上下文权限；Harness 只持有 RAM 执行状态。
- 所有 `report(status)`（包括 Bee 提问知会）各自进入 report-only 轮，不新增 ask wire kind；用户答案仍直接恢复原 Bee 等待点。
- 无 pending user 时 status/done 分别按 seq 有界分页；status 的 retry/backoff 不再遮蔽有效 done。
- 保留每任务 4 条 pending / 8 条累计 status 配额、同 ID 幂等、done 终态校验、用户优先、Stop 和问答独立通道。

**设计评审尚未完成**：合入前需 Session Store（#1311）、Beebou Harness / Host（#1310 / #1309）、Delivery（#1223）及 SC02-B1 场景负责人签收。

## 实现

- Store 认领 status 并写入可信 `bee_status` EVENT；只有对应 COMPLETED Run 才能作为 status 消费见证，旧通用 ACK 端口不能凭任意字符串清 status。
- Host 增加显式 `complete_without_output` / `completed_report_snapshot` 窄接口；普通用户和 done 的非空答复校验不变。
- Harness 允许 status 无用户输出，Store 原子提交 context revision、`COMPLETED, answer=NULL` 和 `consume_witness=run_id`，不写伪造助手答复。
- NULL 完成仅限 status；user NULL 完成和藏在 NULL 提交中的未声明助手答复均被拒绝。
- Harness drain 处理独立 status，deferred status 不阻塞后续有效 done；失败恢复、重放与并发沿用原 Run/UNKNOWN 对账。
- SC02-B1 更新为“提问 status 独立静默成轮 + 原 Bee 直接恢复”，不是删除通知或削弱权限断言。

## 本地验证

基线：`34a156f201627497f6fe92974c071cf25586899c`。实现提交见本 PR head。真实参与者为 SQLite Session Store、HostAPI、NativeBeebouRunner、BeebouHarness、CLI Bridge 和受控 HTTP 模型；受控 Bee runtime / Host isolation witness 在测试中明确标注。

pr:2008.body:
## 问题

最新 main 构建服务端镜像直接失败，任何人都无法产出镜像（#2005）：

```
#26 [bot-build 23/27] COPY temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city /build/temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city
#26 ERROR: failed to calculate checksum of ref ...: "/temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city": not found
```

## 根因

真正的构建上下文过滤器是 `harness/personal-agent/deploy/Dockerfile.dockerignore`（与 Dockerfile 同名的 `<Dockerfile>.dockerignore`，BuildKit 优先于仓库根的 `.dockerignore`）。它是白名单式规则：先 `**` 全排除，再逐条 `!` 放行。

#1903（`fix(weather): 按本次设备定位查询本地天气`，合并于 2026-11-18 16:01 +08，merge commit `63ce28529`）在 `Dockerfile` 第 62 行新增了

```
COPY temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city /build/temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city
```

但同一 PR **只改了 `Dockerfile`，没有同步 `Dockerfile.dockerignore`** 的白名单。被忽略规则排除的路径在 BuildKit 里表现为 `not found`，于是 COPY 校验失败，构建在依赖层之前就终止。

模块本身在仓库里是完整的（`git ls-files temp/device-weather-city` 有 `src/dm_device_weather_city/__init__.py` 等），不是文件缺失。

## 修复

在 `harness/personal-agent/deploy/Dockerfile.dockerignore` 中，按现有 `bee-artifacts` 段的同构格式补 8 行：

```
!temp/device-weather-city/
temp/device-weather-city/**
!temp/device-weather-city/src/
temp/device-weather-city/src/**
!temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city/
!temp/device-weather-city/src/dm_device_weather_city/**
temp/device-weather-city/src/**/__pycache__/
temp/device-weather-city/src/**/*.pyc
```

只改这一个文件，不动 Dockerfile、不动任何 Python 源码，也不改变镜像内容构成（只是让已被 COPY 声明的目录真正进入构建上下文）。

## 验证

同一 ADX `adx-jiuwen-test-6` 的独立 BuildKit Pod（buildkit v0.25.2，`linux/amd64`，`--local dockerfile=<ctx>/harness/personal-agent/deploy`）：

- 未打补丁：在同一位置失败（`COPY temp/device-weather-city` → `not found`），两次复现一致
- 打补丁后：COPY 校验通过，构建继续完成 pip 依赖、wheel 构建、层导出与推送

补丁生效的那次构建源码为：main `38c4d124` + 无关 PR #1924（`88b771f2c`）+ 本修复（`6a2d8fdf2`），镜像已推送并验真：

```
swr.ap-southeast-1.myhuaweicloud.com/openjiuwen-online-test/digitalmate:pr1924v2-20261118-1745-6a2d8fd-test-6
digest        sha256:d0c14b2e38c43ecddf571210fa2940abc27be9238fdf7911f5ff78ac4c8b2187
config digest sha256:223cf30a31f52d947ab3f5f156d201c55980a2c4fabf85d905f97c5841a6f0eb
revision      (集成分支提交) · platform linux/amd64 · 12 层
```

远端校验：manifest 字节重算 sha256 == 远端 `Docker-Content-Digest`、config blob 哈希与 metadata 一致、`registry.py verify` 返回 `verified: true`。

未运行：仓库 CI（node-ut / hypium-ut / 架构检查）。本改动只触及构建上下文清单，不涉及运行时代码；纯 main + 本修复的完整镜像构建未单独复跑（上述成功构建包含一个与该路径无关的 PR）。

pr:2010.body:
Rollout step 4 of [place-resolution-v1](docs/implementations/contracts/place-resolution-v1.md): the #1335 Registry consumer that makes "current location" real for weather.

Refs #1983
Refs #1335

## What changes

**Server (Host)**
- `device_weather_city` stays a zero-argument Bee tool registered through Registry; its descriptor (`device_city_tool`) now declares `place = "city"` and takes its description from config. Its implementation identity includes the configured wording.
- `PlaceGuard.check_device_city`: the reader is admitted only for a task whose stored place is `current_location`. No place gives `PLACE_MISSING`; a `named` or `conversation` task gives `PLACE_NOT_CURRENT_LOCATION` (the place the person named or picked wins, with no device read). The Bee gate now shows a reader's task-bound `EffectRefused` reason instead of a generic refusal. No refusal carries a place name.
- A completed city (and region) is recorded in the task's `TaskPlaces`, so `native_weather` with `{source: current_location, name: <city>}` passes `PlaceGuard`, and no other city does.
- `permission_denied`, `service_disabled`, `location_unavailable`, `revoked`, `timeout`, `cancelled` and `device_unavailable` return `{status, detail}`. `detail` is the configured next step: say why, ask the person to type a city, and do not call again or guess. Nothing is recorded, so there is no fallback place. The owner already asks only the originating socket, at most once per Run.
- `place_tool_listings` leaves zero-argument place-aware tools out, so the Bee keeps the reader's own zero-argument listing.
- Beebou's `device_weather_rule` now says to tell the person why and ask for a typed city, never using the IP address, network country, memory or an earlier city.

**Phone (PLR-C7, ADR-0025)**
- `ensureDeviceCityLocationGrant` reuses any existing grant with no prompt. With no OS grant, it shows the system dialog once, for approximate (city-level) access only. A first grant turns on the app's location switch at approximate precision. A refusal is remembered and not asked again. A saved app opt-out with an OS grant still in place is respected.
- Coordinates stay on the phone (DWC-C4). The server still admits only bounded city/region strings.

**Config, no hard-coded tunables**
- `place_guard.toml`: `device_weather_city_description`, `PLACE_NOT_CURRENT_LOCATION`, and `[place_guard.device_city]` with `timeout_ms` (the owner's wait, which now covers the OS dialog; a test checks it stays below the Bee gate's `decision_timeout_ms`) and the per-status `unavailable` wording. Every key is required.

**Docs**
- Contract PLR-C10 (table plus an "Implementation (step 4)" section) and PLR-R, the DWC status line, and `docs/implementations/UPDATES.md`.

## Tests
- New `test_hive_device_city_reader.py` covers:
  - the descriptor and registration shape;
  - `current_location`-only admission;
  - the result recorded in `TaskPlaces`, and `native_weather` accepting that city and refusing others;
  - each failure status giving the type-a-city detail with no fallback;
  - a source with no authorization never reaching the phone;
  - coordinate/address sentinels and place names absent from the model result, `TaskPlaces` and logs.
- `test_hive_device_city_transport.py` (real WebSocket path): no place and named-place refusals before any device request; a repeat call says why.
- `test_place_guard.py`: new config keys fail closed.
- `tests/unit/device-permissions.test.mjs`: grant reuse without a dialog, one approximate dialog with no grant, a remembered refusal, app opt-out, and a stale request.
- `tests/unit/device-city-request.test.mjs`: the grant step runs before the read; `permission_denied` sends no city.
- Local results:
  - Python suites for `hive-runtime`, `hive-beebou`, `device-weather-city` and `agent_bridge`: every failure also fails on unmodified main (8 environment-specific tests).
  - Node unit suite: 3535 passed. The 3 failures are Chromium visual captures unavailable on this machine.
  - The architecture scan is clean.

## Device acceptance
An emulator run against a cloud test environment built from this branch is in progress. Results will be added here before merging.

pr:2011.body:
Closes #2000
Refs #1983

## What
The Bee's `native_weather` now defaults to today but accepts the day or days the user asks about. Contract: [place-resolution-v1 PLR-C11](docs/implementations/contracts/place-resolution-v1.md).

### Bee schema
| Before (step 3) | After |
| --- | --- |
| `{place}` required, `additionalProperties: false` | `{place, date?, days?}`: `place` required; `date` is `YYYY-MM-DD` (first day); `days` is an integer 1..`max_days` and requires `date`; `additionalProperties: false` |

- No `date`: today in the **task's time zone**, which is the PLR-C2 zone of the dispatching message (the client's reported zone, else the workspace default). Beebou's dispatch records it with the place in the Host-owned `TaskZones` (`dm_hive_runtime.assembly.weather_dates`). The Bee never passes a zone.
- `native_weather` runs as a gate bound effect (`BeeProductSearch.apply_bound`). The provider's `start_date`/`end_date` come from the bound Task and are checked again there, never taken raw from model input.
- `place_guard.toml`'s `native_weather_description` no longer says "today".

### Beebou
`date_rule` in `place_resolution.toml` is appended to the place instruction. Beebou turns 明天/后天/周五/这周末/未来N天/tomorrow/Friday/this weekend/next N days into concrete `YYYY-MM-DD` dates against the time line and writes them into the Bee task. The Bee copies them and never computes a relative day. Answers name the place and the date(s) and cite each forecast date.

### Provider
`engine_weather.forecast(..., start_date, end_date)` requests Open-Meteo `daily` with `start_date`/`end_date` and returns `dates` plus one `days[]` row per local day (`weather`, `high_c`, `low_c`, `precipitation_mm`, `precipitation_probability_percent`, `rain_expected`). A request for exactly the place's own today keeps the existing today view (`forecast_days=1`, current hour). Without dates, behaviour is unchanged (automation, Home weather, `engine_tools_mcp`).

### Limits and past days
- `weather_dates.toml` sets `horizon_days = 13` (today through today + 13) and `max_days = 7`, plus all wording.
- Refusals: `DATE_INVALID`, `DATE_RANGE_TOO_LONG`, `DATE_PAST`, `DATE_BEYOND_HORIZON`, `DATE_ZONE_MISSING`.
- **Past days are refused**, not served from the archive API. That keeps one endpoint and one result shape. Beebou tells the user past weather is unavailable.

Out of scope: Home weather (`HomeWeather`, today-only consent) is unchanged.

## Tests
- `temp/hive-runtime/tests/test_weather_dates.py`: the default today in the task zone, including Shanghai ahead of UTC and Los Angeles behind UTC; a single date; a range; beyond the horizon; a past date; invalid input; the config loader; `TaskZones`; the Bee schema; refusals through `BeeProductSearch`; and that a dated tool never runs unbound.
- `test_engine_weather_dates.py`: the provider's query parameters (`daily`, `start_date`, `end_date`, `timezone`, no `forecast_days`), the daily rows, that the place's own today keeps the today view, that a request without dates is unchanged, coordinates, incomplete responses, invalid windows, and the MCP date arguments.
- `test_hive_beebou_place_dispatch.py`: the zone is carried from dispatch to the Bee (only with an accepted place), and `_turn_zone` uses the client zone or the default.
- `test_beebou_place_window.py`: `date_rule` is required and appended to the instruction.
- Existing place/listing/product-search/device-city tests now record a zone with the place.
- Eval data: `tests/eval/hive-live/regression-cases/2000-weather-dates.json` (5 zh/en relative-date cases; validated by `node --test tests/eval/hive-live.test.mjs`, not run live).

Local run on a Python 3.13 venv with the vendored openjiuwen: all of `temp/hive-runtime`, `temp/hive-beebou` and the Bridge `test_hive*`/`*weather*`/`*search*`/`test_user_location`. Result: 1431 passed, 9 failed. The same 9 fail on base 6a432a4a (`test_hive_beebou_time_note` ×2, `test_hive_home_quote_frames` ×1, `test_user_location` ×6), so this change adds no new failures. Architecture gate: 0 findings, and `hive_bee_runtime.py` stays at the 500-line adapter cap.

pr:2013.body:
Fixes #1759

## 方案

- 新增显式 `RetainedBeeHarness`：由 release 同时保留原 factory、原 identity 与当前 factory；只允许 core 不同，model/tools/skills 和 owned adapter 必须一致。
- `ready_for` 遍历 current/retained 的精确 Profile。旧 factory 临时未就绪保持 queued；只有全部就绪且当前 revision 无匹配才形成 `BindingConflict`。
- 执行、问答和终局见证继续 resolve 原 Store binding；Stop 搜索 current/retained factory 的原 lane。新 Bee 只绑定 current，未传 retained 时 #1496/#1557 行为不变。
- 不改 Store schema、binding 字节或重试语义；不复活驱逐身份、不自动重放未知效果。

## 设计与评审阻塞

包含版本化契约、ADR-0034 和 8 页架构评审稿，覆盖执行、问答、queue/steer、Stop、终局见证、两阶段滚动升级、重启/恢复、重放/丢 ACK。

**PROPOSED：合并前仍需 Runtime/Host、Registry、Store/Manager、Bot owner 完成 D1/C1–C4 设计评审。** #1559 的 roster/派发拒绝不在本 PR 重复实现；#1899 的 successor proof 不在本方案采用。

## 已运行

- 新增 retained binding 定向组合：5/5 通过（真实 SQLite Store、Registry/Host、WorkSwarm adapter，受控 wire/model/witness）。
- Bee verifier、Stop、原 unavailable terminal、answer lane 相关回归：55/55 通过。
- routing readiness：15/15 通过。
- 架构源码测试：244/244 通过；可信 runner/CI 入口未运行。
- 真实安装态 WorkSwarm queue/steer 升级组合：1/1 通过。使用仓库 `install_runtime.py --build-only` 构建并验证 patched wheels；真实 Store/WorkSwarm/Registry/Host，受控模型和 Host isolation witness。v1 原 factory 执行并消费 queue，v2 不接管旧 Session，两个 turn 的 context/completion 均提交。
- `kimi-slides check`、Python 语法和 `git diff --check` 通过。

原始 vendored 源码未带完成证明时，真实 queue 用例按预期以 `WorkSwarm runtime completion is unconfirmed` 失败；改用上述 patched wheels 后通过。未删除或弱化任何断言。

## 未运行 / 范围

- 未运行 HarmonyOS 设备、真实云模型、真实外部 provider、真实多实例容器滚动部署或线上数据验收。
- 未把本地架构测试称为可信 CI，也未声称部署/回滚已完成。
- 本地依赖环境有 FastAPI/google-api-core 与 WorkSwarm OpenTelemetry `<1.42` 的解析冲突；安装态用例实际通过，但完整生产依赖一致性仍需部署门禁确认。

pr:2017.body:
## 背景

#1318：Beebou→Bee 的一轮任务跑超 Host 预算时，原来只有一句英文内部常量
「Stopped at the task budget」，这一轮已经搜过什么、读过什么、做到哪全部丢失；
同时 Home 里的止损卡片会漂到对话尾部，脱离它所属的那一轮。

本 PR 只针对产品路径 Beebou→Bee。

## 改动

### 1. 预算止损带出「这一轮干了什么」（蜂群路径）
- `temp/hive-runtime`：新增 `turn_progress.py`，逐帧观测一轮的进行时状态
  （正文只留最后 4000 字；搜索/已读页面/成功调用/未完成调用各最多 10 条），
  纯内存、turn 结束即释放，不落盘。
- `bee_runtime.py`：预算到点由同一个可见证的 `HostBeeStop`
  （`budget:<run_id>:<generation>`）结束该轮，note 由 `budget_text` 用快照生成，
  随 `TextOutcome("stopped", text=note)` 落库到 `dm_hive_stopped_results.text`。
- `hive_bee_runtime.py`：绑定 turn 预算（`DIGITALMATE_BEE_TURN_BUDGET_S` /
  `EXECUTION_CEILING_S`），并把 adapter 的等待超时设为预算 + 60s。
- 停工说明按任务语言输出：做了什么、缺什么、怎么继续（「回我一句『继续』」）；
  locked budget 改为提示「没法直接接着跑，请重做一次」。

### 2. 止损卡片留在自己那一轮下面
- `hive_store.py`：stopped terminal 按 `stopped_at_ms` 投影为持久行，
  以 dispatch seq 为键、经 `dm_hive_result_notices`（version=1）关联；
  terminal 行携带 `terminal_text`、`task_ref`，可被客户端按 task 回收。
- `DigitalMateConversation.ets`：任务进入 `terminalTasks` 后，客户端退休对应的
  实时 stopped 通知，避免尾部再出现重复的一行。

### 3. 引擎侧共用文案
- `engine_activity.budget_stop_note` / `engine_service.stop_output`：
  用任务语言生成说明；`ExecutionResult.progress`（`TurnProgress`，列表上限 20）承载进度。
- 预算止损同时把 note 写入消息流，供 HAP 与 Home 两条显示路径共用。

## 测试

- 新增 `test_budget_stop_note.py`、`test_hive_runtime_turn_budget.py`、
  `test_hive_runtime_turn_progress.py`，并补充 Home terminal / stop store /
  context terminal 及客户端 `HiveBeeTerminalHome` 用例。
- bridge pytest `-k "hive or bee"`：967 passed / 25 skipped / 7 xfailed；
  8 个失败全部与本次改动无关——4 个在纯净 upstream `eee644066` 上同样复现
  （`time_note` ×2 因上游新增能力元数据系统消息、`quote_frames` 因上游新增
  `timing` 字段、`runtime_flow` 20s 回执超时），4 个 session_proximity 用例
  在并发全量下超时、单独复跑通过。
- 客户端 Node UT 31 项全部通过。

## 设备验收

- 镜像 `v202611184-adx-jiuwen-test-2`（commit `e77ebb926`），HAP 安装于
  `7XNYD26516010915`，2026-11-18 验收通过：
  第一次止损说明在「继续」上方；重新提交后第二轮止损说明紧跟它自己那一轮，
  不再出现重复的尾部卡片。

pr:2019.body:
## 问题

从某个 Bee 直接进入它的会话页时，助手回复的 Markdown 不渲染，`##`、`**`、`|---|` 表格语法原样显示（#2018）。

根因：`HiveBeeConversation.ets` 的 `History()` 用 `Text(row.text)` 渲染所有行，而 Home 主对话的助手回复走 `CloudMarkdownView`，所以同样的内容在 Home 正常、在 Bee 直达页是纯文本。

## 改动

只改 1 个文件、+8/-1：

- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/DigitalMateHome/HiveBeeConversation.ets`
  - 新增 `import { CloudMarkdownView } from '../CloudHome/components/CloudMarkdownView';`
  - `History()` 内按角色分流：`row.role === 'user'` 仍用 `Text`；其余（Bee / Beebou 派单）改用
    ```ts
    CloudMarkdownView({ text: row.text, streaming: false, foldLongReply: false })
    ```

说明：
- `CloudMarkdownView` 本身一行未改，只是新增一个调用方；其 `onOpenLink` 默认空实现、mermaid 系列回调可选，因此只传上述三个参数是安全的。
- `foldLongReply: false` 是刻意选择：这是专门的 Bee 会话页，长报告应完整展开，而不是折叠成概览卡。
- 用户消息气泡、`maxWidth: 86%` 布局约束、气泡底色、以及同文件第 476 行“停止任务”按钮下的小字标签（`Text(row.text)`，10px/maxWidth 100）均未改动。

## 影响面

- 仅「从 Bee 直接进入的会话页」；Home 主对话、CloudHome、Beebou 活动面板不受影响。
- 预期副作用：长报告渲染开销上升（单页静态列表）、表格在 86% 宽度内可能横向溢出、链接会显示为可点样式但当前无跳转处理（改造前是纯文本不可点）。

## 验证

- ArkTS 编译通过：`build_hap.py --source-dir <fix-2018> --config <20026>` → `BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 1m43s`，包内端点仍为 `wss://onlineswarm.openjiuwen.com:20026/digitalmate/ws`。
- 签名通过：sha256 `c721e680a9e74af0b2d2a9adf3ebef94747fd6ad653add1af9d3a4f9bb1868a9`，签名 / 证书链 / 20026 四端点校验 PASS。

**未验证（阻塞）**：真机安装与视觉验收未完成——执行 `hdc install` 时报 `[Fail][E001005] Device not found or connected`，`hdc list targets` 为空，重启 hdc 后仍未恢复，判定为设备未连接（USB 断开或调试授权失效），不是包的问题。因此以下项目仍需在设备上确认：标题/加粗/表格/分隔线的渲染效果、表格横向溢出、长报告滚动与渲染耗时、链接呈现。

## 关联

Closes #2018
Related: #1665（post-HIVE 非阻塞事项汇总）

pr:296.body:
## 关联 Issue

- #233（`==` 标记泄漏，已由 #257 修）与 #278（等号比较被吞，已由 #269 修）
- #241（停止按钮无响应，已由 #268 修）

三个 issue 的修复都已在 main 上。本 PR **不改产品代码**，只把这三处行为补成设备级 ST 回归，避免以后同一个正则或同一处任务定位再退化。

## 做了什么

新增两条 Orbit 真实业务 ST 用例，并保持既有用例行为不变。

### `markup` — 等号比较与高亮标记解析（#233 / #278）

- 把**生产**的 `CloudMarkdown.ets` / `CloudMath.ets` 一起编译进独立 ST HAP，断言直接调用 `parseInline` / `parseMarkdownTable`，而不是复制一份正则到测试里（复制出来的正则会和生产实现漂移，正是这两个 issue 的成因）。
- 先要求模型原样回显一行混合文本，再对**该任务实际返回的回复**做断言：
  1. 每个带空格的比较片段（`a == b`、`if x == 0`）必须原样保留在可见文本里；
  2. 比较不得被渲染成 highlight（这正是 #278 里操作数被删掉的原因）；
  3. 紧贴文字的 `==标记==` 仍然高亮，且原始 `==标记==` 不残留在气泡文本里（#233 的症状）；
  4. 表格单元格路径同样成立：`` `a == b == c` `` 保持字面量，裸 `==25%==` 仍高亮。
- 不写死期望字符串：断言遍历回复中**实际出现**的比较片段，模型多说或少说不会被误判成通过。

### `stop` — 停止正在运行的任务（#241）

- 用 `extractRuntimeMethods` 从 `OrbitTaskRuntime.ets` **逐字提取** `topLevelTaskId` / `stopTarget` / `stopTask`，包进 `OrbitStopTarget`，仅补 `current` 与 `client`。停哪个任务、发什么请求，全部是生产代码。
- 真实流程：提交一条长任务 → 要求它此刻仍是 `pending`/`running`/`waiting` → 经生产 `stopTarget` 算出目标 → 发真实 `task.cancel` → 在同一预算内观察到**同一个 task** 变成 `cancelled`。
- 明确失败而非静默通过：`NOT_ACTIVE`、`READ_ONLY_ROOM`、`STOP_TARGET_MISMATCH`、`NO_CANCEL_SENT`、`STOP_IGNORED`、`CANCEL_UNCONFIRMED`。任务先跑到 `completed` 会被判 `STOP_IGNORED`，不会因为"反正结束了"算过。

### 配套改动

- `orb-rst-scenes.mjs`：注册两个新 key。两条新用例**不进** `all` / `smoke` / `core`，需显式 `-Cases markup,stop`；隔离规则改成按用例名判断，不再靠数组位置。
- `prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs`：新增 `extractRuntimeMethods`（源码结构变化即抛错，不静默降级），并把解析器与 `OrbitStopTarget` 纳入生成清单与 `source-manifest.json`。
- `LiveBusiness.test.ets`：`submit()` / `waitTask()` 增加 `untilActive` 分支，让用例能观察运行中的任务，同时仍正确收尾自己的 task trace。
- `run-orbit-device-st.ps1`：HAP 符号门禁补上两个新用例名（原先只校验六条）。
- `orbit-st-report-view.mjs`：补阶段中文名与用例标题，报告里不再显示裸 key。
- `nightly.yml`：`st_cases` 说明同步。
- `README.md`：用例表、选择器说明、以及**每条用例的真实通过条件**。

## 验证

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `node tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs` | 28 条，26 通过，2 失败 |
| 失败项 | `native stderr warnings…` / `native nonzero exit…` |
| 失败原因 | 本机沙箱禁止 `child_process.spawnSync` 捕获输出（`EPERM`），与本次改动无关：这两条用例及其依赖的 `runNative`（`scripts/orbit-st-tools.mjs`）在 main 上均未改动 |
| `scripts/prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs --compile-only` | 通过，27 个源文件，`OrbitStopTarget.ets` / `CloudMarkdown.ets` 均生成 |
| 生成物语法 | 用 SDK 自带 TypeScript 解析器全量解析 `.ets`，无语法错误 |
| `git diff --check` | 通过 |
| CI `node-ut` | **success**（含 `tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs` 全量 28 条，含本次新增断言） |
| CI `ArkTS Code Check` | **success** |
| CI `hypium-ut` | skipped（仓库变量 `ENABLE_HYPIUM_UT` 未开启，与本次改动无关） |

**未完成、不能算通过：**

- 本机真实 HAP 编译未跑成：hvigor 在 `C:\Users\qq567\.hvigor` 写缓存、并在 `node_modules\@ohos\hvigor` 建符号链接，本机沙箱分别报 `EPERM mkdir` 和 `EPERM symlink`（后者即 WinError 1314）。**CI 也没有跑 HAP 编译那条路**（`hypium-ut` skipped），所以 ST 工程的 ArkTS 编译门禁**仍未真正通过**；生成物只做了 TypeScript 语法解析。
- 两条新用例**从未在真实后端跑过**。`all` / `smoke` / `core` 里没有它们，Nightly 也不会自动跑到，需要显式 `-Cases markup,stop` 并配好 Gateway Bearer 与设备。
- 因此本 PR 不宣称 #233/#278/#241 的 ST 回归"已验证通过"，只提供可执行的回归用例与明确失败判据。跑通后再补真实回执。

## 复现

```powershell
# 离线断言
node tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs

# 生成 + 编译（需要可用的 DevEco 与符号链接权限）
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases 'markup,stop' -OutputDirectory "$env:TEMP\ST-IssueCases"

# 真实运行（需要 ST_DEVICE_ID / ST_ORBIT_URL / ST_ORBIT_BEARER）
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -Run -Cases 'markup,stop' -OutputDirectory "$env:TEMP\ST-IssueCases"
```

## 说明

- 提交内容只有上述 8 个文件，未包含签名材料、本地配置或凭据。
- `markup` 与 `stop` 跑通后会各自留下真实通过记录，届时再考虑是否纳入默认套件；本 PR 不预先放宽或收紧既有五条用例。

## 关于 PR 来源

本 PR 与 #294 是同一提交（`c6e0812f`）。#294 从私有 fork 发起，CI 的 `Download source snapshot` 用 base 仓库 token 去取 fork 的 tarball 返回 404，两个门禁只跑了收尾步骤就失败，实际未验证任何代码。改为从本仓库分支 `test/st-issue-regression-cases` 发起后，tarball 走 `github.repository`，两个门禁均已真实执行并通过。#294 已关闭。

pr:300.body:
## 问题

最新 main 上，Orbit 设备 ST 的测试 HAP **编译不出来**。

```
.\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases core
→ COMPILE RESULT:FAIL {ERROR:22 WARN:100}
  Error: Property 'trajectory' does not exist on type 'ProductionComposer'
  Error: Property 'profilingEnabled' does not exist on type 'ProductionComposer'
  Error: Cannot find name 'OrbitResponse' / 'OrbitRequest'
  Error: Cannot find module '@loop/cloud-adapter'
```

## 根因

`tests/dfx/stability/orbit-device/ComposerHost.ets` 是一个**手写**的 host 类，承载 `prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs` 从生产 `OrbitHome/Index.ets` **逐字提取**的 `send` / `drainSend` 方法体。

生产代码这阵子给这两个方法加了 trajectory 打点、profiling 开关和 draft 行状态，但 host 没跟着声明。提取是逐字的，所以方法体里引用了 host 上不存在的成员——编译必失败。

这是 main 上的既有缺陷，**与任何新用例无关**。已用未修改的 main（`5d574e36`）直接复现。

## 改动

| 文件 | 改动 |
|---|---|
| `ComposerHost.ets` | 引入并实例化生产 `OrbitTrajectory` 作为 `trajectory`；补 `profilingEnabled`（关闭）、`traceSubmissionId`、`draftNeedsOwnRow`；补 `OrbitRequest`/`OrbitResponse` 导入 |
| `prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs` | 拷贝 `OrbitTrajectory.ets` 并在 `orbit/index.ets` 导出；改写 `OrbitDeviceContext.ets` 的 `'@loop/cloud-adapter'` 别名 |
| `tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs` | 两个新守卫 |

### 为什么用真实 `OrbitTrajectory` 而不是空实现

它是纯逻辑类，只依赖 `hilog` 和 `OrbitProtocol` 的计时类型，没有 UI 依赖。用真实实现意味着提取出来的 `send`/`drainSend` 仍然调用**产品本来的**记录器，而不是我在测试里伪造一个。这符合这套 ST 的原则：产品方法逐字执行，测试只补 UI 生命周期。

`profilingEnabled` 设为 `false`，与页面默认值一致，让产品 `send` 走非诊断分支。`traceSubmissionId` / `draftNeedsOwnRow` 也取页面初始值。

### 两个守卫

这次问题的本质是「手写 host 与逐字提取的方法体失配」，而且**只有到真机跑才会发现**。所以补了两个单元守卫：

1. **成员完备性**：提取出的方法体里每个 `this.<member>`，必须能在 host 上解析（`extractSupport` 注入的方法算数）。缺失即报 `ProductionComposer is missing: x, y`。
2. **别名改写**：直接对生成产物断言，任何生成的 `.ets` 都不得残留 `'@loop/'`。这比匹配 prepare 的源码写法可靠。

守卫已验证有效：删掉 `trajectory` 那一行，立刻报
```
AssertionError: ProductionComposer is missing: trajectory
```

## 验证

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `node tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs`（干净 main + 本 commit） | **25/25 通过** |
| 守卫有效性 | 移除 `trajectory` → 报 `missing: trajectory`；恢复 → 全绿 |
| `-CompileOnly -Cases core`（本分支） | **`CompileOnly succeeded`**，`Verified test HAP: SDK runner and all six business case implementations are present.` |
| 生成物别名 | 生成后 `OrbitDeviceContext.ets` 内已无 `@loop` |
| `git diff --check` | 通过 |

编译是**实际执行**的，不是推断：本机 hvigor 已跑通，输出见上。

**未做：** 没有在真机跑业务用例（需要 Gateway Bearer，当前环境没有）。本 PR 只修编译，不改任何用例语义。

## 复现

```powershell
# 修复前
git checkout 5d574e36
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases core
# → COMPILE RESULT:FAIL {ERROR:22}

# 修复后
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases core
# → CompileOnly succeeded
```

## 与其他 PR 的关系

与 #296（新增 #233/#278、#241 的 ST 回归用例）**相互独立**，可分别合并。#296 也包含同样的编译修复（否则它自己的新用例也编不过）；本 PR 先合入后，#296 可以 rebase 掉这部分。

pr:391.body:
E2E DAG validation compares fixed component states before and after each action, showing paired expected/actual endpoint values in HTML. Non-applicable checks are hidden. Generated reply wording, intermediate animation sequences and DAG-specific screenshots are excluded. Missing captures, invalid paths, ineffective actions and component mismatches fail the artifact gate.

One shared allowlist enables 12 reviewed cases for both CI execution and independent artifact validation. BACK-01, QUOTE-01 and TRAVEL-01 retain their standards but are deferred. ST and UT do not run application DAG/component gates.

CI validation uses the effective target consistently for job naming, simulator startup and signing checks. The dedicated upstream validation branch builds and installs the checkout on the simulator, launches it without an interactive window, and skips ST/cloud image deployment. Standard/checker tests run before device operations. The CLI resolves canonical entry paths so macOS temporary-directory symlinks cannot silently skip execution. Page preflight reuses the workflow driver's readiness checks and reports login or system-blocking conditions explicitly.

Validation:
- 40 DAG/component checker tests passed locally and on the macOS CI runner, including a symlink-entry regression.
- Remote simulator startup, device connection, native build and HAP installation passed.
- Four device/signing scenarios and two emulator-launch branches checked locally with mocked build/device executables.
- Local three-round E2E experiment (one attempt per case, frozen standards): 12/12, 1/12, 1/12. Of 22 failures, 20 showed reply failure, one showed cloud session recovery failure and one failed foreground readiness. The controlled component case passed 3/3. This does not establish stability of all business terminal-state checks.
- Latest remote run: https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/41620367760 . E2E execution is currently blocked because the remote simulator opens the DigitalMate login page. Authentication must be restored before rerunning; no remote E2E pass is claimed.

Readiness limit: an action boundary is captured after its driver returns and a quiet layout or completed frame. This does not independently guarantee completion of all asynchronous business work. Reply-completion readiness currently includes UI heuristics and a stable-text fallback; fixed endpoint controls are checked against the reviewed standard.

pr:399.body:
## 这个 PR 做什么

新增七条原生业务 E2E（`DM-WF-REGRESSION-01`～`07`），覆盖 #339、#152、#62、#239、#255、#157 的回归场景，外加一条设备侧探针，用来判断依赖预置数据的两条用例能不能跑。

用例登记在 `tests/cases/case-catalog.yaml`（`ci-gates/case-catalog@1`）：

| 用例 | 关联 | 执行方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 01 | #339 未合并双卡、独立输入、反序回答 | Nightly |
| 02 | #152 主题澄清后长作文交付 | Nightly |
| 03 | #62 真实搜索结论与来源 | Nightly |
| 04 | #239 真实图片产物与预览 | Nightly |
| 05 | #255 失败提醒读取与恢复 | `fixture-required` |
| 06 | #157 主对话与活动入口一致性 | Nightly |
| 07 | #339 静默结果恢复不泄露 | `fixture-required` |

## 为什么 05/07 要单独处理

01/02/03/04/06 在会话内自造状态，可以直接跑。05/07 需要云端真实产生的记录：

- **05**：两条不同的「真实 failed + 未读」任务，加一张 waiting 的未答授权卡
- **07**：一条 completed、非 quiet、结果精确为 `[SILENT]` 的任务（无 active 产物），加一条真实失败或文件交付作对照

这些状态测试造不出来，也不允许伪造（不写库、不编 `failed`、不代用户点授权）。所以它们带 `preconditions.manualSetup` 和 `execution: fixture-required`；`runner.mjs` 的 `selectWorkflows` 会过滤掉所有带 `manualSetup` 的用例，**无人值守 Nightly 永远不会捡到它们**，不会因为缺预置把夜间绿灯打红。

## 探针的安全模型

直接复用已存在的受保护凭据，不向任何人索要 token：

- 从 `AssetCredentialStore` 内存读取 grant，校验 active owner、environment、有效期
- 必须先用 `room.home` 拿到已认证快照，才允许准备记录
- 只导出账号指纹（64 位 hex）和按 marker 匹配的任务元数据，**不导出 token，也不读取其他会话**

## 本轮修复的三个真实缺陷

前几次 CI 失败都不是业务断言失败，而是证据链断裂：

**① 探针写了 0 个文件。** `createModuleContext('entry')` 原本在 `try` 之外，设备上 wrapper 被拒时直接抛断言错，`finally` 里的写文件根本没执行 —— 于是表现为 `Failure: 1` 且没有 `probe.json`。现在上下文解析进 `try`，写入路径独立解析并覆盖 `entry` / `entry_test` / app `filesDir` 三个候选，实际写入路径记录在 `writtenTo`。

**② 收集器信任了退出码。** `hdc file recv` 在远端文件不存在时会打印 `Error opening file` 但 **exit 0**，且不产生本地文件。上一轮「收集成功」其实是空文件。现在必须本地文件非空且含本次 `fixtureRunId` 才算成功；缺失即报「证据缺失，不能判定账号或前置状态」。

**③ ohosTest 编译缺少依赖。** CI 上 `E2E_INSTALL_APP=false` 会跳过 App 构建，`oh_modules` 从未生成；而探针 import 的 `@loop/agent-core`、`@loop/cloud-adapter` 是 `file:../*` 本地依赖，需要 `ohpm install` 后才可解析。表现为 `Cannot find module` + `COMPILE RESULT:FAIL {ERROR:167}`，探针一行都没执行。现在脚本在编译前先 `"$OHPM" install --all`，nightly 也把 `OHPM` 传入该步骤。

同时把阻塞原因分类（`no-active-account` / `no-saved-grant` / `stale-grant` / `unexpected-endpoint` / `cloud-unauthorized` / `tls-failure` / `timeout` / `authenticated-read-empty`），不再一律折叠成 `blocked`。

## 用例本身的一处收紧

05 的 S11 改为陈述「相对 S05 基线，关注数只减少甲这一项」。该计数按 **distinct taskId** 计算（`DigitalMateNoticePresentation.ets:27`），所以用例自己发出的普通问答不会干扰差值；措辞也不再诱导按总数理解。

- `node scripts/gate/gate.mjs verify-cases` → **23 total, 23 ready**

- native `entry@ohosTest` HAP 本地编译通过
- `actionlint` 与 shell 语法检查通过（仅报既有自托管 runner 标签未登记，属既有状态）

## 当前真实状态（不要误读）

**没有任何一条业务 E2E 被验证通过。**

运行 `41380817343`（`inspect-fixtures`）的预检**已通过**（`对话页已就绪，digitalmate-* test id 可见`），说明冷启动后 UI 与 test id 正常；失败发生在探针 HAP 的 ArkTS 编译（上述缺陷 ③），探针逻辑未执行，因此**这次仍不能判定账号或前置状态**。

更早的运行停在页面预检的 `App 云端连接未就绪`，5 条自动用例的业务步骤一步都没执行。设备侧 UI 曾显示 `网络不可用，请检查网络后重试` / `正在恢复云端连接…`，属客户端连接症状，**不构成账号缺失的证明**。

本 PR 的断言一律未放宽。后续运行的价值在于把「连不上」变成可分类的结论：要么跑出逐条结果，要么明确写出是缺 grant、凭据过期、TLS 失败还是 Gateway 拒绝。

`ready` 只表示有用例可执行，不代表已部署云端或已通过真实设备验收。只有截图与评分硬门槛都通过，才能宣称业务验收通过。

pr:401.body:
## What this fixes

A turn that stops receiving events while the websocket stays healthy leaves the UI in "running" indefinitely. Reconnect reconciliation only runs when the connection drops (`CloudChatManager.reconcileAfterReconnect`), so a silent turn is never checked and the user is left with a half sentence and no way to tell whether the answer is still coming — the exact现场 in #379 (回复只有「我核对一下具体是谁说的。」，之后无任何输出，也没有失败提示或重试入口).

The session now watches that silence itself: after one minute without any event on a turn that still owes output, the conversation raises a single `warn` notice ("云端仍在处理，近一分钟没有新的输出。可以继续等待，或停止任务后重试。"). It never changes the run state, never fabricates a failure, and disappears the moment the cloud says anything again.

Fixes #398. Fixes #379 (user-visible report of the same quiet-turn hang). See also #373 (execution-time opacity).

## How it works

`CloudSession`:

- `watchQuiet()` restarts the silence clock and drops a shown hint. It is called from `beginTurn()` and on every frame the session accepts in `apply()`, so only a genuine gap counts.
- The timer fires at most once per quiet stretch (`quietHint` latches until the next event), only while `state` is `running` or `sending` — a paused turn, a turn waiting on an unanswered question, a stopped turn and a finished turn all have their own state and never see the hint.
- `settleQuiet()` stops the clock and removes the hint on `finishTurn()` and on `beginTurn()` of the next turn, so nothing leaks across turns.
- The hint is only placed when `notice` is empty: a real error/notice is never overwritten.
- The threshold is a constructor parameter (`new CloudSession(id, quietHintMs)`), defaulting to the exported `QUIET_HINT_MS = 60000`; tests pass a short value instead of sleeping a minute.

No new protocol, no server change, no new dependency, no logging of prompt/response content, no permission change. Rollback is a revert of two files.

## Tests (failing first)

`tests/unit/cloud-session-quiet-watch.test.mjs` — 7 cases, real `CloudSession` through the existing `tests/support/cloud-test-loader.mjs`, no device or backend.

Red first: before the change the suite failed with `assert.ok(session.notice)` — a silent running turn produced no notice at all.

| Case | Expectation |
| --- | --- |
| running turn, no events | `warn` notice containing「仍在处理」, `state` stays `running` |
| output resumes | notice cleared at once, bubble text continues normally |
| turn finished before the threshold | no notice, `state` is `idle` |
| turn waiting on the user (`chat.ask_user_question`) | no notice (`state` is `waiting`) |
| a real notice already shown | untouched (`连接已中断` stays) |
| silence continues | notice does not repeat |
| next turn starts | no leftover notice from the previous turn |

Green after the change: 7/7. Whole `cloud-*` unit set on this branch: 517 pass / 3 fail, and the 3 failures are the missing local devDependencies (`typescript` ×2, `playwright` ×1) that `ut.yml` installs — none of them touches `CloudSession`.

## Non-goals

- No automatic failure state, no new terminal state, no retry RPC: the client cannot verify the turn is dead, and inventing a failure would be worse than the silence.
- No server-side change; if the cloud really stops answering, a proper terminal event still has to come from the backend (#367/#379).
- No change to execution/step presentation (that is #373/#375).

## Risk

The only risk is a false alarm during a legitimately long non-streaming tool phase (#322): the notice is worded as "still working", changes no state, blocks no input, is cleared by the next event and appears once per quiet stretch, with a one-minute threshold. Worst case the user sees one informational line on a long turn.

pr:403.body:
## What this fixes

Markdown emphasis in a Chinese reply leaked its markers into the bubble and broke the sentence style:

- `***两者***` rendered as `*` + bold `两者` + `*`
- `**粗体 *内斜* 混排**` rendered as five spans (`*`, italic `粗体 `, plain `内斜`, italic ` 混排`, `*`) — the outer bold was lost entirely

Cause: the bold branch of `parsePlainInline()` only accepted content without an asterisk (`\*\*([^*]+)\*\*`), so any nested emphasis made the whole span fail and the leftover markers fell through as plain text.

Fixes #402. Same rendering pipeline as #357 (multi-line content shown unrendered) and independent of #360 (table separator rows).

## How it works

`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudMarkdown.ets`:

- The bold branch now accepts inner emphasis: `\*\*((?:[^*]|\*[^*]+\*)+)\*\*`, which covers `**粗体 *内斜* 混排**`, and `***x***` (the inner `*x*` matches, so the whole triple form lands on the bold branch).
- The captured text has its inner `*` markers removed before the span is created: `Inline` carries a single style, so the outer bold wins and no marker reaches the bubble. A numeric inner pair is the exception: `**5*3*2 = 30**` is arithmetic, so its asterisks stay literal (`boldPlainText()`), while `***x***` keeps rendering as bold `x`.
- Ordered before the backtick branch as before, so inline code and fenced code keep their asterisks literal.

No new dependency, no protocol change, no content dropped — only the markers.

## Tests (failing first)

New `tests/unit/cloud-markdown-emphasis.test.mjs`, 4 cases; red on `0fb0456` (each assertion showed the stray `*` spans above), green after the fix.

| Case | Expectation |
| --- | --- |
| `***两者***` | one bold span, text `两者` |
| `价格 ***99*** 元` | `价格 ` + bold `99` + ` 元` |
| `**粗体 *内斜* 混排**` | one bold span, text `粗体 内斜 混排` |
| `结论：**关键 *点* 已确认**。` | prefix + one bold span + `。` |
| `**粗体**`, `*斜体*`, `==高亮==`, `**粗体** 与 *斜体*` | unchanged |
| `` `a *** b` `` | literal `a *** b` inside a code span |

Whole markdown set on this branch (`cloud-markdown`, `cloud-markdown-links`, `cloud-markdown-layout`, `markdown-render-st`, plus the new suite): **65 pass / 0 fail**.

## Non-goals

- No nested rich text: `Inline` keeps its single-style contract, the outer span wins.
- No change to table recognition (#360's area) or to linkification.
- No new dependency, no logging, no permission change.

## Risk

The only new behaviour is that literal asterisks nested inside a bold span are dropped, except for a numeric inner pair, which stays literal because dropping it would change the value the user reads (`**5*3*2 = 30**` used to become `532 = 30`). A product written with one star and no closing partner (`**2*3**`) is not matched by the bold branch at all and behaves as before (verified: `*` + italic `2` + `3**` on both `0fb0456` and this branch) — the earlier example in this description was wrong. Code spans are matched first and keep their asterisks, and the existing behaviours (`**bold**`, `*italic*`, ``code``) are pinned by the tests. Rollback is a one-line regex revert plus the handler line.

## 问题

「执行步骤」卡片、子代理活动行和步骤摘要都经过 `brief()`（`CloudMessage.ets`）。它只认 `data:` URL 一种二进制形态，而且 scheme 匹配会跨过 JSON 引号：

1. **裸露 base64 不被遮蔽**：`{"image_base64":"iVBORw0KGgo" + "A"×600}` 原样输出 612 个字符（最长到 12000 字符上限），图片生成工具的字节铺满步骤卡片。
2. **多个内联 data URL 被合并**：`{"images":["data:...","data:..."]}` → `{"images":["[二进制内容]"]}`，第二张图消失——`data:[^\s]+;base64,` 会吃到最后一个 `;base64,`，把中间字段吞掉。

## 改动

`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudMessage.ets`（+6/−1）：

- `data:[^"\s]+;base64,` —— 遇到引号即止，两个二进制条目各自遮蔽，JSON 结构与同级字段保持完整。
- 新增 `[A-Za-z0-9+/]{200,}={0,2}` —— 不带 scheme 的裸 base64（≥200 连续字符）同样折叠为 `[二进制内容]`；阈值远大于任何正常标识符，普通文本、短数字、URL 主机名与 `?download_token=` 既有遮蔽行为不变。
- 不改气泡正文、不改协议、不改任何网络行为。

```

```

回归范围（cloud-* 与 digitalmate-*）：

ℹ tests 1015 · pass 1012 · fail 3

pr:411.body:
## 问题

`chat.final` 的落地路径先解析「这条 final 覆盖哪个分段」，`parseChatFinalSegmentId()` 把四个候选字段塞进 `string[]` 后逐个 `.trim()`。帧是服务端下发的 JSON，`Payload.segment_id?: string` 只是编译期声明；消息 id 在服务端常是整数，`||` 只吞掉 `0`/`''`，非零数字会原样进入数组并让 `.trim()` 抛 `TypeError`。

在 `0fb0456` 上实测：

```
parseChatFinalSegmentId({ segment_id: 42 })        → TypeError: value.trim is not a function
session.apply({event:'chat.final',
  payload:{request_id:'turn', content:'最终回答', stream_message_id: 98765}})
                                                   → TypeError: value.trim is not a function
```

异常发生在帧分发里，被 `CloudConnection` 的 `try/catch` 转成 `onProtocolError('消息处理失败，详见通信日志')`：这条 final 的正文整条丢失，同一轮的 `finishTurn()` 也没执行，用户看到的是通用错误提示而不是回复。

Fixes #410

## 改动

`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudFinal.ets`（+11/−6）：

- 候选值按 `string | undefined` 收集，逐个 `typeof value !== 'string'` 跳过，字符串路径仍 `trim()` 后返回；
- 四个字段都不可用时返回 `''`（表示写到客户端当前分段），不再抛异常；
- 与同文件 `parseChatFinalMode()` 已有的 `typeof raw !== 'string'` 校验保持一致。

不改协议、不改分段选择策略、不改任何网络行为；只是不再让一个可选字段的类型把整条 final 打掉。

## 测试

新增 `tests/unit/cloud-final-segment-id.test.mjs`，**先失败后通过**（`0fb0456` 上 4 条中 3 条失败）：

| 用例 | 断言 |
| --- | --- |
| 数字型 `segment_id` / `stream_message_id` | 返回 `''`，不抛异常 |
| 前一个候选不可用、后一个可用 | 取到 `'m-9'`；`'seg-1'` 原样返回；`'  seg-2  '` 被 trim |
| `parseChatFinalMode` 非字符串 | 仍返回 `''`（回归保护） |
| 带数字 `stream_message_id` 的 `chat.final` | 回复落进气泡、`completed === true`、会话回到 `idle` |

```
node --test tests/unit/cloud-final-segment-id.test.mjs   # 4/4
node --test tests/unit/cloud-*.test.mjs                  # 517 tests · 514 pass · 3 fail
```

3 条失败是本地缺依赖的既有基线（`Cannot find module 'typescript'` ×2、`'playwright'` ×1，CI 的 `ut.yml` 会安装），与本次改动无关。`CloudFinal.ets` 此前在 `tests/unit` 里没有任何覆盖，这个文件顺带补上。

## 未验证

- 服务端线上是否真的会下发数字型分段 id：仓库内没有服务端代码，无法证实。本 PR 修的是「客户端把可选字段做成硬失败点」这一可复现事实，而不是声称线上已发生。
- 真机渲染与 ArkTS 编译：沙箱无真机与 ArkTS 工具链，由 CI 的 ArkTS Code Check 覆盖。

## 风险与回滚

行为面很小：只有非字符串候选值从「抛异常」变成「跳过」。若服务端确实永远只发字符串，这个改动等价于空操作。回滚只需 revert 这一个 commit。

pr:415.body:
Fixes #414

## 这个 PR 做了什么

纯文档 + 一个契约测试，没有运行时代码、依赖、权限或设置改动（唯一的仓库元数据变化是新增 4 个标签名
`goal:P1`、`priority:P0`、`type:docs`、`source:goal`，供 issue #414 使用）。

产品迭代目标 v1 的 §10 要求四份产物先于功能落地，但仓库 `docs/` 没有产品目录，每轮都在重新论证定位。
本 PR 落地四份文档，并用一条契约测试把它们钉住：

| 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/product/positioning.md` | 一句话定位、目标用户、三条 JTBD、P1/P2/P3（每条含当前实现证据 / 差距 / 验收）、七条明确不做、三处定位冲突 |
| `docs/product/competitive-landscape.md` | 5 直接 + 3 间接竞品 × 10 维度；每行带 事实/推断/假设、来源、ISO 日期；附本轮复验记录与未核实清单 |
| `docs/product/roadmap-6m.md` | 6 个月只做三件事，分别对应 P1/P2/P3；各有 M1–M3 里程碑、可度量验收、不做清单、风险 |
| `docs/product/backlog.md` | 20 项按支柱排序：类型、优先级、四类标签、证据、用户故事、现状与差距、验收、非目标检查、为什么是我们、不做会怎样、风险、预估、链接 |
| `tests/unit/product-docs.test.mjs` | 7 条契约测试：文档存在与索引、定位句唯一、三支柱字段、竞品来源/日期/置信度、路线图恰三件事、backlog 恰 20 项并按优先级排序、相对链接可解析 |
| `docs/README.md` | 目录表新增 `product/` 一行 |

## 先红后绿（可复核）

文档改动同样能测试先行，所以这一轮拆成两个提交：

1. `8116d36` **只提交测试**。在干净的 `8116d36` worktree 上运行
   `node --test tests/unit/product-docs.test.mjs` → **7 tests / 7 fail**（文档尚不存在）。
2. `e9fb8a6` **加入四份文档与索引**。同一命令 → **7 tests / 7 pass**。

上一轮的问题之一是"文档改动没法先写失败测试"；这里的结论相反：只要是可检查的约束（来源、日期、置信度、
排序、数量），就能先写失败测试。约定不是叙事，能跑才算。

## 评审后的修正（第三提交）

`64ab1f8` 把三个「没有基线却写成验收」的数字标成目标：B01 的 90% 与 B06 的 2 秒标注为「目标，M1 校准」，
B06 改为相对 #223 基线的「P50 下降 ≥ 50%」，B10 的「静默时段 0 次通知」明确为硬性行为而非比例目标。
理由写进 backlog 的新增规则段：没有基线就写死百分比，会让下一轮误以为已经验收过。加完仍 7/7 通过。

## 三个竞品来源本轮重新读过

不编造结论；读不到就降级并写清楚。本轮实测（2026-10-31）：

| 来源 | 结果 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `https://www.notion.com/help/notion-ai-faqs` | HTTP 200，读到正文 | 由推断升为事实（套餐、credits、Agent 建改页面、执行前审阅计划、权限继承） |

## 决定：URL 边界与 #408 同构（方案 a），另补回基线本来就排除的 `]` 和 `}`

执行过程提取来源链接时，采用 #408 在 `CloudMessage.ets:143` 定下的那条边界——`https?:\/\/` 后不允许空白、引号、尖括号、`(`/`)` 以及 CJK/全角标点区段（`\u2000-\u206f`、`\u3000-\u303f`、`\u3400-\u4dbf`、`\u4e00-\u9fff`、`\uff00-\uffef`）。理由：`brief()` 遮的是同一类工具文本，本函数从同一份 `step.text` 里取链接，两处边界一旦分叉，同一句中文里的同一个 URL 会在遮罩面和点击面得到两个不同结果。

在这条边界上只有三处**为「可点击」服务**的差异，都写进了代码注释：

1. **补回 `]` `}`**：基线原类 `[^\s"'<>\]\}]+` 本来就排除这两个字符，而 `#408` 的遮蔽类省掉了它们。遮蔽时多带一个字符无害；这里要把 URL 交给 `openLink`，`见 [https://example.com/a] 结束` 就会点开 `https://example.com/a]`（404）。所以边界用「#408 的类 + `\]` `\}`」。
1b. **CJK 汉字留在地址里**（评审 High，已在 `376d004` 修）：#408 的类停在中日韩汉字上，那对**遮蔽**是对的（它替换字节），但对**要打开的链接**会把 `https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/中文` 砍成站点根 `https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/`（实测），这比「吞一句正文」更糟。所以地址里允许 CJK 汉字、只以 CJK/全角**标点**收尾——这正是气泡自动链接 `CloudMarkdown.ets:75` 已经在用的同一套切法。标注一句残余：`https://example.com/a其中3条`（汉字紧贴 ASCII 且无标点）仍会被吞进地址，与气泡行为一致，属已知取舍。
2. **成对括号回接**：边界把 `(` 整组切掉，而维基式地址 `https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Function_(mathematics)` 的括号属于地址。这里在边界之后仅回接**配平**的括号组（含嵌套）；不配平的 `(`/`)` 仍留在地址外。
3. **ASCII 句末标点**：`.,;:!?*` 不属于地址（`。`、`，` 已由区段排除）。尾部连续剥掉；路径里的 `/`、`%`、`=`、`&`、`#`、`?` 不动（有测试钉住）。`https://x.com/a?` 这类空查询会被剥成 `https://x.com/a`，打开的是同一页面，判断为可接受。

没有把 `CloudMessage.ets` 里的字符类抽成共享常量：该文件正被 #408 占用，本轮不碰（这是本轮唯一的重复，注释里写明指向 `CloudMessage.ets:143`）。

## 改了什么

- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/CloudHome/CloudExecutionViewModel.ets`：`executionResources()` 的链接提取改用上述边界，并在入结果集合前做配平括号回接与句末标点裁剪；`seen` 去重、`titles` 映射（查不到时回退到未修剪的原始匹配）、文件路径提取、其他规则都不变。
- `tests/unit/cloud-execution-view.test.mjs`：新增 6 个测试（边界、括号、合法 URL 语法、去重计数、文本紧邻中文、`]`/`}` 包裹），**没有改动任何既有断言**（diff 里 `^-[^-]` = 0）。

修好后：来源行展示与点击打开的 URL 一致；同一 URL 带不同尾部标点只算一个来源。

## 可达链与单一数据通路（release 路径）

- 渲染：`CloudMessageCard.ets:392-405` → `onOpenProcessLink(link.url)`；详情面板 `Index.ets:1996-2001` → `openProcessLink(item.url)`
- 打开：`Index.ets:1927-1938`，只校验 `/^https?:\/\//` 就 `host.openLink(url)`
- 计数：`CloudExecutionViewModel.ets:237`（`executionWebSourceCount` 内部 `flatMap(step => executionResources(...))`）、`:254-256`（`executionDetailLabel` 同样 `flatMap(executionResources(...))` + `new Set(...)`）——**没有第二条正则**，计数跟着同一个函数走

## 证据（`main@7fbaa28`，node v24.22.2）

pr:506.body:
The evaluation contract job can spend its entire timeout in Git checkout on the self-hosted runners. PR #501 hit repeated connection resets before its tests could start.

Download the exact source commit through the same GitHub archive route used by server regressions, allow time for a slow connection, and record that commit in the evaluation report when the archive has no Git metadata. Cap the download and all retries at 20 minutes, with a 10-second termination grace, so the 25-minute job has time for the tests and failure summary.

Refs #501.

Validation:
- [Self-hosted evaluation workflow](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/41634773393) passed on the current commit: 47 self-tests, 11 task contracts, and both replay tasks passed.
- `node --test tests/eval/eval.test.mjs tests/unit/ci-gate.test.mjs` (57 passed).
- Exercised the download and summary scripts with a local archive and a scaled stalled-transfer timeout; extraction succeeded and the failure summary was produced. Confirmed the total timeout also interrupts curl's retry backoff.
- Ran the self-tests, task validation, and replay tasks from a local archive without `.git` and verified the recorded commit.
- `git diff --check`
